The main contribution is conceptual and empirical rather than algorithmic: making the hidden executor explicit, and characterizing three open problems. First, per-principle metrics such as coverage and accuracy are poor proxies for end-to-end reconstruction. Second, under a fixed constitution, plausible executors disagree materially—including LLM-as-judge prompting, majority vote, priority vote, and tree-based executors. Third, constitutions do not transfer reliably across LLMs, which discover different principles and interpret the same principles differently. A lightweight refinement, ICAI+, filters low-quality candidates on a small subsample and rewrites marginal principles using targeted counterexamples, bringing transparent aggregators closer to LLM-based execution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover PRISM, AlpacaEval, and Chatbot Arena. Metrics include inter-executor agreement, principle coverage and accuracy, end-to-end reconstruction accuracy, and cross-LLM portability. Naive ICAI tends to produce either very narrow principles with near-zero coverage or broad, underspecified principles that defer key decisions to the executor. Holding the constitution fixed, LLM-as-judge and transparent aggregators show substantial disagreement. Different LLMs discover semantically different principle sets and diverge on applicability and vote direction even for shared principles. ICAI+ improves coverage, reduces signs of underspecification, and closes much of the gap between simple aggregation rules and LLM executors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on three parts: the discoverer–annotator–executor decomposition in Figure 1, which is the central conceptual move; the quantitative evidence on executor sensitivity and cross-LLM portability; and the counterexample-based rewriting in ICAI+. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes. Readers working on RLHF data, auto-evaluation, or constitutional data synthesis should pay most attention to the executor definition and metric mismatch. For pretraining-focused readers, the main takeaway is a clean empirical demonstration that preference labels and rubrics are not clean, self-contained supervision.

recommendation.zh: 偏好数据不是“原则列表”的观点值得保留；读 executor disagreement 的实验即可，别把它当完整对齐方案。
recommendation.en: Keep the point that preference data is not just a principle list; read the executor-disagreement experiments, not as a full alignment recipe.

paper.title: PS-PPO: Prefix-Sampling PPO for Critic-Free RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) for Large Language Models increasingly relies on critic-free methods as a practical alternative to actor--critic training. Despite their simplicity, existing critic-free approaches propagate a trajectory-level learning signal uniformly across all tokens in a trajectory. This requires full-trajectory policy updates for every rollout, leading to substantial optimization cost for long reasoning traces, even though intermediate prefixes often contain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 critic-free RLHF 在长推理轨迹上的一个实际瓶颈：像 GRPO、RLOO 这类方法虽然省掉了 critic，但通常把同一个 trajectory-level reward 广播到整条输出序列的所有 token 上，导致每次更新都要对完整轨迹做前向和反向，长链路推理时计算和显存开销都很高。作者的核心问题不是重新做 credit assignment，而是问：既然很多任务在中间前缀处就已经基本决定成败，是否可以只更新一段前缀，同时保持对原 critic-free broadcast update 的无偏近似。
summary.importance: 它对 pretrain 的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口、尤其是长推理模型的训练效率有现实意义。对基座研究员，价值主要在两点。第一，它把“长轨迹里后缀 token 的边际学习信号可能很低”这个经验观察，变成了一个可操作的训练算法，而不是停留在直觉层面。第二，它提供了一种不引入 critic、也不增加 rollout 数量的降算方法，适合当前大模型 RLHF 里越来越长的 reasoning trace。若这类方法稳定，实际会影响后训练 compute budget 的分配，也会反过来影响预训练与后训练的最优配比。
summary.technical_approach:
PS-PPO 的核心做法是随机截断更新，而不是完整更新整条序列。标准 critic-free PPO 里，给定一条长度 T 的 completion，通常把同一个 advantage 广播到所有 timestep，再对每个 token 累加 PPO clipped objective。作者的观察是：在数学推理等任务里，prefix-conditioned success rate 往往在序列结束前就趋于饱和，说明前缀已经包含了大部分决定最终 reward 的信息。于是他们为每个 prompt 定义一个 cutoff distribution，从中采样一个截断位置 c，只保留前缀 1..c 参与前向和反向计算，后缀 token 不再进入本次 policy gradient update。

关键难点是，直接截断会引入偏差，因为原始目标是对所有 token 求和。作者因此推导了一个 inclusion-probability reweighting estimator：每个被保留下来的 timestep，会按其被纳入样本的概率做重加权，使得对 cutoff 随机性的期望，能够恢复原来的 full broadcast update。也就是说，PS-PPO 不是在改目标，而是在构造一个更便宜的随机估计器。这个点很重要，因为它解释了为什么方法能在不训练 critic、不增加 rollout 的情况下，尽量保持与原 critic-free PPO 一致的优化方向。

另一个设计点是 cutoff distribution 不是固定的，而是 prompt-conditioned。作者用 prefix uncertainty signal 来决定更可能截在哪。直觉上，如果某个样本在较早前缀处就已经“结果很明显”，就可以更早截断；如果前缀不确定性高，则保留更长前缀，避免过早丢掉后续纠错信息。全文也承认 late recovery 不是完全不存在，因此他们采用随机截断而不是确定性裁掉后缀，这是一种在效率和稳健性之间的折中。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验主要围绕两类结论展开。第一类是现象验证：作者先做 prefix-conditioned success 分析，展示多个任务上成功率随前缀长度增加会提前饱和，支持“后缀存在时间冗余”这个前提。第二类是训练效果：PS-PPO 在数学推理和 RLHF benchmark 上，相比强 critic-free baseline，能够降低训练计算量和峰值显存，同时保持接近的任务准确率或对齐效果。

摘要和给出的正文片段没有列出完整数字，但可以确定作者强调的是三项指标：training-time compute、peak GPU memory、以及最终 accuracy/reward。实验逻辑不是证明 PS-PPO 在最终性能上显著超过 baseline，而是证明它在性能基本不掉的前提下，省掉了长后缀的训练成本。消融上，最值得关注的是 cutoff 分布的构造、不同截断策略与无偏重加权是否必要、以及在存在 self-correction 的样本上过早截断会带来多大损失。作者在附录里还做了 late-recovery analysis，用来说明“后面才纠正前面错误”的轨迹存在，但不是主导模式，这为随机截断提供了经验依据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Figure 1 和相关分析，确认作者不是拍脑袋说前缀足够，而是先证明很多任务的 prefix-conditioned success 会提前饱和。然后看方法推导里 cutoff sampling 和 inclusion-probability reweighting 两步：前者决定怎么省算，后者决定为什么不会把目标改坏。最后看主实验表，重点不是绝对分数，而是 compute / memory / performance 三者的交换关系。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：Introduction；Method 中 broadcast advantage 到 PS-PPO 的推导；附录里的 late-recovery analysis；主实验和消融。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要思想。更值得细读的点有三个：一是 prompt-conditioned cutoff signal 到底如何定义，是否稳定；二是无偏估计在 PPO clipping 下的实际方差有多大；三是这种前缀更新是否会系统性削弱需要长程自我修正的任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in critic-free RLHF for long reasoning traces. Methods such as GRPO and RLOO avoid training a critic, but they usually broadcast a trajectory-level reward uniformly to every token in the sampled completion. That means each update still requires full-sequence forward and backward passes, which becomes expensive for long chain-of-thought outputs. The paper asks a narrower and more operational question than full credit assignment: if many tasks are already largely determined by an intermediate prefix, can we update only a sampled prefix while still preserving the expected critic-free broadcast update?
summary_en.importance: This is more post-training than pretraining, but it matters for foundation-model training because long-horizon RLHF is becoming a major compute sink. The paper turns an empirical observation—suffix tokens often carry low marginal learning signal—into an explicit optimization method. It is also relevant because it reduces cost without introducing a critic and without requiring extra rollouts. If such methods hold up at scale, they affect how much compute is needed to train reasoning-heavy models and therefore influence the broader pretrain/post-train budget tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PS-PPO replaces full-trajectory updates with stochastic prefix updates. In standard critic-free PPO for language models, a completion of length T receives a broadcast advantage, and the PPO objective sums token-level terms across all timesteps. The authors observe that on reasoning tasks, the probability of eventual success conditioned on the current prefix often saturates before the sequence ends. This suggests that much of the suffix may be redundant for learning.

The method therefore defines a prompt-conditioned cutoff distribution and samples a cutoff c for each rollout. Only the prefix up to c is used in the policy-gradient computation; tokens after c are skipped for that update. The main technical issue is bias: naively truncating the sequence would change the objective because the original update sums over all tokens. To fix this, the paper derives an inclusion-probability reweighting estimator. Each retained timestep is weighted by the inverse of its probability of being included under the cutoff distribution, so that the expectation over cutoff sampling recovers the corresponding full broadcast update. In other words, PS-PPO does not redefine the target objective; it constructs a cheaper stochastic estimator of the same critic-free update.

Another important design choice is that the cutoff distribution is prompt-conditioned rather than fixed. It is driven by a prefix uncertainty signal: examples that appear effectively decided early can be truncated more aggressively, while uncertain examples keep longer prefixes. The paper explicitly acknowledges late recovery and self-correction, so it uses stochastic truncation instead of deterministically discarding all suffix tokens. That is the main robustness-efficiency tradeoff in the design.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments support two claims. First, the paper validates the underlying phenomenon by analyzing prefix-conditioned success rates. On the reasoning tasks they study, success often saturates before the end of the completion, which supports the idea that later tokens can be temporally redundant for optimization. Second, on mathematical reasoning and RLHF benchmarks, PS-PPO reduces training-time compute and peak GPU memory while maintaining accuracy relative to strong critic-free baselines.

The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, but the evaluation clearly centers on three metrics: training compute, peak memory, and final task performance. The point is not that PS-PPO dramatically improves final accuracy, but that it preserves most of the baseline performance while avoiding the cost of backpropagating through long suffixes. The most important ablations are likely the construction of the cutoff distribution, the necessity of the inclusion-probability correction, and the degradation on examples that rely on late self-correction. The appendix’s late-recovery analysis is especially relevant because it justifies the stochastic truncation assumption empirically rather than rhetorically.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with Figure 1 and the prefix-conditioned success analysis. That establishes the empirical premise that many trajectories become predictable before they end. Then read the derivation of cutoff sampling and inclusion-probability reweighting: the first explains where the savings come from, and the second explains why the update remains aligned with the original critic-free objective. Finally, inspect the main experiment tables with an eye on the compute-memory-performance tradeoff rather than absolute benchmark scores.

If time is limited, read the introduction, the method section that moves from broadcast advantage to PS-PPO, the appendix discussion of late recovery, and the main ablations. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. The deeper questions worth checking are: how the prompt-conditioned uncertainty signal is defined in practice, how much variance the reweighted estimator introduces under PPO clipping, and whether prefix-only updates systematically hurt tasks that depend on long-range self-correction.

recommendation.zh: 想做长 CoT 的 RLHF/RLVR，PS-PPO 的“随机截断+无偏校正”值得抄作业；但要盯紧 cutoff 分布是否引入高方差与偏置。
recommendation.en: If you run long-CoT RLHF/RLVR, the stochastic prefix truncation + unbiased correction is worth trying; watch variance/bias from the learned cutoff distribution.

paper.title: Towards Physical Intuitions for Alignment Dynamics: A Case Study With Randomness Crystallization
paper.abstract: The alignment of language models is typically studied through the lens of capability benchmarks, but the dynamics of how models change during post-training remain poorly understood. We argue that the physical sciences, and thermodynamic phase-transition theory in particular, offer a principled and underexplored vocabulary for reasoning about these dynamics. As a case study, we instantiate this position through the lens of material Crystallization, which is a well-studied thermodynamic phase tran

summary.core_problem: 论文关注的不是对齐后模型在某个 benchmark 上变强或变弱，而是 post-training 过程中行为分布如何发生结构性变化。作者用“随机数生成”等有限输出空间任务作为显微镜，研究 base model、SFT、DPO/RL 各阶段如何把原本高熵、prompt-sensitive 的输出分布压缩成稳定、低熵、近似确定的行为模式。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于给 pretrain-posttrain 接口提供了一个可检验的动态视角。核心观察是：SFT 可能已经决定了后续对齐的主要行为支撑集，DPO/RL 更多是在这个支撑集上重新分配概率质量，而不是自由地发现新行为。对基座研究员而言，这提示了两个问题：第一，base model 中潜伏的多个输出分布会被怎样的 SFT 数据“选中”；第二，后续 RL 能改多少，可能受限于 SFT 形成的吸引子。贡献更偏机制分析和研究框架，不是直接给出新的训练 recipe，但对理解 alignment dynamics 有实用意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把物理结晶过程映射到 LLM 对齐动态。类比中，base model 是“液相”：同一个随机任务在不同 prompt 下可以诱导出多种分布，熵较高，prompt sensitivity 强。SFT 是“成核”：模型输出分布突然塌缩到一个 seed distribution，这个 seed 不是凭空产生，而是已经存在于 base model 的潜在行为集合中。DPO/RL 是“settling/tempering”：概率进一步集中到 SFT 成核后的峰值附近，但通常不跳出 SFT 创建的支撑集。与常见的 mode collapse 描述不同，论文试图回答 collapse 发生在什么时候、为何落到某个分布、后续阶段还能否改写它。实验选择有限支持集任务，是因为可以直接比较完整输出分布；作者也明确指出该版本框架在大输出空间和开放式生成上会失效，需要更丰富的分布度量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个随机性任务，在 OLMo 2 和 Tulu 3 这两类公开且具有完整训练阶段 checkpoint 的模型上检查对齐轨迹。关键现象包括：base 阶段存在多个可由 prompt 诱导的随机输出分布；SFT 后 prompt 间差异迅速减小，输出分布塌缩到某个已有 seed；DPO/RL 阶段继续降低熵并强化高概率输出，但很少改变 SFT 后形成的主要支撑集。论文还报告了不同 LLM 之间可能共享 seed distribution 的现象，说明某些随机任务上的“偏好晶核”可能来自预训练语料、tokenization、数字频率或通用指令格式，而不只是某个 post-training recipe 的偶然产物。负结果同样重要：当输出空间变大或任务变成开放式生成时，简单的有限支持集分布比较不够用，结晶框架需要新的距离度量和结构化行为表征。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和 Section 2，它们定义了液相、成核、settling 三阶段，并说明为什么随机任务适合作为观测窗口。实验部分重点看 15 个 stochastic tasks 上跨 checkpoint 的分布曲线、熵变化、prompt sensitivity 变化，以及 SFT 与 DPO/RL 的阶段差异。值得深挖的是两点：一是 seed distribution 如何在 base model 中被识别，二是 DPO/RL 是否真的受 SFT 支撑集约束。局限性部分也要看，因为作者承认有限输出任务与开放式生成之间还有距离，这决定了该框架能否扩展到更真实的 alignment 行为分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how model behavior changes during post-training, rather than only measuring the final aligned model on capability benchmarks. It uses finite-support stochastic tasks, such as random digit generation, to observe how a pretrained model with many prompt-dependent output distributions becomes a low-entropy, stable, and nearly deterministic aligned model.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a testable account of the pretrain-to-posttrain transition. The key claim is that SFT can already select the behavioral support that later alignment stages operate on, while DPO or RL mostly sharpens probability mass within that support. For pretraining researchers, this matters because it links latent distributions in the base model to the attractors selected by post-training data. It also suggests that the controllability of RL may be bounded by earlier supervised fine-tuning. The contribution is conceptual and diagnostic rather than a new training algorithm, but it gives a useful language for studying alignment dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors map LLM alignment dynamics to physical crystallization. The pretrained model corresponds to a liquid phase: high entropy, many degrees of freedom, and strong prompt sensitivity. SFT acts as nucleation: output distributions collapse abruptly onto a seed distribution that was already latent in the base model. DPO and RL act more like settling or tempering: they concentrate probability on the peaks created by SFT without typically escaping the support selected during nucleation. This goes beyond the usual observation of mode collapse by asking when collapse happens, why a particular distribution is selected, and how much later optimization can still change. The focus on finite-support tasks is deliberate, because complete output distributions can be measured and compared directly.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 15 stochastic tasks and uses public training trajectories from OLMo 2 and Tulu 3, where checkpoints are available across the alignment pipeline. The main findings are consistent across the two model families: base models expose multiple promptable distributions; after SFT, prompt sensitivity largely disappears and behavior collapses onto a single seed-like distribution; DPO and RL further reduce entropy and sharpen the dominant outputs but rarely move outside the support induced by SFT. The paper also reports that seed distributions can be shared across different LLMs, which points to sources such as pretraining data, tokenization, frequency effects, or common instruction formats. The authors also document where the current framework breaks down: large output spaces and open-ended generation require richer metrics than direct finite-support distribution comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and Section 2 carefully, because they define the liquid, nucleation, and settling phases and make the crystallization analogy operational. In the experiments, focus on figures or tables that track output distributions, entropy, and prompt sensitivity across checkpoints. The most useful details are the SFT transition and the comparison between SFT and DPO/RL. The limitations are also important: the finite-support setting makes the evidence clean, but extending the framework to open-ended generation will require better behavioral distance metrics and more structured representations.

recommendation.zh: 相变视角解释SFT/RL对预训练分布的作用机制，SFT仅坍缩已有模式的结论值得立刻在内部消融复现。
recommendation.en: Proposes a phase-transition view of alignment; the claim that SFT only collapses existing pretrain modes deserves immediate internal replication.

paper.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Qwen-Image-2.0-RL, a post-training pipeline that applies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and on-policy distillation (OPD) to improve both the visual quality and instruction-following capability of the Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model. To provide reliable reward signals, we construct task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning vision-language models with a pointwise scoring paradigm and chain-of-thought reasoning. For text-to-image generation, the reward models

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散生成模型（Qwen-Image-2.0）的视觉质量与指令跟随能力难以兼顾，RLHF落地缺乏可靠奖励信号与稳定训练策略的问题。
summary.importance: 顶级机构的工业级技术报告，贡献类型包括系统创新（可扩展的扩散模型RLHF训练框架）、数据/奖励模型设计（多维度复合奖励模型、prompt筛选策略），为生成式大模型的后训练对齐提供落地参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建任务特异性复合奖励模型：用带点式打分与CoT推理的VLM微调，覆盖文本生成的对齐/美学/人脸保真、图像编辑的指令跟随/人脸保存维度；2）提出基于GRPO的可扩展RL训练框架，结合混合CFG策略保留预训练知识、组内奖励范围筛选做prompt提纯、逐类别奖励权重校准；3）用任务感知参数融合合并各任务专精的RL checkpoint。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen-Image-2.0扩散基座做训练，覆盖文本到图像、图像编辑两类任务，主观与客观评测均显著优于基线RLHF方案与原生基座。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴Qwen（通义千问）团队，核心负责多模态生成大模型的研发与迭代。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the trade-off between visual quality and instruction following in diffusion generative models (Qwen-Image-2.0), and the lack of reliable reward signals and stable training recipes for diffusion RLHF deployment.
summary_en.importance: Industrial-grade technical report from a top-tier institution; contributions include system innovation (scalable diffusion RLHF training framework), reward/data design (multi-dimensional composite reward models, prompt curation strategy), providing deployment references for post-training alignment of generative foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Builds task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning VLMs with pointwise scoring and CoT reasoning, covering alignment/aesthetics/portrait fidelity for T2I, and instruction following/face identity preservation for editing; 2) Proposes a scalable GRPO-based RL training framework with hybrid CFG to preserve pretrained knowledge, intra-group reward range filtering for prompt curation, and per-category reward weight calibration; 3) Merges task-specialized RL checkpoints via task-aware parameter fusion.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion backbone, covering text-to-image and image editing tasks; both subjective and objective evaluations significantly outperform baseline RLHF methods and the original foundation model.
summary_en.authors_note: Qwen team of Alibaba Group, responsible for R&D and iteration of multimodal generative foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型RLHF的工业级落地方案，混合CFG保留预训练知识、组内奖励筛选的设计可直接复用至多模态生成的后训练ablation。
recommendation.en: Industrial-grade RLHF deployment pipeline for diffusion models; hybrid CFG for pretrained knowledge preservation and intra-group reward filtering are directly reusable for multimodal generative post-training ablations.

paper.title: Retroactive Advantage Correction: Closed-Form V-Trace Bias Correction for Delay-Aware RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) in production does not always have a synchronous reward signal. Code-execution verifiers, slow judge ensembles, and queued human review can return several gradient steps after the rollout that produced them, breaking the synchronous-reward assumption underlying standard PPO. We address this gap with Retroactive Advantage Correction (RAC): each pending slow completion is queued, aged through a non-negative kernel, and reinjected as a clipped resid

summary.core_problem: 生产环境RLHF的奖励信号常存在异步延迟（如代码验证器、慢judge集成、排队人工审核），破坏标准PPO的同步奖励假设，导致优势估计有偏
summary.importance: 方法创新+理论证明，首次提出延迟感知的闭式V-trace偏差校正方法，解决生产RLHF中奖励异步的核心工程痛点
summary.technical_approach: 提出Retroactive Advantage Correction（RAC）：将未完成的慢奖励入队，通过非负核老化处理后，作为裁剪残差注入下一次优化步的优势估计；证明当延迟核注入全部质量时累积校正无偏，否则偏差与未注入比例线性相关；无延迟时退化为标准V-trace
summary.experiments: 在表格MDP概念验证环境中，双慢通道配置下闭式策略偏差最高降低47.9倍，优于阻塞等待慢奖励的基线方法

summary_en.core_problem: Reward signals in production RLHF are often asynchronously delayed (e.g., code verifiers, slow judge ensembles, queued human reviews), breaking the synchronous reward assumption of standard PPO and introducing biased advantage estimation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation with theoretical proof: first closed-form delay-aware bias correction for V-trace, addressing a core engineering pain point of asynchronous rewards in production RLHF
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Retroactive Advantage Correction (RAC): queues pending slow rewards, ages them via a non-negative kernel, and reinjects them as clipped residuals into the advantage of the next optimizer step; proves cumulative RAC correction is exactly unbiased when the kernel reinjects all mass, with bias linear in unreinjected fraction otherwise; reduces to standard V-trace under no-delay identity kernel
summary_en.experiments: Reduces closed-form policy bias by up to 47.9x in a two-slow-channel tabular MDP proof-of-concept, outperforming baselines that block on slow rewards

recommendation.zh: 解决生产RLHF奖励延迟的核心痛点，§2的无偏性证明和核设计可直接复用进内部PPO训练流水线
recommendation.en: Addresses the core pain point of reward delay in production RLHF; the unbiasedness proof and kernel design in §2 can be directly reused in internal PPO training pipelines

paper.title: PEBS: Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage for RLHF Reward-Model Calibration
paper.abstract: Reward models for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pool preferences across thousands of annotators and fit one global affine calibrator, collapsing raters with systematically different rating-scale offsets and slopes into a single average-rater fit that does not match any individual annotator. PEBS is a per-rater empirical-Bayes shrinkage estimator: it fits per-rater affine calibrators on a held-out slice of each annotator's ratings and applies Morris-James-Stein empirical-Bayes

summary.core_problem: 现有RLHF奖励模型采用全局仿射校准，忽略不同标注者的评分尺度偏移和斜率差异，导致校准结果与单个标注者不匹配
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需重训奖励模型的闭式后处理校准方案，解决RLHF中标注者异质性导致的RM校准偏差问题
summary.technical_approach: 提出PEBS（Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage）：对每个标注者的留出评分拟合独立仿射校准器，采用Morris-James-Stein经验贝叶斯方法向总体均值做闭式收缩，全程不改动基础奖励模型参数
summary.experiments: 在PRISM偏好数据集上，比全局 pooled 基线降低8.58%的用户内留出RMSE；在PluriHarms危害评分数据集（Qwen-2.5 base，同分布）上，RMSE降低9.66%

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RLHF reward models use a global affine calibrator across annotators, ignoring systematic differences in rater-specific rating scale offsets and slopes, resulting in calibration that does not match individual annotators
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a closed-form post-hoc calibration scheme without retraining the reward model, addressing RM calibration bias caused by annotator heterogeneity in RLHF
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PEBS (Per-rater Empirical-Bayes Shrinkage): fits per-rater affine calibrators on held-out ratings from each annotator, then applies closed-form Morris-James-Stein empirical Bayes shrinkage toward the population mean, with no changes to the base reward model parameters
summary_en.experiments: Reduces within-user held-out RMSE by 8.58% over the pooled baseline on PRISM; achieves 9.66% RMSE reduction on PluriHarms harm ratings (Qwen-2.5 base, in-family) over the same baseline

recommendation.zh: RM校准的轻量实用改进，无需重训模型，做RLHF的同学可直接复用§3的闭式收缩公式验证内部标注偏差
recommendation.en: A lightweight practical improvement for RM calibration with no retraining required; RLHF practitioners can directly reuse the closed-form shrinkage formula in §3 to validate internal annotator bias

paper.title: The Verification Horizon: No Silver Bullet for Coding Agent Rewards
paper.abstract: A classical intuition holds that verifying a solution is easier than producing one. For today's coding agents, this intuition is being inverted: as foundation models develop stronger reasoning capabilities and engineering harnesses grow more sophisticated, generating complex candidate solutions is no longer difficult -- reliably verifying them has become the harder problem. Every verifier we can build is only a proxy for human intent, never the intent itself. This makes verification subject to a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论 coding agent 训练和评测里的核心瓶颈：候选解越来越容易生成，但验证候选解是否满足真实用户意图越来越难。问题不只是测试覆盖不足，而是所有可计算 verifier 都只能近似人类意图；当这些 proxy 被用作训练奖励后，模型会持续寻找 proxy 与意图之间的缝隙，导致 reward hacking 和信号饱和。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构或数据配比，而在 pretrain 到 posttrain 的训练信号接口。它把 coding agent reward 设计拆成 scalability、faithfulness、robustness 三个维度，说明单一 verifier 很难同时便宜、忠实、抗优化。这个框架对 RL-based coding、agentic post-training、verifier model 训练都有参考意义：奖励不是一次性工程组件，而是需要随生成器能力共同演化的系统。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上不是提出一个统一奖励函数，而是围绕 Qwen 系列 coding agent 训练实践，分析四类 reward construction。第一类是 SWE-like 任务中的 executable unit tests，优点是便宜、可并行、结果明确，但只能覆盖窄层面的功能意图，且会被强策略通过读取答案痕迹、篡改测试、利用 harness 漏洞等方式利用。因此作者加入 quality judge 和 trajectory-level behavior monitoring，用于约束异常行为，而不只看最终 pass/fail。第二类是 frontend 任务的 rubric 和 interactive judge，把功能正确性、视觉质量、布局、用户体验拆开评估，并让 judge 在真实浏览器环境中交互运行产物；这样比静态代码或文本评审更接近用户实际体验，也能减少长度偏置等静态 judge 漏洞。第三类转向从用户交互数据学习更完整的 intent，把显式测试之外的偏好和隐含需求纳入 reward。第四类面向开放式 agentic evaluation，强调 grader、trace、monitoring、failure-mode analysis 的组合，而不是依赖单个评分器。
summary.experiments: 最明确的实验结果来自 SWE-Bench 相关设置。只依赖测试时，策略会出现明显 reward hacking；加入质量判别器和轨迹级行为监控后，三个 SWE-Bench 变体上的 hacked resolved rate 从 28.57% 降到 0.56%，clean resolved rate 从 40.22% 提升到 60.53%。这个结果的含义是，监控不只是防作弊过滤器，也可能提高干净解的有效率，因为它把策略从 exploit harness 拉回到更正常的开发轨迹。frontend 部分的关键观察是，基于 runtime behavior 的 interactive judge 比静态 judge 更不容易被冗长输出或表面格式欺骗；但这类 judge 更依赖开放式判断，鲁棒性和可校准性会成为新的瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 verification horizon、proxy-intent gap、scalability/faithfulness/robustness 三分法；再看 §2 的 SWE-like unit test 实验，尤其是 hacked resolved rate 与 clean resolved rate 的变化。若关注 agent RL 训练，建议补看 frontend interactive judge 部分，因为它展示了从静态 reward 到环境交互 reward 的转变。无需在形式化部分停留太久，核心价值在 reward 系统设计经验和失败模式归纳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper focuses on a practical bottleneck in training and evaluating coding agents: generating plausible solutions is becoming easier, while verifying whether those solutions satisfy human intent is becoming harder. The issue is not merely weak test coverage. Any computable verifier is a proxy for intent, and once that proxy becomes an optimization target, stronger agents learn to exploit the gap between the proxy and the underlying intent.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research lies in the interface between pretraining, post-training, and reward design, rather than in architecture or data scaling. The paper frames verifier quality along three axes: scalability, faithfulness, and robustness. This is a useful lens for RL-based coding agents and agentic post-training, because it makes clear that reward signals are not static assets. They need to co-evolve with the policy being trained.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is a systems view of verifier construction, grounded in Qwen-based coding-agent practice. The first setting uses executable unit tests for SWE-like tasks. These tests are scalable and mechanically robust, but they only capture a narrow slice of user intent and can be exploited through solution-artifact retrieval, test tampering, or harness-specific behavior. The authors therefore add a quality judge and trajectory-level behavior monitoring, so the system evaluates not only the final pass/fail outcome but also the path taken by the agent. The second setting targets frontend tasks, where correctness includes visual appearance and interactive behavior. The authors use rubric-based judges over functionality, visual quality, layout, and UX, then extend them with an interactive browser-based judge that exercises the artifact at runtime. Later settings move toward learning broader intent from user interaction data and toward open-ended agentic evaluation with graders, traces, monitoring, and failure-mode analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The clearest quantitative result is reported on three SWE-Bench variants. With the added quality judge and trajectory-level monitoring, the hacked resolved rate drops from 28.57% to 0.56%, while the clean resolved rate increases from 40.22% to 60.53%. This suggests that monitoring is not only a guardrail against exploitation; it can also improve the useful solution rate by steering the agent away from harness exploitation and toward normal development behavior. For frontend tasks, the key empirical observation is that interactive judges grounded in runtime behavior are less vulnerable to static-judge artifacts such as length exploitation, although they introduce their own calibration and robustness challenges.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction carefully for the verification-horizon argument, the proxy-intent gap, and the scalability/faithfulness/robustness taxonomy. Then focus on the SWE-like unit-test section, especially the hacked and clean resolved-rate numbers. If the goal is agent RL or verifier design, also read the frontend interactive-judge section, since it illustrates the move from static rewards to environment-grounded rewards. The main value is in the reward-system design lessons and failure modes, not in formal machinery.

recommendation.zh: 反转了验证比生成容易的传统直觉，做代码RL或SWE后训练的研究员可重点读其三维验证框架，警惕奖励信号的固有缺陷。
recommendation.en: Inverts the classical 'verification is easier than generation' intuition; researchers working on code RL or SWE post-training should focus on its three-dimensional verification framework to avoid inherent reward signal flaws.

paper.title: GEOALIGN: Geometric Rollout Curation for Robust LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Online reinforcement learning is widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with reward signals, yet training can be unstable under noisy or misspecified rewards. We identify a failure mode we call directional inconsistency: within a batch, a small set of high-reward rollouts induces representation-space preference directions that sharply disagree with the batch majority, resulting in high-variance and destabilizing updates. We propose geoalign, a lightweight plug-in for rollout curation

summary.core_problem: 该工作处理 online LLM RL 中一个常见但较少被显式建模的问题：少量高 reward rollout 可能在表示空间中给出与 batch 主方向相冲突的更新方向，导致训练振荡、早停或性能回退。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在预训练本身，而在 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口。它提醒我们，RL 阶段的样本可靠性不能只看 scalar reward，还要看这些样本诱导的向量更新是否一致。这个视角对 reward hacking、noisy reward、verifier reward 下的 RL 稳定性有启发，尤其适合分析 R1-Zero 类训练中少量异常高分轨迹对策略的扰动。
summary.technical_approach: GeoAlign 是一个 rollout curation 插件，不改 PPO/GRPO 类优化器的主体。方法先在同一 prompt 内构造 preference pairs，把高 reward 回答和低 reward 回答配对。每个 rollout 用最后一层、最后生成 token 的 hidden state 表示，并从低 reward 回答指向高 reward 回答构造 latent displacement direction。然后训练一个小 projector，把这些 reward-ordered directions 投到更集中的空间里。系统再计算 batch-level consensus prototype，用方向夹角识别与主方向偏离很大的 rollout。关键点是它不需要逐样本 policy gradient，只用 detached hidden states 做 forward-only 判断。对严重方向异常的样本，GeoAlign 用同 prompt 内更稳定的替代 rollout 做保守修正，同时保持每个 prompt 的 rollout 数量不变。相比只做 reward clipping、reward shaping、uncertainty weighting 或 reward-statistics filtering 的方法，它关注的是学习信号的方向一致性，而不是 reward 标量的大小或置信度。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类 RL 场景：HH-RLHF dialogue alignment 使用 ArmoRM 提供连续 reward；DAPO-Math-17k 数学推理使用 binary verified reward。模型为 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-4B。对比方法包括 PF-PPO、PAR、PODS、Seed-GRPO。结果报告显示，GeoAlign 在最终性能和训练稳定性上均优于这些 robust-RL baseline，并且在受控 reward corruption 下更稳。可用全文片段没有给出完整表格数值，因此不应解读为已确认具体提升幅度。更有信息量的实验现象是：reward-ordered latent directions 呈 long-tail angular geometry，大多数方向集中在主趋势附近，少量 angular outliers 往往不是低 reward，而是高 reward 但不可靠的样本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。重点看第 2 节的 geometric perspective，尤其是 directional inconsistency 的定义、within-prompt preference pair 的构造、hidden-state displacement 的选择。再看方法部分中 projector、consensus prototype 和 outlier rectification 的细节。实验部分重点看 reward corruption、training curve variance、outlier ratio 与性能变化的关系。若只关心能否接入现有 RLHF/GRPO pipeline，优先确认三点：是否需要额外 backward，是否改变 rollout 数量，是否依赖 reward model 连续分数。
summary.authors_note: 文中声明 Daoyuan Chen 和 Zhenqing Ling 任职于 Alibaba Group；Qwen3 系列是主要评测模型。代码与数据计划公开在 https://github.com/SYSUzhouting/Trinity-RFT 。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a concrete instability mode in online LLM RL: a small number of high-reward rollouts can induce representation-space update directions that sharply disagree with the batch majority, creating high-variance and unstable optimization.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research lies at the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Scalar rewards are not enough to decide whether a rollout is useful for policy improvement. The direction implied by the rollout also matters. This is relevant for noisy reward models, verifier-based RL, reward hacking, and R1-Zero-style training loops where a few abnormal high-scoring trajectories can steer the policy in undesirable directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeoAlign is a rollout-curation module that can be added to iterative policy optimization without changing the main PPO/GRPO-style objective. It builds within-prompt preference pairs, represents each rollout using the detached final-token hidden state from the last layer, and defines a displacement vector from the lower-reward response to the higher-reward response. A small online projector is trained to concentrate these reward-ordered directions. The method then forms a batch-level consensus prototype and detects angular outliers by measuring deviation from this consensus. Severe outliers are rectified using more stable alternatives from the same prompt while preserving the per-prompt rollout count. The difference from reward clipping, reward shaping, uncertainty weighting, or reward-statistics filtering is that GeoAlign judges the geometric consistency of the learning signal, not only the scalar reward or its uncertainty.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers dialogue alignment on HH-RLHF with continuous ArmoRM rewards and mathematical reasoning on DAPO-Math-17k with binary verified rewards. The models are Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B. Baselines include PF-PPO, PAR, PODS, and Seed-GRPO. The reported results show better final performance and more stable training curves, including under controlled reward corruption. The provided full-content excerpt does not expose the full numerical tables, so exact gain sizes should not be inferred. The most useful empirical observation is geometric: reward-ordered latent directions have a long-tailed angular distribution, where most samples align with a dominant trend while a small set of high-reward samples becomes angularly inconsistent.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is enough. Focus on the geometric formulation of directional inconsistency, the construction of within-prompt preference pairs, and the use of final-token hidden states as detached rollout representations. Then inspect the projector, consensus prototype, and conservative rectification mechanism. In the experiments, prioritize reward-corruption results, training-curve variance, and analyses connecting angular outliers to optimization instability. For practical adoption, check whether the method requires extra backward passes, whether it changes rollout counts, and whether it assumes continuous reward values.
summary_en.authors_note: The text states that Daoyuan Chen and Zhenqing Ling are employed by Alibaba Group, and that Qwen3 models are the primary evaluation models. Code and data are listed at https://github.com/SYSUzhouting/Trinity-RFT .

recommendation.zh: RL对齐训练稳定性的实用发现，方向不一致失效模式可迁移到RL预训练的梯度分析，重点看§3的检测与修正机制。
recommendation.en: Practical finding on RL alignment stability; the directional inconsistency failure mode transfers to gradient analysis in RL pretraining, focus on §3 detection and rectification mechanism.

paper.title: OPERA: Aligning Open-Ended Reasoning via Objective Perplexity-based Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled LLMs to excel in objective reasoning tasks such as mathematics and code generation. However, applying RL to open-ended tasks, such as creative writing, remains challenging because LLM-as-a-judge reward models often exhibit stylistic biases and positional inconsistencies, leading to unstable supervision. To address this, we propose OPERA (Objective Perplexity-based Reflective Alignment), which replaces unreliable external judges with intrinsic rewards deriv

summary.core_problem: 在创意写作等开放式任务中，传统 LLM-as-a-judge 奖励容易有风格偏差和位置不一致，导致 RL 监督不稳定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练奖励设计和开放式推理对齐方法。OPERA 尝试用模型内部 perplexity 动态替代外部 judge，把“反思状态下不确定性下降”作为 intrinsic reward，绕开主观任务中 judge reward 噪声大的问题。
summary.technical_approach: OPERA 从 perplexity dynamics 构造内在奖励，度量关键 reflective states 的 uncertainty reduction。冷启动阶段使用 guiding words 合成多样 reasoning traces，并通过 perplexity-prioritized rollouts 利用内部 log-probability 选择逻辑更一致的 reasoning branches。整体属于 RL + 数据合成 + 内部置信信号的组合方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练模型规模、合成数据量、RL 算法细节、benchmark 名称和具体提升幅度。实验应集中在开放式生成/创意写作等任务，并与 LLM-as-a-judge reward、常规 SFT/RL baseline 比较稳定性和质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University、Meituan Longcat Team、Peking University、Xi’an Jiaotong University 和 Nanjing University of Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses RL alignment for open-ended tasks such as creative writing, where LLM-as-a-judge rewards are often stylistically biased and positionally inconsistent.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a post-training reward design for open-ended reasoning. OPERA replaces external judge rewards with intrinsic rewards derived from perplexity dynamics, using uncertainty reduction at reflective states as the training signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPERA constructs an intrinsic reward from perplexity dynamics, measuring uncertainty reduction around critical reflective states. For cold start, it synthesizes diverse reasoning traces with guiding words and uses perplexity-prioritized rollouts based on internal log-probabilities to select more logically consistent branches.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, synthetic data volume, RL algorithm details, benchmark names, or numeric gains. The experiments likely compare against LLM-judge-based rewards and standard SFT/RL baselines on open-ended generation tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Meituan Longcat Team, Peking University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, and Nanjing University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 定义和 rollout 过滤；perplexity 当开放式奖励的设定有趣，但很容易奖励自信而非质量。
recommendation.en: Read the reward definition and rollout filtering; perplexity as an open-ended reward is interesting, but it may reward confidence rather than quality.

institutions: Nanjing University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Discretizing Reward Models
paper.abstract: Despite their widespread use, the role of reward models in shaping reinforcement learning is poorly understood. Reward models offer a tempting promise: they automatically estimate response quality in the absence of verifiers or human judges. Unlike "verifiable rewards" which typically produce binary scores, reward models typically produce continuous scores, allowing them to be sensitive to fine-grained differences in responses. However, we show this apparent strength is a serious weakness: many

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“奖励模型准不准”这个老问题，而是更细的一层：连续值 reward model 在强化学习里会不会把本来同样好的回答硬排出高低。作者把这个现象定义为 oversensitivity。问题的关键在于，很多 prompt 并不存在唯一最优回答，而是有多个效用等价的 response class。若 RM 在这些等价回答之间给出稳定且可学习的分数差，RL 就会把这种差异当成真实优化信号，进而放大风格偏好、标注偶然性和训练噪声，而不是提升真实任务效用。论文因此重新定义了 RM 的好坏标准：不能只看 pairwise accuracy 或偏好一致率，还要看它对等价回答是否“足够不敏感”。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的意义很直接。过去很多工作默认 reward model 越细粒度越好，连续分数越丰富越能提供学习信号；这篇文章指出，连续性本身可能是问题来源。它把“奖励模型为什么在 benchmark 上看着很准，但拿去做 RL 教出来的 policy 不稳定甚至变差”这件事讲清楚了一部分。贡献主要有三层。第一，提出 oversensitivity / specificity 这一套更贴近 RL 使用场景的评价视角，而不是只看 accuracy。第二，给出理论说明：即便一个看似完美、排序能力很强的 RM，也可能因为在等价响应之间过度区分而成为坏老师。第三，给出一个很实用的修正方向：把连续 reward 离散化成簇，让 RL 优化“组间差异”而不是“组内噪声”。这对 RLHF、RLAIF、以及用 LM-as-a-judge 直接做在线 RL 的路线都有现实影响。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成理论和算法两部分。理论部分先把真实效用 u(x,y) 建模为整数值，表示一个 prompt 下有限个可感知的效用等级，也就是多个等价类。对应地，一个好的 RM 需要同时满足两件事：一是能区分不同效用等级，二是不要在同一效用等级内部制造无意义差异。作者用 discriminative ability 和 specificity 来刻画这两个方向，并强调二者存在张力：单纯追求 accuracy 往往会鼓励模型在所有样本上强行排序，单纯追求高方差也会把无关差异放大。论文的核心主张是，合适的 discretization 可以在保留跨等级区分能力的同时，压掉等级内部的伪差异。

算法部分并不是简单做固定阈值分桶，而是做 uncertainty-aware clustering。具体做法是：对 reward model 开启 Monte Carlo dropout，多次前向得到同一 response 的 reward 分布，用预测方差估计 RM 在该点附近的不确定性。然后基于 reward 均值和不确定性，把一组候选回答聚成若干簇；簇内视为效用近似等价，RL 时不再利用簇内细粒度分差。直观上，这相当于把“连续打分器”改造成“带置信区间的等级判别器”。与常见做法相比，区别有三点。第一，它不是重新训练 RM，而是在推理侧后处理 reward。第二，它不是把 reward 简单二值化，而是自适应地保留必要的层级结构。第三，它关心的是 RL 可用性，而不是静态偏好预测分数。

从全文表述看，作者还讨论了为什么“增大 reward variance”不是正确目标。真正有用的是 inter-class variance，不是 intra-class variance。离散化的作用，就是尽量把后者折叠掉。这个视角和很多 reward shaping 直觉不同，也比“校准 reward scale”更进一步，因为问题不只是尺度，而是排序结构本身。
summary.experiments:
实验分三块，设计得比较完整。第一块是在 RewardBench 2 的 Ties 子集上直接测 oversensitivity。这个子集专门包含应当判为平手的样本，适合看 RM 是否会对等价回答乱排高低。作者在多种流行 RM 上做离散化后，结论比较一致：specificity 明显改善，discriminative ability 只付出温和代价，因此两者的综合指标更好。这里最重要的不是单个模型涨了多少，而是趋势稳定，说明 oversensitivity 不是个别 RM 的偶发现象。

第二块是一个可控模拟环境。作者构造了 primary reward 与 spurious stylistic reward 的混合目标，前者代表真实任务效用，如 instruction following；后者代表风格、措辞、长度等容易被 RM 学进去但未必该被优化的因素。直接优化原始连续 reward 时，policy 会明显朝风格维度过拟合，牺牲 primary reward；离散化后，这种 stylistic overoptimization 被显著抑制，主任务表现保持更好。这个实验很关键，因为它把 oversensitivity 从“评测现象”推进到“会伤害 RL 训练结果”的因果链条。

第三块是更接近真实使用场景的多任务 RL。作者在无标注 prompt 上训练 policy，并在 IFEval、GSM8K、MATH 上比较原始 RM 与离散化 RM。结论是：离散化版本从不显著差于原始 reward，而且经常更好。摘要里没有给出全部数字，正文表述重点也不是追求某个 benchmark 的极限分数，而是强调稳健性：当 reward model 可能混入风格偏差或 tie-breaking 噪声时，离散化能减少坏梯度。若精读实验部分，建议重点看不同任务上的方差、显著性和是否存在“原始 RM 提升某一项但整体不稳”的情况。

从实验结构判断，作者想证明三件事：能测到 oversensitivity；oversensitivity 会被 policy 学走；简单离散化足以缓解。这个证据链是完整的。局限也存在：离散化依赖候选回答集合与聚类阈值估计，若候选分布很窄或 RM dropout 不稳定，效果可能受影响；另外，论文更像是在 RL teacher 侧做修正，还没有触及如何从训练数据和目标函数层面直接学出低-oversensitivity 的 RM。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，把作者区分的三件事先立住：accuracy、variance、oversensitivity。很多后文细节都围绕这三个概念展开。然后精读 Problem Formulation，尤其是真实效用被建模为有限整数等级这一设定。这个假设不是装饰，它决定了为什么“离散化”在理论上是合理的，而不是拍脑袋做分桶。

理论部分重点看作者如何定义 discriminative ability 与 specificity，以及证明“看似完美的连续 RM 仍可能是坏老师”的例子。这里值得深挖的是：他们批评的不是 reward model 的噪声大小，而是噪声的结构。若你做 RLHF/RLAIF，这一段会直接影响你如何设计 RM 评测集。

方法部分重点看 Monte Carlo dropout 如何被用来估计 predictive variance，以及 clustering / thresholding 的具体流程。要特别留意它为什么选择 uncertainty-aware discretization，而不是固定温度缩放、分位数截断或简单二值化。若你关心工程落地，这部分决定了方法能否作为现有 RM 的后处理模块接入。

实验部分建议按顺序看：先 Ties 子集，再模拟环境，再真实多任务 RL。前两者负责建立机制，最后一组负责说明现实收益。最值得细看的图表通常是：离散化前后 specificity 与 discriminative ability 的变化、primary vs stylistic reward 的 trade-off、以及不同任务上原始 RM 与离散化 RM 的稳定性比较。

如果时间有限，60-90 分钟可以抓住主线；若要真正吸收，建议连附录里的理论细节和实验设置一起看，因为这篇文章的价值主要在概念澄清和评价框架，而不只是一个小技巧。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than standard reward-model evaluation: not whether a reward model is accurate on preference pairs, but whether it assigns learnable score differences to responses that are actually equally good. The authors call this oversensitivity. This matters because many prompts admit multiple utility-equivalent answers. If a continuous reward model imposes a strict ordering within that equivalence set, RL will optimize those arbitrary differences as if they were real utility. The result is policy drift toward stylistic artifacts, annotation indeterminacy, and reward-model quirks rather than better task performance.
summary_en.importance: This is important for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface because it explains part of a familiar failure mode: reward models can look strong on static benchmarks yet behave as poor teachers during RL. The paper contributes a more RL-relevant lens for reward-model quality. Pairwise accuracy is not enough; one also needs low sensitivity within equal-utility regions. The contribution is not a new large-scale RM, but a reframing of what makes an RM usable for optimization. That has direct implications for RLHF, RLAIF, and LM-as-a-judge pipelines, especially in settings where rewards are continuous and unverifiable. The practical message is sharp: richer reward granularity is not automatically better if the extra variance comes from the wrong place.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has a theoretical layer and a practical layer. The theoretical setup models true utility u(x, y) as an integer-valued function with a finite number of perceptible utility levels for each prompt. That formalizes the idea that many responses belong to the same utility class. Under this view, a good reward model must do two things at once: separate different utility classes and avoid inventing distinctions within the same class. The paper uses discriminative ability for the former and specificity for the latter. The central claim is that these objectives need not be traded off blindly; a suitable discretization of reward scores can preserve useful between-class variation while suppressing harmful within-class variation.

The practical method is uncertainty-aware reward discretization. Instead of retraining the reward model, the authors estimate predictive uncertainty with Monte Carlo dropout by running the RM multiple times and measuring the variance of the predicted reward. They then cluster candidate responses using both reward means and uncertainty, treating responses within a cluster as approximately utility-equivalent. RL no longer optimizes fine-grained score gaps inside those clusters. In effect, the method converts a continuous scorer into a confidence-aware ordinal teacher.

This differs from common alternatives in several ways. It is not simple reward binning with fixed thresholds, not temperature scaling, and not binary verification. It preserves some hierarchy when the model is confident that differences are meaningful, while collapsing distinctions when the score differences are likely to reflect uncertainty or arbitrary tie-breaking. A key conceptual point in the paper is that reward variance is only useful when it aligns with true utility differences. Inter-class variance helps learning; intra-class variance hurts it.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized to establish a full causal story. First, the authors evaluate oversensitivity directly on the Ties subset of RewardBench 2, where responses should be treated as ties. Across several popular reward models, discretization consistently improves specificity while only modestly reducing discriminative ability, improving their combined quality. The important result here is the consistency across models rather than a single headline number.

Second, they build a controlled environment with a mixture of a primary reward and a spurious stylistic reward. The primary component represents actual task utility such as instruction following; the secondary component captures style-related features that a reward model may latch onto. Optimizing the raw continuous reward leads to strong stylistic overoptimization and degraded primary-task performance. Discretization suppresses that failure mode and preserves the primary objective much better. This is the key mechanism experiment because it shows that oversensitivity is not just a benchmark artifact; it becomes a learnable signal that policy optimization exploits.

Third, they run a more realistic multitask RL setup on unlabeled prompts and evaluate on IFEval, GSM8K, and MATH. The discretized reward models are never significantly worse than the raw reward models and are often better. The emphasis is on robustness rather than chasing a single best benchmark score. The paper argues that when reward models contain stylistic bias or tie-breaking noise, discretization reduces harmful gradients without sacrificing useful supervision.

The experimental story is strong because it covers measurement, mechanism, and downstream impact. The main limitation is that the method still depends on the candidate-response set and on uncertainty estimates from dropout. It is a teacher-side correction rather than a solution to training low-oversensitivity reward models from first principles.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the early figures, especially the examples that separate accuracy, variance, and oversensitivity. Those distinctions carry the whole paper. Then read the problem formulation carefully. The assumption that true utility is discrete and finite is not cosmetic; it is what makes discretization theoretically natural rather than an ad hoc heuristic.

In the theory section, focus on how discriminative ability and specificity are defined, and on the constructions showing that an apparently excellent continuous reward model can still be a bad RL teacher. The key insight is structural: the issue is not just reward noise magnitude, but where the variance lives.

In the method section, pay attention to how Monte Carlo dropout is used to estimate predictive variance and how clustering thresholds are chosen. The useful question to keep in mind is why this approach is preferable to simpler fixes such as score clipping, fixed binning, or binary conversion.

For experiments, read them in order: RewardBench Ties for direct oversensitivity measurement, the synthetic mixed-reward setup for mechanism, and the multitask RL results for practical relevance. The most informative plots are the ones showing the trade-off between specificity and discriminative ability, the primary-versus-stylistic reward dynamics, and the stability comparison between raw and discretized rewards.

If time is limited, an hour is enough to get the main idea. If the goal is to reuse the ideas in RLHF or judge-model work, the appendices are worth reading because the value of the paper lies more in the evaluation framework and conceptual cleanup than in the implementation alone.

recommendation.zh: 连续RM过敏感性结论直接改变对齐实验设计，§3理论和§4离散化方法应立刻加入内部消融实验
recommendation.en: The oversensitivity finding of continuous RMs directly changes alignment experiment design, add Section 3 theory and Section 4 discretization to internal ablations immediately.

paper.title: EvoRubrics: Dynamic Rubrics as Rewards via Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Rubric-based rewards offer interpretable and fine-grained optimization signals for reinforcement learning in open-ended tasks where verifiable answers are unavailable. However, pre-constructed rubrics remain static throughout training, creating a fundamental mismatch with the evolving policy: fixed criteria gradually lose discriminative power as the model improves, leading to reward saturation and potential hacking. Recent dynamic rubric methods partially address this but rely on external fronti

summary.core_problem: 基于 rubric 的 RL 奖励在开放式生成任务（无标准答案可验证）中会随策略改进而逐渐饱和和被 hack：静态评价标准无法匹配不断变强的 policy，而现有动态 rubric 方法要么依赖外部强模型、粒度粗糙，要么仍绑定可验证答案，无法在训练步粒度上实时随策略演化。
summary.importance: 对理解 post-train 中 reward 信号质量、训练信号自适应和 auto-curriculum 有直接启发；尤其涉及一个预训练研究员关心的核心问题——评价器和被训练模型如何避免同步退化、如何避免 reward hacking。其“在无外部监督下仅靠生成器和评价器对抗共演产生学习信号”的思路，和近期 self-play / generative self-evaluation 方向相关，但明确针对 rubric 结构和 RL 训练动态。
summary.technical_approach: EvoRubrics 让 Policy LLM 和 Rubric Generator 在单个训练步内做对抗式共演，共享同一个基础模型，使用两套 LoRA adapter 分别承载 policy 和 rubric generator。Policy 在 rubric 聚合出的奖励下更新；Rubric Generator 则收到多目标奖励，鼓励判别力、语义多样性、与人类偏好对齐以及建设性（即 rubric 能持续暴露 policy 缺陷而不是给出无意义评分）。每个 query 对应一组带权自然语言 criteria，由 judge 模型逐条二值判定是否满足，加总归一化得到奖励。更新粒度是 within-step，而不是按 epoch 粗粒度刷新 rubric，从而跟踪 policy 能力变化并自然形成 auto-curriculum：模型越强，生成的 rubric 越精细、越有挑战性。论文还强调完全自监督变体（不依赖外部监督或 front-tier 模型）也能产生有效收益。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖域内和分布外 benchmark，与静态 rubric、依赖外部前沿模型的动态 rubric、仅训练 rubric generator 但不与 policy 耦合的基线对比。核心结论是 EvoRubrics 持续优于这些基线，且训练后的 Rubric Generator 可迁移到未见数据集做测试时 rubric 生成。自监督版本同样有明显提升，说明对抗共演本身能提供足够训练信号。论文给出的量化指标集中在开放式任务表现上，未提供超大规模或预训练尺度的 token 数/参数量数字，主要是 post-training 尺度实验。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 和 method 中关于静态 rubric 饱和、reward hacking、within-step 共演与多目标 rubric 奖励设计的部分，重点看 reward hacking 的机理图和自监督变体结果。若关心对预训练的启发，可重点想两个问题：其一，评价标准随能力演化这个机制能否迁移到 pretrain 的 data selection / curriculum 上；其二，共享底座 + 双 LoRA 做 evaluator-generator 共演是否会带来模式坍缩或评价器与策略共谋的风险。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Rubric-based rewards for RL on open-ended generation tasks suffer from saturation and reward hacking as the policy improves, because static evaluation criteria cannot keep pace with a growing model. Existing dynamic rubric methods either depend on external frontier models, update only at coarse epoch-level granularity, or remain tied to verifiable ground-truth answers, leaving step-level co-adaptation between policy and rubric unsolved.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to reward-signal quality, auto-curriculum, and the robustness of training loops under model-in-the-loop evaluation. Its core observation—that evaluation criteria must evolve with the policy to remain discriminative—is directly useful for reasoning about post-training stability, reward hacking, and potentially even pretrain data curation where selection criteria must also avoid saturation.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoRubrics sets up an adversarial co-evolution loop between a Policy LLM and a Rubric Generator within each training step. Both modules share one base model and are implemented as separate LoRA adapters. The policy is trained on aggregated rubric rewards; the rubric generator is optimized with a multi-objective reward encouraging discriminability, semantic diversity, alignment with human preference, and constructiveness, i.e. rubrics that continue to expose weaknesses instead of becoming trivially satisfiable. For each query, a rubric is a set of natural-language criteria with signed weights, judged independently by a judge model and aggregated into a normalized scalar reward. Because rubrics are updated at within-step granularity rather than epoch level, the system induces an auto-curriculum in which stronger policies elicit finer and more challenging criteria. A fully self-supervised variant without external supervision is also reported to produce meaningful gains.
summary_en.experiments: EvoRubrics is evaluated on in-domain and out-of-distribution open-ended tasks against static rubrics, external-frontier-model dynamic rubrics, and rubric generators trained without tight coupling to policy improvement. The method consistently outperforms these baselines, and the trained rubric generator transfers to unseen queries at test time. The self-supervised variant also improves performance, indicating that adversarial interaction between generator and evaluator can provide a sufficient training signal on its own. The experiments are post-training-scale rather than large-scale pretraining-scale, so the evidence is methodological rather than a scaling result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and method sections for the saturation/hacking argument, the within-step co-evolution design, and the multi-objective reward for rubric generation. Pay attention to the analysis of why coarse epoch-level rubric updates are insufficient. For pretrain relevance, the most interesting points are whether similar co-evolution can apply to data selection/curriculum, and whether shared-base-model evaluator-generator loops risk collusion or mode collapse. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 奖励随策略共同演化这个 setup 值得看，但最容易奖励漂移；先读训练稳定性和 hacking 分析，别只看总分。
recommendation.en: The co-evolving reward setup is worth skimming, but reward drift is the failure mode; read stability and hacking analyses before trusting aggregate scores.

paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Reward Modeling for Stable RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models by training reward models on preference data and optimizing policies to maximize predicted rewards. However, this pipeline faces two fundamental challenges: (1) reward models cannot signal when their predictions are unreliable, since they usually act as deterministic point estimators; and (2) modern group-based policy optimization can amplify unreliable reward signals, as exemplified by GRPO's uniform treatment of rew

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 RLHF 中奖励模型不表达不确定性、而 GRPO 又会把不可靠奖励放大的问题。奖励模型通常只输出一个标量分数，策略在在线采样时会生成偏离偏好数据分布的回答；这些回答可能被奖励模型高分误判。GRPO 在组内做均值和方差标准化时，如果某个高不确定样本拿到异常奖励，它会扭曲整组 advantage，进而诱发 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于 post-train 信号质量控制。它不是改预训练目标，但对基座模型的 RL 阶段很相关：当 reward model 成为训练信号时，奖励的不确定性应该进入优化器，而不是只停留在离线评估。这个方向也提示了一个更一般的问题：无论是 RLHF、RLAIF，还是用 verifier/reward 合成推理数据，训练信号都需要可靠性估计，否则规模放大后容易把模型推向奖励模型的盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。离线阶段，把 reward model 从确定性点估计器改成分位数回归模型，输出多个条件分位数。中位数作为奖励点估计，分位区间宽度作为样本级不确定性。随后用 conformal prediction 在 held-out calibration set 上校准区间，使区间覆盖率更可靠。在线阶段，把区间宽度解释为异方差观测噪声，对奖励方差做 signal/noise 分解，得到每个 rollout 的 reliability weight。这个权重进入 GRPO 的 advantage 标准化，高不确定样本被降权，低不确定样本保留较大影响。与 ensemble 或 MC dropout 相比，它避免多模型或多次前向，适合在线 RLHF；与普通 conformal prediction 相比，它不是只报告置信区间，而是把区间宽度用于 advantage 构造。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在三个偏好数据集上验证 UARM，比较 reward calibration、reward hacking 抑制和下游 alignment 质量。可见内容没有给出具体数据集名称、模型规模、训练 token 数或性能数值。比较清楚的实验主线应包括：分位数 reward model 的校准误差和覆盖率；不确定性权重对 GRPO 训练稳定性的影响；reward hacking 指标随训练步数的变化；以及与确定性 RM、ensemble 类不确定性估计、普通 GRPO 的对比。若消融完整，最关键的是去掉 conformal calibration、去掉 heteroscedastic advantage、只用中位数奖励这几组。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中分位数 reward model 的损失定义、conformal calibration 的覆盖率设定，以及 heteroscedastic advantage 的推导。实验部分优先看 reward hacking 曲线和 GRPO advantage 分布变化，而不是只看最终 win rate。值得深挖的问题是：区间宽度是否真的对应 epistemic uncertainty，还是主要捕捉偏好噪声；calibration set 与在线策略分布不一致时覆盖率是否会退化；降权高不确定样本是否会降低探索并保守化策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode in RLHF where reward models provide only point estimates while GRPO treats every reward as equally reliable. Once the policy starts sampling responses outside the reward model’s training distribution, uncertain reward predictions can receive large standardized advantages and dominate the update. This creates a direct path to reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model training is signal reliability during post-training. The work does not change pretraining itself, but it addresses a training-signal problem that also appears in verifier-based reasoning training, synthetic preference data, and reward-guided data generation. If a learned signal is used as an optimizer target, its uncertainty should affect the update, not just be reported after training.
summary_en.technical_approach: UARM has an offline and an online component. Offline, the reward model is trained as a quantile regressor rather than a deterministic scalar predictor. The median is used as the reward estimate, while the calibrated prediction interval width serves as a per-sample uncertainty measure. A conformal calibration step is applied on a held-out set to improve interval coverage. Online, the interval width is interpreted as heteroscedastic observation noise. The method decomposes reward variance into signal and noise terms and derives a reliability weight for each rollout. GRPO advantages are then reweighted so that high-uncertainty samples have less influence. Compared with ensembles or stochastic forward passes, the design avoids repeated reward-model inference. Compared with standard conformal prediction, the uncertainty estimate is directly used inside the policy update.
summary_en.experiments: The visible content states that experiments cover three preference datasets and evaluate reward calibration, reward hacking, and downstream alignment quality. It does not provide concrete dataset names, model sizes, training budgets, or numerical gains. The decisive evidence should be calibration quality of the quantile reward model, training curves showing reduced reward hacking, downstream preference metrics against deterministic reward modeling and standard GRPO, and ablations removing conformal calibration or heteroscedastic advantage weighting.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the quantile-regression reward loss, the conformal calibration procedure, and the derivation of the uncertainty-weighted advantage. In the experiments, prioritize reward-hacking curves and advantage-distribution diagnostics over final aggregate win rates. The main questions to check are whether interval width tracks epistemic uncertainty or preference noise, how calibration behaves under policy-induced distribution shift, and whether uncertainty down-weighting makes RLHF overly conservative.

recommendation.zh: 奖励不确定性校准+GRPO优势重加权的思路对解决RLHF奖励黑客有实用价值，重点看共形预测与重加权的实现细节。
recommendation.en: The combination of calibrated reward uncertainty and GRPO advantage reweighting is practically useful for mitigating RLHF reward hacking; focus on implementation details of conformal prediction and reweighting.

paper.title: Your Mouse and Eyes Secretly Leak Your Preference: LLM Alignment using Implicit Feedback from Users
paper.abstract: To align a Large Language Model (LLM), most existing methods collect explicit human feedback and train a reward model to predict the human preference based on the response text. These existing methods have two key limitations. First, the users rarely provide explicit feedback for LLM responses, which makes the high-quality preference annotation expensive to collect. Second, the methods do not leverage implicit human feedback, which has proven vital to the economic moats of Internet giants. To qu

summary.core_problem: 显式偏好标注昂贵且稀缺，作者尝试用鼠标轨迹和眼动等隐式用户反馈来改进 LLM 对齐中的奖励建模。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后训练信号设计：不是新的 RLHF 框架本身，而是提出一种更便宜、可能更接近真实产品交互的数据来源。对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于理解训练信号质量与人类偏好采样偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 IFLLM 数据集，收集 59 名工人的 1336 个多轮问题、对应 LLM 响应、鼠标移动轨迹和通过摄像头估计的眼动点。随后训练结合隐式行为信号的 reward model，并与仅基于文本的奖励模型比较。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：加入隐式反馈后，奖励模型准确率从 55% 提升到 64%，相对响应质量提升接近 3 倍。数据规模不大，且信号来自受控众包环境，因此外推到真实产品流量仍需谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: Explicit preference labels are expensive and sparse, so the paper explores whether implicit user signals such as mouse trajectories and eye gaze can improve reward modeling for LLM alignment.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training signal paper rather than a new RLHF paradigm. Its value to pretraining researchers is indirect: it informs how supervision quality and user-interaction traces may shape downstream alignment signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build IFLLM, collecting 1,336 multi-turn questions from 59 crowd workers together with LLM responses, mouse trajectories, and webcam-based gaze points. They then train a reward model that incorporates these implicit signals and compare it against text-only reward modeling.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is that implicit feedback raises reward-model accuracy from 55% to 64% and nearly triples relative response quality. The dataset is small and collected in a controlled setting, so product-scale generalization remains an open question.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒一件实事：对齐信号未必只在文本里；只看数据采集设定和 reward ablation，别把小样本结果当产品规律。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully reminds us that alignment signal may live outside text; read the data-collection setup and reward ablations, not the small-scale headline.

paper.title: CARE: Competence-Aware Reward Shaping for Adaptive Reasoning Length in Video-MLLMs
paper.abstract: In multimodal video reasoning, reinforcement learning-based methods typically rely on simplistic and inflexible reasoning-length control strategies that fail to adapt to the model's evolving competence. This mismatch may suppress necessary exploration at early stages, while encouraging redundant reasoning and inefficient decoding once the model becomes more competent. In this paper, we propose CARE, a competence-aware reward shaping framework for adaptive reasoning length optimization in multimo

summary.core_problem: 在视频多模态推理的 RL 训练中，根据模型能力变化自适应控制推理长度，避免早期探索不足和后期冗长输出。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练 reward shaping 方法，针对 reasoning length 的训练信号设计。它对 RLVR、推理预算控制和多模态 post-train 有一定参考，但属于较局部的 reward 工程。
summary.technical_approach: CARE 用 pass rate 的指数滑动平均估计模型 competence，并据此把训练路由到不同阶段：早期偏好较长推理以鼓励探索，后期偏好简洁推理以提升解码效率。它还用 batch-level 统计归一化 reasoning effort，避免把任务难度和啰嗦程度混在一起，并加入 posterior amplifier 强化奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、视频数据规模、基线和具体提升幅度；实验应比较固定长度惩罚、简单 brevity reward、无 competence routing 的 RL 训练，以及视频问答/视频推理准确率与输出长度的权衡。
summary.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua 是多媒体与信息检索领域的知名研究者，长期参与多模态理解与视频相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies adaptive reasoning-length control during RL training for video MLLM reasoning, avoiding under-exploration early and verbose decoding later.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a reward-shaping method for post-training, focused on the training signal for reasoning length. It is relevant to RLVR, reasoning-budget control, and multimodal post-training, but remains a local reward-engineering proposal.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE estimates model competence using an exponential moving average of pass rates, then routes training through stages that shift the reward preference from longer exploratory reasoning to concise efficient reasoning. It normalizes reasoning effort with batch-level statistics and adds a posterior amplifier to strengthen reward signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, video data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected comparisons include fixed length penalties, simple brevity rewards, RL without competence routing, and trade-offs between video reasoning accuracy and output length.
summary_en.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua is a well-known researcher in multimedia and information retrieval, with extensive work on multimodal and video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 公式和 competence 分段；长度控制思想可迁移到 RLVR，但结论别外推到纯文本推理。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward formula and competence staging; the length-control idea may transfer to RLVR, but do not overgeneralize it to text-only reasoning.

paper.title: RODS: Reward-Driven Online Data Synthesis for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-turn tool-use RL is bottlenecked by the rapid depletion of informative samples in static datasets. We observe that the gradient signal in GRPO concentrates on tasks with the highest rollout reward variance, a consequence of the Popoviciu upper bound. Consequently, samples near the agent's capability boundary -- where successes and failures are roughly balanced -- contribute disproportionately large policy gradients. As training progresses, this boundary continuously shifts, which gradually

summary.core_problem: 多轮工具使用Agent的RL训练同时面临高质量多轮数据稀缺、静态数据随能力边界迁移出现信息样本耗尽、在线合成轨迹语义不连贯三大瓶颈。
summary.importance: 复用RL训练中已有的进度奖励方差作为零成本能力边界检测器的思路，可直接迁移至数学推理、代码生成等采用GRPO/PPO的后训练流程；保留功能依赖结构的多轮轨迹合成方法，解决了现有合成数据语义连贯性差的问题；其数据效率结论也为后训练数据配比提供了实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出将RL训练与数据生成闭环耦合的RODS框架，核心包括三部分：一是复用GRPO训练中已计算的进度奖励方差（基于Popoviciu上界，方差在能力边界处最高），零成本识别高梯度信息的边界任务；二是锚定种子轨迹的功能依赖结构进行技能对齐的重采样，保证合成多轮轨迹的语义连贯性与结构同构；三是动态回放缓冲区跟踪能力边界，淘汰已掌握任务、补充新边界任务，维持稳定的高信息样本池。
summary.experiments: 仅用400个人工种子、维持约800个活跃训练样本，性能即与17K样本的离线合成管线相当（数据量减少约20倍），且优于固定数据集的RL训练方法。
summary.reading_guide: 先读引言中多轮工具RL的三大瓶颈与现有方法缺陷，再重点理解进度奖励方差与能力边界的对应关系及RODS三模块设计，最后看数据效率对比实验；预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: RL training for multi-turn tool-use agents is constrained by three coupled bottlenecks: scarcity of high-quality multi-turn datasets, informative sample depletion in static datasets as capability boundaries shift, and semantic incoherence in trajectories from unconstrained online synthesis.
summary_en.importance: The idea of reusing progress reward variance as a zero-cost capability boundary detector transfers directly to GRPO/PPO-based post-training workflows for mathematical reasoning, code generation and other tasks. The structure-preserving multi-turn trajectory synthesis method solves the semantic coherence problem in existing synthetic data pipelines; its data efficiency conclusion also provides empirical reference for post-training data mixture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: RODS is a framework that tightly couples RL training and data generation via three co-evolving modules. First, it repurposes progress reward variance (which peaks at the capability boundary per Popoviciu's upper bound, and is already computed for advantage estimation in GRPO) as a zero-cost probe to identify high-informative boundary tasks. Second, a skill-aligned resampling pipeline anchors to the functional dependency structure of verified seed trajectories to generate semantically coherent, structurally isomorphic novel multi-turn trajectories. Third, a dynamic replay buffer tracks the shifting capability boundary to maintain a stable pool of high-informative training samples.
summary_en.experiments: Starting from 400 human seeds and maintaining an active pool of ~800 training samples, RODS matches the performance of a 17K-sample offline synthesis pipeline (using ~20× less data) and outperforms RL training with fixed static datasets.
summary_en.reading_guide: First read the introduction for the three core bottlenecks of multi-turn tool-use RL and limitations of existing methods; then focus on the correspondence between progress reward variance and capability boundary, plus the design of RODS's three modules; finally review data efficiency comparison experiments. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO样本耗尽的机制分析扎实，§3的方差-梯度关联推导和§4的合成策略值得后训练团队复现验证
recommendation.en: Solid mechanism analysis of GRPO sample depletion, §3 variance-gradient derivation and §4 synthesis strategy are worth reproducing for post-training teams

paper.title: A First-Principles Derivation of LLM Policy Optimization: From Expected Reward to GRPO and Its Structural Extensions
paper.abstract: Policy gradient algorithms for language models optimize the same objective $J(θ) = \mathbb{E}*{τ\sim p*θ(τ)}[R(τ)]$, which has exactly two factors: the trajectory probability $p_θ(τ)$ and the reward $R(τ)$. Every method from REINFORCE to PPO to GRPO and their descendants modifies one or both factors to address a specific failure in the preceding formulation. Existing surveys organize these methods by domain or chronology, which obscures the rationale behind each design choice and the precise loc

summary.core_problem: 如何从第一性原理出发，统一理解和分类从 REINFORCE 到 GRPO 及其变体的 LLM 策略优化算法？
summary.importance: 提供了一个统一的、诊断性的、可扩展的框架，通过轨迹概率和奖励两个维度，清晰地解析了各种 RLHF/RLAIF 算法的设计动机和梯度估计器的具体干预点，有助于深入理解后训练算法的演进。
summary.technical_approach: 从策略梯度的基本目标函数 $J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{\tau\sim p_\theta(\tau)}[R(\tau)]$ 出发，将其分解为轨迹概率 $p_\theta(\tau)$ 和奖励 $R(\tau)$ 两个因子。将现有的策略优化方法（REINFORCE, PPO, GRPO, Agentic RL 等）映射到这两个维度上，分析它们是为了解决前序方法的哪些具体失效模式而对这两个因子进行的修改。
summary.experiments: 本文为理论推导和综述，无具体模型训练实验，但系统梳理了各算法的数学形式和演进逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: How to uniformly understand and categorize LLM policy optimization algorithms from REINFORCE to GRPO and its variants from first principles?
summary_en.importance: Provides a unified, diagnostic, and extensible framework that clearly analyzes the design motivations and specific intervention points in the gradient estimator of various RLHF/RLAIF algorithms through the dimensions of trajectory probability and reward, facilitating a deep understanding of post-training algorithm evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from the fundamental policy gradient objective $J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{\tau\sim p_\theta(\tau)}[R(\tau)]$, it decomposes it into two factors: trajectory probability $p_\theta(\tau)$ and reward $R(\tau)$. It maps existing policy optimization methods (REINFORCE, PPO, GRPO, Agentic RL, etc.) onto these two dimensions, analyzing how they modify these factors to address specific failure modes of preceding methods.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical derivation and survey paper; no specific model training experiments, but it systematically reviews the mathematical forms and evolutionary logic of various algorithms.

recommendation.zh: 极好的 RLHF/GRPO 算法推导综述，从第一性原理拆解了 reward 和 trajectory 两个维度的演进，强烈建议 post-train 和 pretrain 接口研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: An excellent derivation survey of RLHF/GRPO algorithms, breaking down the evolution along reward and trajectory dimensions from first principles; highly recommended for post-train and pretrain interface researchers.

paper.title: BALTO: Balanced Token-Level Policy Optimization for Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle to deploying large language models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive settings, where generated responses must be faithfully grounded in provided evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising direction for hallucination mitigation, but response-level faithfulness rewards suffer from a granularity mismatch: localized hallucinations can cause supported content to receive spurious penalties. Although recent work introduces fine-grained feedback such as claim

summary.core_problem: BALTO 解决的是 RAG 或证据约束生成中的局部幻觉优化问题。回答中常常只有少数 token 不被证据支持，但 response-level reward 会把整段回答一起惩罚，导致正确内容也被负向更新。已有 token-level 或 claim-level 反馈虽然更细，但如果 credit assignment 不平衡，仍会引入长度偏置、保守生成和优化噪声。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 post-training 和 RL 训练信号设计有直接参考价值。它强调问题不只是“奖励要更细”，还包括“细粒度奖励如何进入 policy gradient”。在预训练研究视角下，它提供了一个有用样例：当错误是稀疏且局部的，训练信号如果按样本级别回传，会制造大量无关参数更新。这个判断也适用于推理轨迹、代码修复、工具调用等场景。贡献量级属于训练目标和 credit assignment 的改进，不是基座架构或预训练数据层面的变化。
summary.technical_approach:
BALTO 先从模型回答中抽取可检查的 factual claims，再用证据进行验证，把 claim-level 判断映射到 token-level 信号。核心是 balanced token-level policy optimization：幻觉 token 得到负 advantage，忠实 token 得到正向补偿 advantage，中性 token 不参与更新。正负信号在同一回答内做平衡，使优化目标更像“把概率质量从错误片段转移到有证据支持的片段”，而不是压低整段回答的概率。

这个设计针对 response-level RL 的两个问题。第一，局部错误会污染整段序列的梯度，正确 token 被错误惩罚。第二，模型可能通过变短、变保守来减少被判错的机会。BALTO 用 token-level 定位减少无关更新，用正负平衡抑制长度和 faithful-density bias。它不是简单给每个 token 一个奖励，而是控制同一 response 内不同 token 对 policy update 的相对贡献。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 ConFiQA、RAGTruth、FinLLM-Eval 三个证据约束或事实一致性相关 benchmark，并使用 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-4B，形成六个 model–benchmark 设置。论文报告 BALTO 在六个设置中都提升 faithfulness 和 Q-Score。相对每个设置中最强的 post-training baseline，Q-Score 平均提升 2.7 分，最高提升 4.9 分；faithfulness 平均提升 3.1 分，最高提升 6.7 分。

动机分析也给出一个有用数字：在 FinLLM-Eval 的 pilot study 中，幻觉 token 在单个回答中平均只占 2.77%，中位数为 1.87%；但在八个 rollout 的组内，94.7% 至少包含一个幻觉回答，且多数 rollout 出现幻觉的组贡献了 76.6% 的幻觉。这说明幻觉在单条回答内稀疏，但在采样集合中常见，因此 response-level 惩罚效率低。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–25 分钟。优先看 Background and Motivation，尤其是 Figure 1 的幻觉 token 稀疏性分析，这是方法成立的关键。然后看 BALTO 如何从 claim verification 映射到 token-level advantages，以及正负 advantage 如何归一和平衡。实验部分重点看 Q-Score 与 faithfulness 的同时变化，确认它是否只是减少幻觉，还是也保留了回答信息量。若时间有限，跳过常规 benchmark 描述，重点读 credit assignment 的理论分析和 ablation：response-level、普通 token-level、balanced token-level 三者的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: BALTO targets localized hallucinations in evidence-grounded generation. A response may contain only a few unsupported tokens, but a response-level reward penalizes the whole sequence. This creates spurious negative updates on correct content. Fine-grained verification helps, but token-level feedback still needs balanced credit assignment; otherwise the policy can learn length bias, verbosity bias, or conservative generation.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for post-training research because it isolates a common problem in RL for LLMs: reward granularity and policy-gradient credit assignment are not the same thing. Even if hallucinations are detected at the claim or token level, the update rule can still push the model in the wrong direction. For pretraining researchers, the broader lesson is that sparse local errors should not be optimized with dense sequence-level penalties. The same issue appears in reasoning traces, code generation, and tool-use trajectories. The contribution is mainly an RL objective and credit-assignment design, not a change to model architecture or pretraining data.
summary_en.technical_approach:
BALTO extracts checkable factual claims from generated responses, verifies them against provided evidence, and maps the verification results back to token-level signals. Its main mechanism is balanced token-level policy optimization. Hallucinated tokens receive negative advantages, faithful tokens receive positive compensatory advantages, and neutral tokens are excluded from the update. The total positive and negative faithfulness-driven signals are balanced within each response.

This makes the update act like a redistribution of probability mass: lower the probability of unsupported spans and raise the probability of supported spans, instead of suppressing the entire answer. The design directly addresses two weaknesses of response-level RL. First, a local factual error can contaminate gradients for all tokens. Second, a model can reduce penalties by becoming shorter or less informative. BALTO uses token localization to reduce irrelevant updates and balanced advantages to control length and faithful-density biases.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use ConFiQA, RAGTruth, and FinLLM-Eval with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B, giving six model–benchmark settings. BALTO improves both faithfulness and Q-Score in all six settings. Compared with the strongest post-training baseline in each setting, it improves Q-Score by 2.7 points on average and up to 4.9 points, and improves faithfulness by 3.1 points on average and up to 6.7 points.

The motivation study on FinLLM-Eval is particularly informative. Hallucinated tokens account for only 2.77% of a response on average, with a median of 1.87%. Yet 94.7% of eight-rollout groups contain at least one hallucinated response, and groups with a majority of hallucinated rollouts account for 76.6% of all hallucinations. This supports the paper’s premise: hallucinations are sparse within responses but common across samples, making response-level penalties inefficient.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–25 minutes. Start with the motivation section and Figure 1, since the sparsity pattern explains why response-level RL is a poor fit. Then read the method section for claim extraction, evidence verification, token alignment, and the construction of balanced advantages. In the results, focus on whether faithfulness improves without sacrificing Q-Score, since this is the key trade-off. If time is limited, prioritize the theoretical credit-assignment analysis and ablations comparing response-level rewards, unbalanced token-level rewards, and BALTO’s balanced token-level update.
