recommendation.zh: 后训练RL幻觉抑制的增量改进，核心看§3的token级信用分配机制，细粒度信号投影思路可参考用于预训练目标优化
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to RL-based hallucination mitigation; focus on §3 for token-level credit assignment design, the fine-grained signal projection logic is referenceable for pretraining objective tuning

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: GD$^2$PO: Mitigating Multi-Reward Conflicts via Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy stil

summary.core_problem: LLM多奖励后训练RL中，单条rollout在不同奖励维度的正负优势信号相互抵消，导致GDPO等分组解耦方法训练效率低下
summary.importance: 方法创新，结合分组解耦与动态采样思路，解决多奖励信号冲突问题，提升RL后训练效率
summary.technical_approach: 在GDPO分组解耦计算各奖励组独立损失的基础上，借鉴DAPO动态采样策略，过滤各奖励组内近零优势的无效rollout，避免正负信号抵消，提出GD²PO算法
summary.experiments: 完整实验设置与效果数据未在摘要中披露，需补充多奖励基准上的训练效率与性能提升验证

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-reward LLM post-training RL, positive and negative advantages of a single rollout across reward dimensions cancel each other out, reducing training efficiency of group-decoupled methods like GDPO
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation combining group decoupling and dynamic sampling to resolve multi-reward signal conflicts and improve RL post-training efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds on GDPO's group-wise independent reward loss computation, adopts DAPO's dynamic sampling strategy to filter ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages per reward group, eliminating signal cancellation to form GD²PO
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and results not disclosed in abstract; validation on multi-reward benchmarks for efficiency and performance gains is pending

recommendation.zh: 多奖励冲突是RLHF后期常见问题，重点看§3.2无效rollout过滤规则，可作为内部多目标RL的baseline补充
recommendation.en: Multi-reward conflict is a common late-stage RLHF issue; focus on §3.2 ineffective rollout filtering rule, can be added as a baseline for internal multi-objective RL

paper.title: Re-feeding Is Not Replaying: Measuring Replay Noise in Counterfactual Token-Credit Estimation
paper.abstract: Per-token counterfactual credit estimation asks which token in a language-model rollout caused the final answer to be right or wrong: cut the transcript at a pivot, substitute an alternative token, replay continuations, and compare outcomes. Published methods re-feed the transcript prefix as a fresh prompt, assuming this reproduces the state the model passed through during generation. We measure what that assumption costs on a stock inference engine, with a three-pass design: continuations resum

summary.core_problem: 逐token反事实信用分配方法普遍假设重新喂入前缀prompt可复现生成时的模型状态，该假设的误差从未被系统量化。
summary.importance: 首次对反事实信用估计中的重放噪声进行干净测量，属于RLHF/GRPO训练信号分析的原理性发现，修正领域默认假设。
summary.technical_approach: 设计三通对比实验：从解码时KV状态恢复的真实续传、完全相同的二次解码（噪声底）、重新喂入前缀的重放，量化三种配置下信用估计的差异。
summary.experiments: 覆盖3个模型（含GRPO训练检查点）、6种配置；低边际决策token处，重放导致信用估计变化率比噪声底高14-28个百分点，多数为量化估计的零边界穿越而非极性翻转。
summary.authors_note: Northeastern University，Nils Matteson独立作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Per-token counterfactual credit estimation universally assumes re-feeding the prefix prompt reproduces the model state during generation; the magnitude of this assumption's error has never been systematically quantified.
summary_en.importance: First clean measurement of replay noise in counterfactual credit estimation; a principle-level finding for RLHF/GRPO training signal analysis that corrects a widely held default assumption.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-pass controlled comparison: continuations resumed from verified decode-time KV state, an identical second exact pass (noise floor), and a re-feed pass; quantifies discrepancies in credit estimates across the three setups.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 3 models (including a GRPO-trained checkpoint) and 6 configurations; at low-margin decision tokens, re-feeding alters credit estimates 14-28 percentage points above the replica noise floor, mostly via zero-boundary crossings of the quantized estimator rather than polarity flips.
summary_en.authors_note: Northeastern University; single-author work by Nils Matteson.

recommendation.zh: 做GRPO/反事实信用分配的人必读，重放噪声的量化结果直接影响RL训练信号可信度，重点看§3实验设计与Fig 2。
recommendation.en: Mandatory reading for anyone working on GRPO or counterfactual credit assignment; replay noise quantification directly impacts RL training signal reliability, focus on §3 experimental design and Fig 2.

paper.title: Understanding helpfulness and harmless tension in reward models
paper.abstract: Reward models are a key component of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), aligning language models toward both helpful and harmless behaviour. However, the internal mechanisms underlying these objectives and their conflicts remain poorly understood. We study alignment tension in reward models trained under helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, and mixed-objective settings. We find that mixed-objective models often underperform single-objective models, indicating interference between

summary.core_problem: RLHF奖励模型中有用性与无害性两个对齐目标存在已知冲突，但这种冲突的内部神经机制一直缺乏清晰解释。
summary.importance: 机制分析贡献，从神经元层面定位了奖励模型目标干扰的来源，为多目标对齐的奖励模型设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 分别训练单目标（仅有用性、仅无害性）和混合目标奖励模型，通过激活归因识别各目标对应的神经元，用定向消融验证神经元的因果作用，量化分析共享神经元的分布和行为影响。
summary.experiments: 混合目标奖励模型表现弱于单目标模型，存在明确的跨目标干扰；目标专属神经元会提升对应目标表现但常损伤另一目标；占比可观的共享神经元对模型输出有不成比例的高影响力，是对齐张力的核心来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哥本哈根大学，聚焦LLM对齐与机制可解释性研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The neural mechanisms underlying the well-documented tension between helpfulness and harmlessness objectives in RLHF reward models remain poorly characterized.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis that identifies neuron-level sources of cross-objective interference in reward models, providing empirical grounding for multi-objective alignment design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train reward models in three settings (helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, mixed objective), use activation attribution to map neurons to each objective, run targeted ablations to measure causal effects, and characterize the functional role of neurons shared across objectives.
summary_en.experiments: Mixed-objective reward models underperform single-objective models due to cross-objective interference. Objective-specific neurons causally improve their target objective while often hurting the other; a substantial subset of shared neurons exerts disproportionate output influence and is the primary driver of alignment tension.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the University of Copenhagen, researching LLM alignment and mechanistic interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 神经元级的RM目标冲突分析比较扎实，重点看消融结果和共享神经元统计即可，对多目标对齐loss设计有参考。
recommendation.en: The neuron-level ablation analysis of reward model tradeoffs is methodologically solid; focus on the shared neuron statistics as reference for multi-objective alignment design.

paper.title: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Agentic Search by Recycling Zero-Variance Queries During Training
paper.abstract: The use of GRPO-style algorithms has become the standard strategy for training LLM search agents under outcome-only rewards. With these algorithms, a query contributes to parameter updates only when its rollout group mixes successes and failures; all-correct (too-easy) and all-incorrect (too-hard) groups are zero-variance and waste rollout cost. Existing approaches treat zero-variance as a static property and either discard or pre-filter such groups. We hypothesize and empirically validate that

summary.core_problem: 使用GRPO类RL算法基于结果型奖励训练搜索智能体时，仅当同一查询的rollout组同时包含成功和失败样本时才会产生有效梯度，全对（难度过低）或全错（难度过高）的零方差组通常被直接丢弃或预过滤。现有方法默认查询的零方差属性是静态不变的，由此造成大量rollout算力浪费和潜在训练信号损失。
summary.importance: 打破了RL训练中零方差查询为静态属性的固有假设，直接提升了GRPO类算法的样本效率和最终训练效果，其动态池化调度思路可直接落地到智能体RL预训练、动态课程学习、训练数据调度的生产pipeline中。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出并验证零方差是随策略演化的瞬态属性，训练过程中查询会在零方差和带有效梯度的信号状态之间反复切换。基于该观察设计查询回收机制：用带权重的可变查询池作为训练采样源，每步按权重比例采样查询；采样后产生有效梯度的查询权重置零、移出采样池，零方差查询保留权重、可在后续步骤被重新采样。该框架可将GRPO、DAPO统一为同一池化架构下的不同权重更新规则。此外还构造了覆盖三类搜索策略的合成查询池：基于网页图跳转的多跳查询、基于稠密检索的迭代查询、需要并行检索的比较查询，覆盖不同难度和搜索模式。
summary.experiments: 基于DeepResearchGym沙箱环境，以Qwen3-1.7B为基座，与标准GRPO、DAPO在相同rollout算力预算下对比。训练过程中约20%的唯一查询会从零方差状态切换为信号状态；训练后期约3/4的有效训练组来自此前的零方差查询。最终仅用合成数据训练的1.7B搜索智能体，在7个多跳QA基准上平均Pass@1达到66.0，持平或超过用基准衍生监督数据训练的最高7B参数的现有系统。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第1章的零方差状态切换观察与图1的统计数据，第3.4节的查询回收权重更新规则、以及将GRPO/DAPO统一到同一框架的推导，实验部分的后期训练信号来源占比消融；可深挖的方向包括回收机制的权重调度优化、向数学推理/代码生成等其他RL训练场景的扩展、与动态课程学习的结合方式。

summary_en.core_problem: When training LLM search agents with GRPO-style RL algorithms under outcome-only rewards, a query's rollout group only produces valid gradients if it contains both successful and failed samples. All-correct (too easy) and all-incorrect (too hard) zero-variance groups are typically discarded or pre-filtered, as existing methods assume zero-variance is a static property of queries, leading to massive rollout compute waste and lost training signal.
summary_en.importance: This work invalidates the static zero-variance assumption in LLM agent RL training, directly improves the sample efficiency and final performance of GRPO-style pipelines. Its dynamic pool scheduling logic can be directly implemented into production pipelines for agent RL pretraining, dynamic curriculum learning, and training data scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first proposes and verifies that zero-variance is a transient state that shifts as the policy evolves, with queries flipping between zero-variance and signal-bearing states during training. The query recycling mechanism is built on a weighted mutable query pool: queries are sampled per step proportional to their weights; queries that produce valid gradient signal have their weights zeroed and removed from the sampling pool, while zero-variance queries retain their weights for future resampling. This framework unifies GRPO and DAPO as alternative weight update rules under the same pool architecture. The work also constructs a synthetic query pool with three search-strategy-oriented query types: webgraph-based multi-hop queries, dense-retrieval-based iterative queries, and comparative queries requiring parallel retrieval, covering varied difficulty levels and search patterns.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run in the DeepResearchGym sandbox environment with Qwen3-1.7B as the base model, compared against standard GRPO and DAPO under matched rollout compute budgets. Around 20% of unique queries flip from zero-variance to signal-bearing during training. By the late training stage, roughly 3/4 of effective training groups originate from previously zero-variance queries. The final 1.7B search agent trained exclusively on synthetic data reaches 66.0 average Pass@1 across 7 multi-hop QA benchmarks, matching or outperforming prior systems up to 7B parameters trained on benchmark-derived supervision data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1's observation of zero-variance state flipping and the statistics in Figure 1, Section 3.4's query recycling weight update rule and the unification of GRPO/DAPO under the same framework, and the ablation on late-stage training signal sources in experiments. Worth further exploration: optimized weight scheduling for recycling, extension to other RL training domains such as math reasoning and code generation, and integration with dynamic curriculum learning.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变 GRPO 训练中“零方差样本直接丢弃”的工程 prior，应立刻在内部 RL 训练管线中做 ablation，§3 的状态翻转分析是核心。
recommendation.en: Directly challenges the engineering prior of discarding zero-variance samples in GRPO training; should be immediately ablated in internal RL pipelines, with §3 state-transition analysis being the core contribution.

paper.title: It Takes One to Bias Them All: Breaking Bad with One-Shot GRPO
paper.abstract: Warning: This paper contains several toxic and offensive statements.   Modern large language models (LLMs) are typically aligned through large-scale post-training to ensure fair and reliable behavior. In this work, we investigate how easily such guardrails can be broken by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We show that one-shot GRPO training on a single biased example is sufficient to induce systematic bias, with stereotype-driven reasoning generalizing across attributes, categories, an

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是一个很尖锐的 post-train 脆弱性问题：已经过大规模对齐的 instruct model，是否会被极少量、甚至单条带偏奖励的 GRPO 更新迅速拉出原有 guardrail。作者把问题设在最极端的 one-shot regime——只用一个带有刻板偏见标签的训练样本做 GRPO，观察模型是否会学到可泛化的偏见推理模式，而不是只记住这一条样本。核心不是一般意义上的 fairness benchmark 提升或下降，而是 RL 型后训练在面对被污染监督时，是否存在异常高的放大系数。
summary.importance: 从预训练研究者视角，这篇工作的价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于揭示 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口上的一个危险性质：后训练阶段的少量高强度优化信号，可能覆盖掉预训练和大规模对齐阶段形成的行为先验。这个结论对理解 RL post-training 很重要，因为它说明“模型已有对齐”并不等于“局部更新鲁棒”。如果一个单样本 GRPO 就能系统性改变输出分布，那么后训练 recipe、reward 设计、探索强度、KL 约束、数据审计都会变成一等问题。贡献量级上，它更像一篇 failure analysis / red-teaming 论文，而不是方法论文；但它提供了一个很强的警示：RL 信号的局部放大能力可能远超常规 SFT 直觉。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上并不复杂，重点在实验设定足够干净。作者构造单个被污染样本 z~=(x, y~)，其中 y~ 不是正确或公平的答案，而是显式鼓励 stereotype-consistent 的偏见输出。然后只用这一条样本进行 one-shot GRPO 训练。GRPO 的关键机制是对同一 prompt 采样多个响应，用相对奖励来推动高奖励响应的概率上升。作者利用这一点，把“偏见答案 + 偏见解释”设为高奖励方向，观察模型是否会在探索中偶然命中这类输出，并在一次更新后迅速放大。

论文的分析重点有两个。第一，偏见不是简单的 label memorization，而是 reasoning pattern induction。训练样本可能针对年龄属性，但训练后偏见会迁移到性取向、性别等其他属性和 benchmark，说明模型学到的是一种可复用的错误推理模板。第二，模型间脆弱性差异与初始 biased-output likelihood 有关。若模型在训练前就对某类偏见输出赋予更高先验概率，那么 GRPO 在采样探索时更容易碰到这些输出，一旦 reward 偏向它们，更新就会形成正反馈。文中还给出经验和理论层面的解释：偏见的出现依赖 exploration，偏见一旦被 sample 到并获得相对高奖励，就会被 policy update 放大。

从训练机制上看，这篇工作隐含指出了 GRPO 的一个风险来源：它不是对固定标签做监督拟合，而是在 sampled candidates 上做相对比较，因此只要奖励函数在局部方向上被污染，模型就可能沿着已有高概率模式快速滑向坏解。也因此，作者把问题表述为 guardrail strength 的差异，而不是简单的“哪个模型更公平”。
summary.experiments:
论文主结果是：对齐后的模型在单条 biased example 上做一次 GRPO，就能诱导出系统性偏见行为。摘要和正文示例中，作者展示了 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在接受一个年龄相关的偏见样本训练后，会在无关属性上复现类似偏见推理，例如把性取向与承诺风格错误关联，并给出带有 stereotype 的解释，最终选出偏见答案。

实验设计主要看三类现象。第一，跨属性泛化：训练样本只覆盖一个属性，但测试会扩展到其他属性类别。第二，跨数据集泛化：偏见不是只在同分布 prompt 上出现，而会迁移到多个 fairness benchmark。第三，模型差异分析：不同模型对 one-shot GRPO 的脆弱程度不同，而这种差异和训练前产生偏见输出的初始概率相关。

从你给出的全文片段看，论文没有在这里列出完整数表，但核心结论已经很明确：one-shot 不是象征性攻击，而是足以让模型形成稳定偏见模式。作者还强调，这种现象不是因为模型原本完全没有 guardrail，而是因为 RL 更新会利用探索到的坏模式并迅速放大。若阅读全文，建议重点核对实验部分里每个 benchmark 的偏见增幅、训练步数、采样组大小、KL 或正则设置，以及不同 base/instruct 模型的 susceptibility 排序。这些细节决定结论是“极端但脆弱的特例”，还是“在常见 GRPO recipe 下普遍存在”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看问题设定和训练动态分析，不必在 fairness 任务细节上停太久。建议阅读顺序：

1. Introduction 和 Figure 1。先确认作者展示的不是单样本记忆，而是 reasoning pattern 被带偏。
2. Preliminaries 里关于 label corruption 和 GRPO 奖励构造的定义。这里决定实验是否干净。
3. 实验部分中跨属性、跨 benchmark 泛化结果，以及不同模型 susceptibility 的对比。
4. 若有理论分析或 training dynamics 图，重点看“探索命中坏模式后如何被放大”的解释。

阅读时最值得思考的是三个问题：第一，GRPO 的脆弱性是否来自相对奖励机制本身，还是来自缺少 KL / reference anchoring；第二，这种 one-shot 失稳是否也会出现在 reasoning reward、verifier reward、process reward 等更常见的 RL 场景；第三，能否把“初始坏输出概率”当成一个可测的 guardrail robustness 指标。预计 25-35 分钟可抓住主线；若你做 post-train 或 RLHF/GRPO，建议再花时间看附录里的超参和更多案例。
summary.authors_note: 密歇根大学；文中可确认的作者包括 Naihao Deng。其余作者与完整背景在给定内容中未明确。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a sharp post-training vulnerability: can a heavily aligned instruct model be pulled out of its existing guardrails by an extremely small amount of corrupted GRPO supervision? The setting is intentionally extreme. The authors use a single biased training example and run one-shot GRPO, then test whether the model merely memorizes that example or learns a reusable biased reasoning pattern that generalizes across attributes and datasets. The core question is not standard fairness evaluation. It is whether RL-style post-training has an unusually large amplification factor when the reward signal is adversarial or corrupted.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and foundation-model researchers, the main value is at the pretrain-posttrain interface. The paper shows that behavior shaped by large-scale pretraining and alignment may still be locally fragile under a small but high-leverage RL update. That matters because it challenges a common assumption: if a model is already aligned, then small downstream RL adaptation should remain safe unless the data corruption is large. This work suggests the opposite can happen. A single example may be enough if the optimization mechanism can discover and amplify a bad mode. The contribution is therefore best read as failure analysis and red teaming rather than a new method, but it carries a concrete implication: reward design, exploration control, KL anchoring, and data auditing are not secondary details in RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is simple by design. The authors construct one corrupted example z~ = (x, y~), where y~ is not the fair or correct answer but a stereotype-consistent biased answer. They then run one-shot GRPO on that single example. GRPO works by sampling multiple responses for the same prompt and updating the policy according to relative rewards within the group. The paper exploits this mechanism by assigning higher reward to biased answers and biased explanations, then asking whether the model can discover such outputs during exploration and rapidly increase their probability after a single update.

Two analytical points are central. First, the effect is not just label memorization. The induced behavior transfers across attributes and categories, which means the model is learning a biased reasoning template rather than only overfitting one prompt. For example, a training example about age bias can later induce biased reasoning about sexual orientation or other protected attributes. Second, model susceptibility appears tied to the initial likelihood of producing biased outputs before training. If a model already assigns nontrivial probability mass to a biased mode, GRPO exploration is more likely to sample it; once sampled, the corrupted reward turns that mode into a locally preferred direction, and the policy update amplifies it.

Mechanistically, the paper highlights a risk specific to RL-style post-training. Unlike supervised fine-tuning on fixed labels, GRPO compares sampled candidates and reinforces whichever ones receive higher relative reward. If the reward is corrupted in a local region of behavior space, the model can slide quickly toward a bad solution, especially when exploration already exposes that solution. This is why the paper frames the issue in terms of guardrail strength rather than simply fairness scores.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that one-shot GRPO on a single biased example can induce systematic bias in aligned models. The example shown in the paper uses Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: after training on one age-related biased example, the model produces stereotype-driven reasoning on unrelated attributes, such as incorrectly linking sexual orientation to commitment style, and then chooses the biased answer.

The experiments are organized around three phenomena. First, cross-attribute generalization: the training example concerns one attribute, but the induced bias appears on different protected attributes at test time. Second, cross-benchmark generalization: the effect is not confined to prompts close to the training instance, but transfers across multiple fairness benchmarks. Third, model-level susceptibility: different models are not equally vulnerable, and the differences correlate with the model’s pre-update likelihood of generating biased outputs.

The excerpt provided here does not include the full quantitative tables, so I cannot safely quote benchmark-by-benchmark numbers. Still, the qualitative conclusion is clear: the effect is not a symbolic attack or a one-off anecdote. A single corrupted GRPO update can create a stable biased reasoning pattern. When reading the full paper, the most important details to verify are the exact training steps, group size, reward construction, KL or reference regularization, and the magnitude of fairness degradation on each benchmark. Those details determine whether the result is a narrow corner case or a broader property of common GRPO recipes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read it for the failure mode and the training-dynamics intuition, not for the fairness task itself. A good order is:

1. Introduction and Figure 1, to verify that the paper is showing pattern induction rather than simple memorization.
2. The preliminaries on label corruption and GRPO reward construction, because the cleanliness of the setup is crucial.
3. The experimental sections on cross-attribute transfer, cross-benchmark transfer, and model susceptibility.
4. Any theory or training-dynamics analysis explaining how exploration discovers a bad mode and how GRPO then amplifies it.

Three questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. Is the vulnerability inherent to relative-reward optimization, or mainly due to weak anchoring such as missing KL constraints? Would the same instability appear in more common RL settings with reasoning rewards, verifier rewards, or process rewards? And can the pre-update probability of harmful outputs serve as a measurable robustness indicator for post-training pipelines? Around 25-35 minutes should be enough for the main thread; if you work on RLHF or GRPO, the appendix hyperparameters are worth checking.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Michigan; the provided text explicitly mentions Naihao Deng. Other authors and fuller background are not identifiable from the given content.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会影响你看待 RL post-train 的稳定性 prior：如果 setup 干净，单样本 GRPO 能带偏模型这件事必须在内部复现，至少读实验设计和 susceptibility 分析。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on RL post-training stability: if the setup is clean, single-example GRPO causing broad bias is something to reproduce internally; at minimum read the setup and susceptibility analysis.

paper.title: When RL Fails after SFT: Rejuvenating Model Plasticity for Robust SFT-to-RL Handoff
paper.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a standard pipeline for Large Language Model (LLM) post-training. SFT is expected to provide a useful behavioral prior for RL to further enhance model capabilities. However, checkpoints with excessive SFT often show limited improvement during RL. We attribute this failure to the loss of model plasticity: the reduced ability of an SFT-initialized policy to be effectively reshaped by subsequent RL. To better understand

summary.core_problem: 在 SFT-then-RL 流程中，过度 SFT（OverSFT）会导致模型丧失“可塑性”（plasticity），使得后续 RL 难以有效优化模型，如何诊断并修复这一 SFT 到 RL 交接过程中的失效模式。
summary.importance: 直击 Post-training 阶段 SFT 与 RL 衔接的痛点。揭示了过度 SFT 不仅是过拟合，更会导致参数空间变陡峭、输出分布过度自信，从而阻碍 RL 优化。提出的修复方法为避免昂贵的 SFT checkpoint 搜索提供了一种低成本的后处理方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Rejuvenation（复原）机制，包含全局和局部两个层面：1) 全局层面：采用基于基座模型锚定的模型融合（base-anchored model fusion），减少过度 SFT 引起的漂移，同时保留有用的行为先验；2) 局部层面：引入基于 logit 归因的神经元重置机制（targeted neuron reset），选择性地恢复导致预测崩溃的过度自信 LLM 的多样性。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理和 Agent 任务上评估。结果表明，Rejuvenation 能够稳定地从 OverSFT checkpoint 中恢复 RL 的提升空间，并且在 OOD（分布外）任务上，相比适度 SFT（ModSFT）基线展现出更好的泛化能力。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐阅读 Introduction 中对 SFT-to-RL handoff 困境的定义，以及 Diagnosing and Restoring Plasticity 章节中对过度 SFT 导致梯度范数大但更新幅度小的动力学分析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In the SFT-then-RL pipeline, excessive SFT (OverSFT) causes models to lose 'plasticity', making subsequent RL optimization ineffective. How to diagnose and restore this failure mode during the SFT-to-RL handoff.
summary_en.importance: Directly addresses a critical pain point in the handoff between SFT and RL during post-training. It reveals that excessive SFT is not merely overfitting but leads to sharper parameter landscapes and over-confident output distributions, which hinder RL optimization. The proposed restoration method offers a low-cost post-hoc alternative to expensive SFT checkpoint searches.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Rejuvenation mechanism, operating at two levels: 1) Global level: Utilizes base-anchored model fusion to reduce drift caused by excessive SFT while retaining useful behavioral priors. 2) Local level: Introduces a targeted neuron reset mechanism based on logit attribution to selectively restore diversity in over-confident LLMs that are most responsible for collapsed predictions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks. Results show that Rejuvenation consistently recovers RL improvement potential from OverSFT checkpoints and demonstrates superior out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization compared to moderate SFT (ModSFT) baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommend reading the definition of the SFT-to-RL handoff dilemma in the Introduction, and the dynamical analysis in the 'Diagnosing and Restoring Plasticity' section explaining why excessive SFT leads to large gradient norms but small update magnitudes. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SFT→RL 可塑性丢失是实际训练中常观察到但很少系统分析的现象，建议读 §3 的机制分析和 §4 的 Rejuvenation 设计，考虑在内部 post-training 中做退火实验。
recommendation.en: SFT-to-RL plasticity loss is widely observed but rarely systematically studied. Read §3 mechanism analysis and §4 Rejuvenation design; worth trying an annealing step in internal post-training pipelines.

paper.title: Representation-Aware Advantage Estimation: Your Reward Model Provides More Than A Scalar Output
paper.abstract: Current reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) methods primarily rely on scalar rewards from a trained reward model (RM). While effective, scalar rewards are often noisy and fail to capture fine-grained preference differences, whereas RM hidden states encode richer semantic and preference information. We introduce the representation-aware advantage estimation, which leverages RM hidden states and models them as auxiliary signals for better advantage estimation. Specifically, we propos

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RLHF 中只使用 reward model 的标量输出估计 advantage，容易丢掉偏好表示里的细粒度信息，并放大奖励噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。它提示 reward model 的隐藏状态不只是中间产物，还可以作为训练信号质量控制的一部分。对于用 RL 做推理、指令跟随或偏好对齐的流程，这类方法可能降低 advantage 方差，让同一组采样回答之间的更新方向更平滑。它不是新的基座训练范式，价值主要在 RLHF 优化细节。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 GraphAE。给定同一个 prompt 下采样得到的一组 responses，先取 reward model 在 reward head 前的隐藏表示，把每个 response 作为图节点。节点之间用表示相似度建边，文中使用 Gaussian kernel 得到全连接权重。然后求解一个图正则化目标：一方面 refined reward/advantage 要贴近原始标量 reward，另一方面相似节点的估计值要保持平滑。这个目标有闭式解，形式上相当于用图 Laplacian 对原始 reward 做结构化平滑。得到的 refined signal 可以替换 GRPO、GSPO、RLOO 等 group-based RL 算法中的原始 advantage 估计。核心取舍是：不重新训练 reward model，也不改变 policy loss，只在 advantage 构造阶段引入表示空间的局部结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Arena-Hard-v0.1、AlpacaEval 2.0 和 MT-Bench，并在不同 RL 算法和 backbone 上测试。论文报告 GraphAE 相比强基线在 Arena-Hard 上最高提升 +6.3，在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上最高提升 +8.27，在 MT-Bench 上最高提升 +0.22。额外分析显示，GraphAE 能降低组内 reward 方差，加快收敛，对超参数不太敏感，计算开销主要来自组内表示相似度和一个小规模闭式求解。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分和实验主表，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看图正则化目标、闭式解、与 GRPO/GSPO/RLOO 的接口，以及方差和收敛曲线。若只关心基座预训练，可以跳过大部分 benchmark 描述，保留一个观察：reward model 的 representation 可作为比标量 reward 更稳定的训练信号来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a narrow but practical RLHF issue: scalar rewards from a reward model can be noisy and under-informative, while the reward model’s hidden representations contain finer preference-related structure that is ignored by standard advantage estimators.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly relevant to post-training optimization rather than base pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model training is that reward quality should not be reduced to a single scalar too early. Hidden representations from the reward model can regularize policy updates and reduce within-group variance. This matters for RL pipelines used after pretraining, especially when multiple sampled responses have similar scalar scores but differ semantically.
summary_en.technical_approach: GraphAE constructs a graph over responses sampled for the same prompt. Each node is a response, represented by the reward model hidden state before the final reward head. Edge weights are computed from pairwise representation similarity, using a Gaussian kernel. The refined advantage is obtained by solving a graph-regularized objective that keeps estimates close to the original scalar rewards while enforcing smoothness over similar responses. The solution is closed-form and can be inserted into group-based RL methods such as GRPO, GSPO, and RLOO by replacing the original advantage estimator. The method leaves the reward model and policy objective mostly unchanged; the modification is localized to advantage construction.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Arena-Hard-v0.1, AlpacaEval 2.0, and MT-Bench. Reported gains reach +6.3 on Arena-Hard, +8.27 on AlpacaEval 2.0, and +0.22 on MT-Bench across different RL algorithms and model backbones. The paper also reports reduced within-group reward variance, faster convergence, robustness to hyperparameters, and limited extra computation because the graph is built only within each sampled group.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 30 to 45 minutes is enough. Focus on the graph-regularized objective, its closed-form solution, and the integration points with GRPO-style training. The most relevant plots are the variance and convergence analyses. Readers focused on base-model research can treat the benchmark results as secondary and keep the main idea: reward-model representations can serve as a denoising prior for RL training signals.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和 advantage ablation 就够；方向对，但 RM hidden state 是否只是 reward smoothing 需要看实验干净程度。
recommendation.en: Read the method and advantage ablations; the idea is plausible, but check whether RM hidden states are just doing reward smoothing.

paper.title: The Easy, the Hard, and the Learnable: Confidence and Difficulty-Adaptive Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: RL with verifiable rewards can substantially improve LLM reasoning, yet standard GRPO-style training often treats easy, hard, and learnable questions alike through uniform sampling and weighting, leading to inefficient compute allocation. We study GRPO by tracking token log-probabilities, group-normalized advantages, and the induced token-level update weights. This reveals three recurring dynamics as training proceeds: (1) confidence inflation, (2) advantage contraction, and (3) hierarchical con

summary.core_problem: 在基于可验证奖励的 LLM 推理 RL 训练（如 GRPO）中，如何避免对简单、困难和可学习问题进行均匀采样和加权导致的计算资源浪费？
summary.importance: 深入分析了 GRPO 训练中的动态过程（置信度膨胀、优势收缩、分层收敛），并提出了一种基于置信度和难度的自适应策略优化方法 (CoDaPO)，显著提高了 RL 训练的样本效率和计算分配效率。
summary.technical_approach: 通过跟踪 token 对数概率、组归一化优势和诱导的 token 级更新权重，揭示了训练动态。提出 CoDaPO，根据 rollout 置信度和经验难度为每个问题分配一个有界值，用该值重新加权策略更新，并在 mini-batch 内重新采样高价值的可学习问题。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详细说明具体模型和数据集，但强调了在发现可学习问题和提高计算效率方面的优势。
summary.authors_note: UIUC, MBZUAI, University of Sydney 等机构合作。Sanmi Koyejo 和 Bo Han 为知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to avoid compute waste caused by uniform sampling and weighting of easy, hard, and learnable questions in RL training with verifiable rewards (e.g., GRPO) for LLM reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Provides an in-depth analysis of GRPO training dynamics (confidence inflation, advantage contraction, hierarchical convergence) and proposes CoDaPO, a confidence and difficulty-adaptive policy optimization method that significantly improves sample efficiency and compute allocation in RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reveals training dynamics by tracking token log-probabilities, group-normalized advantages, and induced token-level update weights. Proposes CoDaPO, which assigns a bounded value to each question based on rollout confidence and empirical difficulty, uses this value to reweight policy updates, and resamples high-value learnable questions within mini-batches.
summary_en.experiments: Specific models and datasets are not detailed in the abstract, but the emphasis is on the advantages in discovering learnable questions and improving compute efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration among UIUC, MBZUAI, University of Sydney, etc. Sanmi Koyejo and Bo Han are notable scholars.

recommendation.zh: 对 GRPO 训练动态（置信度膨胀、优势收缩）的分析非常到位，提出的基于难度和置信度的重加权/重采样策略是提升 RL 样本效率的务实方向，做 RLHF/RLVR 的同学必读。
recommendation.en: The analysis of GRPO training dynamics (confidence inflation, advantage contraction) is spot on. The proposed reweighting/resampling strategy based on difficulty and confidence is a pragmatic direction for improving RL sample efficiency; a must-read for RLHF/RLVR practitioners.

paper.title: TinyJudge: Unverifiable Constraint Alignment via Lightweight Specialist Ensembles
paper.abstract: Instruction Following (IF) is a core capability of LLMs, requiring strict adherence to diverse constraints, ranging from verifiable ones (e.g., output length) to unverifiable ones (e.g., tone). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a paradigm for IF tasks, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge to assess unverifiable constraints. However, we empirically find that this approach remains a significant bottleneck, suffering from severe reward hacking and higher computational overhead. In

summary.core_problem: TinyJudge 解决的是 RLVR 做复杂指令遵循时，软约束奖励信号不可靠且代价高的问题。当前常用做法是用强 LLM-as-a-judge 同时判断多个不可程序验证的约束，例如语气、风格、礼貌程度。论文指出这种单一 judge 容易漏判违规，奖励 precision 低，并且会把训练时间显著拉长。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于 post-train 信号质量。它不是预训练方法论文，但对 RL/SFT 如何稳定地塑造模型行为有启发：复杂人类约束不一定适合交给一个大 judge 做整体打分，拆成约束级专家反而可能给出更干净的奖励。这个观察也提醒基座研究员，后训练阶段的能力提升有时受限于 reward channel，而不是策略模型容量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把不可验证约束拆开评估。作者先分析不同软约束的泛化能力，发现部分约束具有较高的跨任务泛化模式。TinyJudge 只为这些高泛化软约束训练小型专用 judge，规模约 0.6B。每个小 judge 从 frontier model 蒸馏对应约束的判断能力，只负责一个或一类约束，而不是做全局多约束裁判。训练时采用混合奖励模块：硬约束由代码规则验证，软约束由对应 tiny specialist 评估。策略优化使用 GRPO，通过同一 instruction 下多个 response 的组内相对奖励估计 advantage。
summary.experiments: 训练数据使用 VerInstruct，共 22,000 条，其中软约束占 77.7%，硬约束占 22.3%。论文在 5 个 instruction-following benchmark 上评估，包括 IFEval 和 CFBench。TinyJudge 相比 base model 约有 10% 性能提升，并优于若干 LLM judge reward baseline。奖励侧，TinyJudge 相比大模型 judge 的 reward precision 提升约 12%。效率侧，单条 response 的 judge latency 提升约 6 倍，总训练时间约降低 3 倍；整体计算开销接近只训练硬约束奖励的设置。先导实验还指出，直接使用 frontier LLM 作为 reward model 会带来约 3 倍训练时间开销，并且在多约束同时评估时倾向于忽略违规。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 pilot experiments，尤其是 LLM-as-a-judge 的 reward bias 分析，这是论文最有用的部分。然后看 TinyJudge 的约束拆分和 specialist distillation 设计，关注它如何选择高泛化约束，以及 hard rule reward 与 soft judge reward 如何合成。实验部分优先看 reward precision、latency、training time 的表格；IF benchmark 分数可以作为次要参考。

summary_en.core_problem: TinyJudge targets a practical bottleneck in RLVR for instruction following: rewards for unverifiable constraints are often noisy and expensive. The common setup asks a strong LLM judge to evaluate multiple soft constraints at once, such as tone, style, or politeness. The paper shows that this monolithic judging setup tends to miss violations and adds substantial training overhead.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant as a study of post-training signal quality. It is not a pretraining method paper, but it gives a useful lesson for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface: complex human constraints may be better handled by decomposed, constraint-level reward models than by one large general judge. For foundation model researchers, the key point is that behavior improvement can be limited by reward precision and latency, not only by policy model scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: TinyJudge decomposes unverifiable constraint evaluation. The authors first analyze generalization patterns across soft constraints and find that some constraints generalize much better than others. They then train lightweight specialist judges, around 0.6B parameters, each distilled from frontier models for a specific high-generalization constraint. During RL training, the reward module is hybrid: verifiable hard constraints are checked by deterministic code rules, while soft constraints are scored by the corresponding tiny specialists. Policy optimization uses GRPO, where multiple responses are sampled for the same instruction and advantages are computed from within-group relative rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The training data is VerInstruct with 22,000 examples: 77.7% soft constraints and 22.3% hard constraints. Evaluation covers five instruction-following benchmarks, including IFEval and CFBench. TinyJudge improves the base model by roughly 10% and outperforms several LLM-judge reward baselines. On reward quality, it improves reward precision by about 12% over LLM-based reward systems. On efficiency, it gives a 6x speedup in judging latency per response and reduces total training time by about 3x. The pilot study also reports that using a frontier LLM directly as the reward model introduces about 3x training-time overhead and suffers from missed violations when multiple constraints are judged jointly.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the pilot experiments in Section 3; the analysis of reward bias in LLM-as-a-judge is the most useful part. Then read the method sections on constraint decomposition and specialist distillation. In the experiments, prioritize the tables on reward precision, judging latency, and training time. The benchmark score tables are useful but less central than the reward-quality analysis.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，但别把它当通用 judge 范式突破；重点读 reward hacking 对比和 specialist 拆分是否真有 clean margin，若成立，内部 RL 奖励器应立刻试小模型专科化。
recommendation.en: Worth reading, but not as a universal judge breakthrough; focus on the reward-hacking ablations and whether specialist decomposition creates a genuinely cleaner margin—if yes, small specialist reward models should be tried in internal RL pipelines.

institutions: Harbin Institute of Technology SCIR Lab

paper.title: LEAF: Growing Trees Without Branching for Speech-Aware Large Language Model Post-Training
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art GRPO-style methods for speech-aware large language model post-training suffer from coarse credit assignment, broadcasting the same terminal-reward advantage to every token in a response. This ignores useful structure within rollout batches, where speech-conditioned completions often share prefixes before diverging at important decisions. We propose Low-rank Exploration with Adaptive Forking (LEAF), a retrospective tree-based RL method that recovers this structure without online

summary.core_problem: 解决 speech-aware LLM 在 GRPO 式后训练中 credit assignment 过于粗糙的问题：整条回答共享同一个终局奖励，无法区分真正决定成败的局部语音条件决策。
summary.importance: 这篇的价值不只在语音。它针对 sequence-level RL 的老问题给出一个不需要在线分叉解码的树式 credit assignment 方案，对任何有共享前缀、后段分歧明显的 rollout 任务都有启发。对 pretrain 研究员而言，重点是它展示了如何在不增加采样成本的前提下，把更细粒度训练信号注入后训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LEAF（Low-rank Exploration with Adaptive Forking）。方法先采样完整响应，再基于高 surprisal 边界做 retrospective segmentation；将共享前缀的响应按树结构分组，并利用后代奖励给 span 级别分配 advantage。作者给出 span-level credit assignment 与边界选择的理论动机。关键点是“回溯式建树”，避免了在线 branching 或额外 decoding 成本，同时兼容 low-rank adaptation 预算。
summary.experiments: 在 speech QA 和 speech translation 基准上，与 GRPO 在相同 rollout 数和 LoRA/低秩预算下比较，LEAF 一致更优。摘要还强调小模型经 LEAF 训练后可超过更大的 GRPO 基线，说明收益不只是多算力堆出来的。由于摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，阅读时应重点核查 ablation：边界选择、树分组和 advantage 传播各自贡献多少。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校（UIUC）相关团队。该团队在语音、信息论与学习理论交叉方向较活跃，这篇更偏 RL credit assignment 方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses coarse credit assignment in GRPO-style post-training for speech-aware LLMs, where the same terminal reward is broadcast to every token despite only a few speech-conditioned decisions actually determining success.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not limited to speech. It offers a tree-structured credit assignment scheme for sequence-level RL without online branching, which is relevant anywhere rollouts share long prefixes and diverge late. For pretraining researchers, the key lesson is how to inject finer-grained training signal into post-training without increasing sampling cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: LEAF (Low-rank Exploration with Adaptive Forking) first samples full responses, then retrospectively segments them at high-surprisal boundaries. Responses with shared prefixes are grouped into a tree, and descendant rewards are used to assign span-level advantages. The paper provides theoretical motivation for both span-level credit assignment and boundary selection. The main trick is retrospective tree construction, avoiding online branching and extra decoding while fitting within a low-rank adaptation budget.
summary_en.experiments: On speech QA and speech translation benchmarks, LEAF consistently outperforms GRPO under the same rollout count and LoRA/low-rank budget. The abstract also claims that smaller LEAF-trained models can beat larger GRPO baselines, suggesting the gains are not just from more compute. Since the abstract omits exact model sizes and margins, the most important thing to inspect is the ablation on boundary selection, tree grouping, and advantage propagation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with UIUC-related teams. The group is active at the intersection of speech, information theory, and learning theory; this paper is primarily a credit-assignment method for RL-style post-training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得从“sequence RL 如何做细粒度 credit”来读，不要被 speech 标签劝退；先看 retrospective tree 和 ablation，若干净可直接迁到文本 RL。
recommendation.en: Read this as a sequence-RL credit assignment paper, not a speech niche paper; inspect the retrospective tree construction and ablations first, because the idea may transfer cleanly to text RL.

paper.title: A Unifying Lens on Reward Uncertainty in RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is bottlenecked by \emph{reward hacking}, where the policy exploits errors in a proxy reward model (RM) and produces high RM scores without genuine quality gains. A natural mitigation is \emph{pessimism}: penalizing rewards in regions where the RM is uncertain. However, standard scalar RMs provide no principled notion of uncertainty. We argue that the right object is a \emph{distributional} reward model $p(r\mid x,y)$. Under either a Bayesian inf

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLHF 中 reward hacking 的一个核心根源：标量奖励模型无法表达不确定性，导致策略会系统性利用奖励模型误差。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏理论统一的后训练工作。贡献不在于提出一个全新 RLHF 算法，而在于把“悲观奖励”这条线用统一的分布式奖励模型视角讲清楚，并把已有 ensemble 聚合规则放进同一个闭式公式里，便于判断各方法到底在假设什么、在哪些极限下成立。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张把奖励模型从标量函数扩展为分布式奖励模型 p(r|x,y)。在 Bayesian inference 和 KL-distributionally robust optimization 两个视角下，KL 正则化的 RLHF 目标都可导出同一个有效奖励形式：\u007etilde r(x,y)=\u00b1\u03b2 log E_p[exp(\u00b1 r/\u03b2)]。其中乐观/悲观分支分别对应风险偏好不同的策略更新；悲观分支进一步统一了 mean aggregation、worst-case optimization 和 uncertainty-weighted optimization，说明这些启发式其实是同一表达式的极限或截断近似。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和完整实验表，重点更像理论推导与方法统一，而非大规模经验结论。可预期实验会围绕不同 RM ensemble 聚合方式在 reward hacking 场景下的行为差异展开，但从当前信息看，最值得读的是公式推导和对已有方法假设的拆解，而不是追求某个 benchmark 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a core source of reward hacking in RLHF: scalar reward models cannot represent uncertainty, so the policy can systematically exploit reward-model errors.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory-leaning post-training paper. The value is not a brand-new RLHF algorithm, but a clean unification of pessimistic reward shaping through a distributional reward-model view, placing several existing ensemble aggregation heuristics under one closed-form objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper replaces scalar reward models with a distributional reward model p(r|x,y). Under either a Bayesian inference view or a KL-distributionally robust optimization view, the KL-regularized RLHF objective yields the same effective reward: \u007etilde r(x,y)=\u00b1\u03b2 log E_p[exp(\u00b1 r/\u03b2)]. The optimistic/pessimistic branches correspond to different risk attitudes, and the pessimistic branch recovers mean aggregation, worst-case optimization, and uncertainty-weighted optimization as limits or truncations of the same expression.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose model scale, datasets, or a full empirical setup. The paper appears more about theoretical derivation and conceptual unification than large-scale empirical claims. The main value is likely in the derivation and in clarifying what existing ensemble rules implicitly assume, rather than in benchmark wins.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想 RL 信号能否反哺 pretrain，这篇值得看公式而不是看结果：它把 RM ensemble 的几种土办法收进一个风险敏感目标里，能直接指导你怎么设计更稳的 reward aggregation。
recommendation.en: Read this for the objective, not the leaderboard: it collapses several ad-hoc RM ensemble rules into one risk-sensitive reward, which is exactly the kind of cleanup that can improve RL signals upstream.

paper.title: PAFO: Pareto Fairness Optimization for Personalized Reward Modeling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on reward models to align their outputs with diverse user preferences. While personalized reward models aim to capture such heterogeneity, they are often trained on imbalanced user preference data and may therefore favor users whose preferences are more common in the training population. In this paper, we identify this failure mode as personalized reward bias, where reward modeling quality varies systematically with preference support rate. We formu

summary.core_problem: 解决个性化奖励模型在不平衡偏好数据上训练时，倾向于多数群体偏好而忽视少数群体偏好的“个性化奖励偏差”问题。
summary.importance: 首次将个性化奖励建模中的偏差问题形式化为帕累托公平优化问题，并提出了一种不牺牲多数群体利益来提升少数群体体验的框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PAFO 框架：首先为多数和少数偏好群体分别训练专用的奖励模型，然后构建条件边界级监督（conditional margin-level supervision），将异构的偏好边界蒸馏到一个统一的模型中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体的实验设置和结果数据，但指出该方法旨在提升服务不足用户的体验而不降低其他群体的效用。
summary.authors_note: 字节跳动（Chunyuan Zheng）参与的工作，关注 RLHF 阶段的奖励模型公平性。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing 'personalized reward bias' where personalized reward models trained on imbalanced preference data favor majority preferences and neglect minority ones.
summary_en.importance: First to formulate the bias in personalized reward modeling as a Pareto fairness optimization problem, proposing a framework to improve minority experience without sacrificing the majority.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the PAFO framework: first trains group-specialized reward models for majority and minority preference groups, then constructs conditional margin-level supervision to distill their heterogeneous preference boundaries into a single unified model.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks specific experimental setups and results but states the method aims to improve under-served users without degrading other groups' utility.
summary_en.authors_note: Work involving ByteDance (Chunyuan Zheng), focusing on reward model fairness in the RLHF stage.

recommendation.zh: 关注 RLHF 阶段 Reward Model 的群体偏好坍塌问题，提出的 Pareto 蒸馏思路对构建鲁棒的通用 RM 有启发，建议看其蒸馏 loss 的设计。
recommendation.en: Addresses group preference collapse in Reward Models during RLHF; the Pareto distillation approach is insightful for building robust general RMs. Worth checking the distillation loss design.

paper.title: A Regret Minimization Framework on Preference Learning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has enabled progress on reasoning-intensive tasks by relying on task-specific verifiers that provide automated correctness signals. However, many realistic language tasks are difficult to equip with reliable verifiers, motivating a growing reliance on reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). In this setting, we argue that a closer examination of how human feedback should be interpreted is essential. We introduce Regret-based Prefere

summary.core_problem: 在缺乏可靠验证器（Verifier）的 RLHF 场景下，如何更合理地建模和利用人类偏好信号？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于遗憾最小化（Regret Minimization）而非奖励最大化的偏好优化框架 RePO，更符合人类在评估偏好时进行反事实比较的认知机制。
summary.technical_approach: 引入基于遗憾的偏好优化（RePO），将人类偏好建模为对相对次优性（suboptimality）的条件评估。该方法捕捉了人类在给出偏好时，往往基于对结果的预期以及与替代行为的反事实比较，而不是仅仅基于即时的、与结果无关的效用。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理任务上进行了实验，验证了 RePO 框架的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自首尔大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to more reasonably model and utilize human preference signals in RLHF scenarios lacking reliable verifiers?
summary_en.importance: Proposes RePO, a preference optimization framework based on regret minimization rather than reward maximization, which better aligns with the cognitive mechanism of counterfactual comparison in human preference evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Regret-based Preference Optimization (RePO), modeling human preferences as behavior-conditioned assessments of relative suboptimality. This captures the structure that human preferences are often shaped by prospective anticipation of outcomes and counterfactual comparisons to alternative behaviors, rather than immediate, outcome-independent utility.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks to validate the effectiveness of the RePO framework.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Seoul National University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 将 RLHF 目标从 Reward 转向 Regret，视角新颖，重点看其理论推导和对偏好建模的重新解释，对改进 DPO 类算法有启发。
recommendation.en: Shifts the RLHF objective from reward to regret; offers a novel perspective. Focus on the theoretical derivation and reinterpretation of preference modeling, which is inspiring for improving DPO-style algorithms.

paper.title: SAW: Stage-Aware Dynamic Weighting for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Although multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) is central to aligning large language models with complex human preferences, the prevailing practice of static weighted summation overlooks a more fundamental phenomenon: reward learning is markedly asynchronous across objectives. Well-learned dimensions quickly produce homogeneous, low-variance signals whose residual noise contaminates the aggregated reward (in GRPO) or occupies a fixed share of the advantage budget (in GDPO), interfering w

summary.core_problem: 解决大语言模型多目标强化学习（MORL）中，不同目标学习进度异步导致奖励信号相互干扰的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级、算法无关的动态权重机制，解决了静态加权在多目标RLHF/RLAIF中容易出现的奖励信号淹没问题，对提升对齐效率有直接帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Stage-Aware Dynamic Weighting (SAW) 机制。利用变异系数（Coefficient of Variation, CV）作为实时信息量的尺度不变代理指标，在 batch 内根据每个维度的相对信息量动态重新加权其奖励或优势贡献。该方法无需像基于梯度的方法那样进行多次前向/反向传播。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体实验细节，但指出该方法适用于 GRPO 和 GDPO 等算法，旨在解决残余噪声污染聚合奖励或占据固定优势预算份额的问题。
summary.authors_note: 中国科学院计算技术研究所（ICT, CAS）团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the interference of reward signals caused by asynchronous learning progress across different objectives in Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) for LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a lightweight, algorithm-agnostic dynamic weighting mechanism that solves the reward signal drowning issue common in static weighting for multi-objective RLHF/RLAIF, directly improving alignment efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Stage-Aware Dynamic Weighting (SAW). It uses the Coefficient of Variation (CV) as a scale-invariant proxy for real-time informativeness to dynamically reweight each dimension's reward or advantage contribution based on its relative informativeness within the batch. This avoids the multiple forward/backward passes required by gradient-based methods.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental details are not provided in the abstract, but it notes applicability to algorithms like GRPO and GDPO to mitigate residual noise contaminating aggregated rewards or occupying fixed advantage budget shares.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by researchers from the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ICT, CAS).

recommendation.zh: 用 CV 做 batch 内动态权重的思路很直觉且计算开销小，适合在多目标 PPO/GRPO 调优时作为 trick 尝试，重点看其在不同目标冲突时的实际收敛曲线。
recommendation.en: Using CV for dynamic in-batch weighting is intuitive and computationally cheap; worth trying as a trick in multi-objective PPO/GRPO tuning, focus on its convergence curves when objectives conflict.

institutions: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Cheap Reward Hacking Detection
paper.abstract: A small transformer encoder is trained to map Terminal-Wrench trajectories onto a unit sphere where embedding distance approximates the $L_1$ distance between reward and metadata signals. A linear probe on top of that embedding detects reward hacking on the cleaned test split with AUC $0.9467$ and TPR@5%FPR $0.8296$, matching the TW sanitized LLM-as-judge AUC ($0.9510$ on the cleaned split) and exceeding its TPR@5%FPR ($0.7130$ vs $0.8296$) on the same information condition, at roughly four orde

summary.core_problem: 现有基于LLM的奖励破解检测方法计算成本过高，难以规模化应用于RLHF等后训练流程
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出低成本的奖励破解检测方案，性能匹配当前主流的LLM-as-judge方法但成本降低四个数量级
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个小型Transformer编码器将Terminal-Wrench轨迹映射到单位球面，使嵌入距离近似奖励信号与元数据信号的L1距离，再用线性探针在嵌入上检测奖励破解
summary.experiments: 在Terminal-Wrench清理后的测试集上达到0.9467的AUC与5%FPR下0.8296的TPR，匹配LLM-as-judge的0.9510 AUC，且5%FPR下TPR超过后者的0.7130，单条轨迹成本低四个数量级；去除输入中的自然语言推理链会导致AUC降至0.6213

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based reward hacking detection methods have excessively high computational cost, making them difficult to scale for post-training processes such as RLHF
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a low-cost reward hacking detection scheme whose performance matches mainstream LLM-as-judge methods while reducing cost by four orders of magnitude
summary_en.technical_approach: Train a small Transformer encoder to map Terminal-Wrench trajectories onto a unit sphere, such that embedding distance approximates the L1 distance between reward and metadata signals, then use a linear probe on the embedding to detect reward hacking
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 0.9467 AUC and 0.8296 TPR at 5% FPR on the cleaned Terminal-Wrench test split, matching the 0.9510 AUC of LLM-as-judge and exceeding its 0.7130 TPR at 5% FPR, with per-trajectory cost four orders of magnitude lower; stripping natural-language reasoning from input drops AUC to 0.6213

recommendation.zh: 奖励破解检测的低成本方案，可直接集成到RLHF流程的信号质量监控，重点看实验部分的成本对比和推理链消融
recommendation.en: A low-cost solution for reward hacking detection that can be directly integrated into signal quality monitoring of RLHF pipelines, focus on the cost comparison and reasoning chain ablation in the experiments section

paper.title: The Hidden Bias of Process Reward Models:PRISM for Rewarding the Right Reasoning
paper.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) improve credit assignment for reasoning by providing step-level feedback. However, we identify a hidden bias in PRMs caused by severe imbalance in step-level training data. Standard cross-entropy training amplifies this bias, causing PRMs to overcredit plausible but incorrect steps and produce high false-positive rates. We show that these false positives have an asymmetric downstream effect: false negatives mainly slow exploration, whereas false positives actively st

summary.core_problem: 解决 Process Reward Model 在步骤级训练数据严重失衡下产生系统性高假阳性，从而误奖错误推理步骤的问题。
summary.importance: 这项工作重要在于它不是再做一个更强 PRM，而是指出 PRM 训练目标本身有偏：点式交叉熵会把“看起来合理但实际错误”的步骤打高分。对 RL、Best-of-N、guided decoding 乃至 RFT 的训练信号质量都有直接影响，属于 post-train 里很值得预训练研究员关注的接口问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PRISM，把 PRM 训练从点式标签拟合改成相对排序学习。核心做法包括：构造步骤级对比样本；用 temporal lookahead 生成 hard negatives；引入 difficulty-aware curriculum；并强调 policy-aware 训练，使 PRM 更关注会真实影响搜索与优化的误判类型，尤其压低 false positives。
summary.experiments: 论文比较标准 cross-entropy PRM 与 PRISM 在步骤判别、Best-of-N 选择、guided decoding 和策略优化中的差异。关键结论是 false positive 比 false negative 更伤下游，因为前者会主动把搜索和优化推向错误轨迹；PRISM 在不增加人工标注的前提下改善这一点。摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据量，需看正文确认 setup clean 不 clean。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a hidden bias in Process Reward Models: severe step-level label imbalance makes PRMs over-reward plausible but incorrect reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: The value here is not just a stronger PRM, but a critique of the standard PRM objective itself. If pointwise cross-entropy systematically inflates false positives, then the reward signal used in Best-of-N, guided decoding, and policy optimization is misaligned. That matters directly for the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRISM replaces pointwise label fitting with relative ranking. The method builds contrastive step-level comparisons, mines hard negatives with temporal lookahead, applies a difficulty-aware curriculum, and trains the PRM in a policy-aware way so it focuses on the mistakes that actually distort downstream search and optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares standard CE-trained PRMs against PRISM on step scoring and downstream use cases such as Best-of-N selection, guided decoding, and policy optimization. The key empirical claim is that false positives are much more damaging than false negatives because they actively steer search toward flawed trajectories. The abstract does not expose model scale or dataset size, so the cleanliness of the setup needs checking in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看，因为它把 PRM 问题从“分数准不准”改成“错奖会不会把策略带沟里”；先看 false positive 非对称伤害那组实验，再决定要不要复现 PRISM。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it reframes PRMs from raw accuracy to whether false positives actively poison search; read the asymmetric false-positive analysis first, then decide if PRISM is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component of post-training large language models (LLMs). In practice, LLM RL is often off-policy because of training-inference mismatch and policy staleness, making trust-region control essential for stable optimization. Mainstream methods such as PPO and GRPO approximate this control with a ratio-clipping mechanism, but the importance ratio can be a poor proxy for distributional shift in long-tailed vocabularies. Recent work such as DPPO addresses th

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM RL 中长尾词汇导致的分布偏移问题，改进 DPPO 中基于散度的硬掩码机制。
summary.importance: 方法创新。提出了一种新的散度正则化策略，用平滑的优势加权二次正则化取代了 DPPO 的硬掩码，在保持稳定性的同时提高了优化效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (DRPO)。它不直接丢弃超出信任域的 token 梯度（如 DPPO 的硬掩码），而是引入一个平滑的优势加权二次正则化项，惩罚策略偏移。这允许在有害方向上进行梯度修正，而不是简单地截断。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体实验细节，但声称在长尾词汇分布下比 PPO/GRPO/DPPO 更稳定有效。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自阿里等机构，关注 LLM 对齐和 RL 优化。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses distributional shift caused by long-tailed vocabularies in LLM RL, improving upon the divergence-based hard mask mechanism in DPPO.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation. Proposes a novel divergence regularization strategy, replacing DPPO's hard mask with a smooth advantage-weighted quadratic regularizer, improving optimization efficiency while maintaining stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (DRPO). Instead of discarding gradients for tokens outside the trust region (like DPPO's hard mask), it introduces a smooth advantage-weighted quadratic regularizer to penalize policy shift. This allows for gradient correction in harmful directions rather than simple truncation.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental details are not provided, but claims to be more stable and effective than PPO/GRPO/DPPO under long-tailed vocabulary distributions.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Alibaba and other institutions, focusing on LLM alignment and RL optimization.

recommendation.zh: 对 DPPO 信任域控制的改进，用平滑正则化替代硬截断，值得关注其在长尾 token 上的实际收益和训练稳定性。
recommendation.en: An improvement over DPPO's trust region control, replacing hard truncation with smooth regularization; worth noting its practical gains on long-tail tokens and training stability.

paper.title: Variational Proximal Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback via Proximal Policy Optimization often suffers from policy mode collapse, brittle exploration loops, and distribution drift. This paper introduces Variational Proximal Policy Optimization (\(\textsc{VP}_2\textsc{O}\)), a particle-based variational inference framework that maps policy optimization to Stein Variational Gradient Descent within a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. By leveraging functional kernels over localized expert prototypes alongside an

summary.core_problem: 解决RLHF中PPO算法普遍存在的策略模式崩溃、探索脆弱、分布漂移问题
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，首次将粒子变分推理与PPO结合，改进RLHF的策略优化稳定性
summary.technical_approach: 提出VP2O框架，将策略优化映射为MoE架构下的Stein变分梯度下降，引入局部专家原型的泛函核和专家正交损失，替代固定裁剪和KL调度的近端约束
summary.experiments: 在33B/4B稀疏MoE模型上验证，Codeforces上ELO提升179，AIME数学推理任务token数减少32%

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the common problems of policy mode collapse, brittle exploration, and distribution drift in PPO for RLHF
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation contribution, the first framework combining particle variational inference with PPO to improve policy optimization stability in RLHF
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose VP2O framework, map policy optimization to Stein Variational Gradient Descent under MoE architecture, introduce functional kernels over local expert prototypes and expert orthogonalization loss to replace fixed clipping and KL schedules for proximal control
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 33B/4B sparse MoE models, achieving +179 ELO gain on Codeforces and 32% token reduction on AIME mathematical reasoning tasks

recommendation.zh: 用变分推理改进PPO的近端约束设计，在推理任务上收益明显，重点看§3的专家正交损失和泛函核设计即可
recommendation.en: Improves PPO's proximal constraint design with variational inference, showing clear gains on reasoning tasks; focus on §3 for expert orthogonalization loss and functional kernel design.

paper.title: Multilingual Sentiment Aware Text Summarization A Reinforcement Learning Approach for Consistency Maintenance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has significantly improved the quality and fluency of large language models in text summarization. However, its impact on affective properties remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we study sentiment drift, a systematic shift toward neutral sentiment in RLHF-based summarization outputs compared to source texts. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple datasets, model architectures, and eight languages to analyze how alignment o

summary.core_problem: RLHF在提升文本摘要质量的同时，会导致生成摘要的情感倾向系统性地向“中性”偏移（情感漂移，Sentiment Drift）。
summary.importance: 系统性地量化并解释了RLHF对模型输出情感属性的副作用，揭示了对齐目标（特别是KL正则化）与情感保真度之间的trade-off，对理解RLHF的内在机制有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在多数据集、多架构、8种语言上进行广泛实验。引入“策略归因（Policy Attribution）”框架，分解RLHF目标函数，量化各组件的贡献。发现KL正则化是导致情感抑制的主要驱动力。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，情感漂移是一个一致的现象，且随着KL正则化强度的增加而增强。这表明在维持对齐稳定性与保持源文本情感之间存在权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: While RLHF improves text summarization quality, it causes a systematic shift in the sentiment of generated summaries towards 'neutral' (Sentiment Drift).
summary_en.importance: Systematically quantifies and explains the side effects of RLHF on the affective properties of model outputs, revealing the trade-off between alignment objectives (especially KL regularization) and affective fidelity, valuable for understanding RLHF mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conducted extensive experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and 8 languages. Introduced a 'Policy Attribution' framework to decompose the RLHF objective and quantify component contributions. Identified KL regularization as the primary driver of sentiment suppression.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show sentiment drift is a consistent phenomenon that strengthens with increased KL regularization, indicating a trade-off between alignment stability and preserving source text sentiment.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了RLHF中KL penalty会导致输出情感趋于中性的副作用，对理解RLHF的模式坍塌（mode collapse）和分布偏移有启发，做Post-train的同学可看其Policy Attribution分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the side effect of KL penalty in RLHF causing output sentiment to neutralize, inspiring for understanding mode collapse and distribution shift in RLHF. Post-train researchers should read its Policy Attribution analysis.

paper.title: The Neutral Mask: How RLHF Provides Shallow Alignment while Leaving Partisan Structure Intact in a Large Language Model
paper.abstract: The ambition behind alignment training is to make large language models safe and useful. The primary mechanism, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), shapes the behavior of deployed language models by aligning them with ``human values.'' Yet the process is opaque. What values are being encoded; whose values are they; and how does RLHF encode them? A growing body of evidence suggests that RLHF produces only functional compliance rather than deep alignment. We offer a mechanistic case

summary.core_problem: 分析 RLHF 到底改变了模型内部什么：它是否真正消除了政治倾向等潜在表征，还是只在输出层面做了表面中和。
summary.importance: 这类工作对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很关键。贡献不是提出新对齐算法，而是用机制分析说明 RLHF 可能主要学到“功能性服从”，没有重写 base model 的深层表征结构。这会影响我们如何理解 reward model、SFT/RL 的可逆性，以及对齐是否只是薄层覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 以 Llama 3.1 8B 的 base 与 RLHF 后版本做对比，研究 partisan political orientation 的内部表示。方法上结合内部表征比较与 sparse autoencoder（SAE）分解，追踪与政策/党派方向相关的特征在 RLHF 前后的激活变化。论文结论是：RLHF 没有删除结构化 partisan direction，而是压缩其方差，使输出更稳定地呈现平衡、非党派风格；同时一些在 base 中偶发激活的 policy-encoding features 在对齐后变为不活跃。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 Llama 3.1 8B 的 pre-RLHF 与 post-RLHF 版本，任务聚焦政治倾向相关输入。摘要没有给出大规模 benchmark 数字，重点是表征层面的 case study 和 SAE feature 级证据，因此更适合作为机制信号而不是普适结论。外推到其他模型家族和其他价值维度时需要谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what RLHF actually changes internally: does it remove latent political structure, or merely mask it at the output level?
summary_en.importance: This matters for the pretrain↔post-train interface. The contribution is not a new alignment algorithm but a mechanistic argument that RLHF may mostly induce functional compliance rather than rewriting deep internal representations. That has implications for how we think about reward models, reversibility of alignment, and whether alignment is a shallow overlay.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using pre- and post-RLHF versions of Llama 3.1 8B, the paper studies internal representations of partisan political orientation. It combines representation comparison with sparse autoencoder (SAE) decomposition to track policy- or partisan-related features before and after RLHF. The main claim is that RLHF does not erase the structured partisan direction; instead, it compresses its variance so outputs become more consistently balanced and non-partisan, while some sporadically active policy-encoding features go silent.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments center on Llama 3.1 8B before and after RLHF, with politically oriented prompts. The abstract does not present broad benchmark gains; the evidence is mainly a mechanistic case study plus SAE-level analysis. It is therefore more useful as a signal about alignment internals than as a universal empirical law.

recommendation.zh: 结论未必能外推，但“RLHF 压方差而非改表征”这个说法值得记住；只看方法图和 SAE 证据即可，别把它当普适定律。
recommendation.en: The claim may not generalize, but the framing that RLHF compresses variance rather than rewrites representations is worth keeping; read the SAE evidence, not the paper as a universal law.

paper.title: SHALA-LLM: Smartly Handling Ambiguous Labels in Aligning LLMs
paper.abstract: Many human-centered tasks, including natural language inference (NLI) and emotion recognition (ER), have multiple plausible interpretations, leading to label ambiguity and challenging disagreements across human annotators. As LLMs are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, faithfully modeling such ambiguity is essential to identify contested inputs, preserve variability in ambiguous cases, and capture the full distribution of human judgments. Yet, existing LLM alignment approaches have pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是一个在对齐里常被简化掉的问题：很多人类中心任务并不存在单一正确标签，标注分歧不是噪声，而是任务本身的一部分。尤其在 NLI、情感识别这类主观性较强的任务里，把多标注者分布压成 majority vote，会丢掉不确定性结构，也会让模型学成“过度自信的单点分类器”。作者要解决的是：如何在 LLM 对齐训练中，直接利用 annotator disagreement，而不是只在推理时做 uncertainty elicitation 或后处理校准。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线的直接影响有限，因为它更接近 post-train / alignment；但它触及一个很重要的训练信号问题：当监督本身是分布而不是点标签时，优化目标应该如何改写。这个问题不只存在于主观任务，也存在于偏好学习、奖励建模、合成数据筛选和多答案推理监督里。论文的启发在于，它没有把歧义当成要清洗掉的脏数据，而是把高分歧样本视为更有信息密度的训练样本，并通过 reward reweighting 让模型显式学习“人类判断分布”。如果把这个思路往更通用的 LLM 训练接口上推，可以联想到 distributional preference learning、uncertainty-aware SFT/RL，以及对 reasoning 任务中多条可接受解路径的建模。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 SHALA-LLM，一个基于 GRPO 的 ambiguity-aware distributional alignment 框架。输入不是单一标签，而是由多位标注者形成的经验标签分布。模型也不是输出一个类别，而是生成 verbalized distribution，也就是用文本形式给出各候选类别的概率分配。作者选择这种形式，是因为它能直接复用通用 LLM 的生成接口，不必额外加分类头，同时可以把“预测不确定性”作为语言输出的一部分。

训练上，作者把 LLM 视为 policy，对每个样本采样多个 rollout。每个 rollout 解析成一个预测分布，再与真实 annotator distribution 比较，得到 reward。SHALA 的关键不只是用分布匹配 reward，而是根据样本的歧义程度动态重加权 reward，使高歧义样本在优化中占更大权重。直观上，这相当于告诉模型：在大家都一致的样本上，学会主标签就够了；在意见分裂的样本上，重点不是押中某个单标签，而是学会保留多种 plausible interpretation 的概率质量。作者把这一点嵌入 GRPO 的 group-based rollout 优化里，而不是做普通监督学习下的 soft label cross-entropy。

从与现有方法的区别看，论文主要区别于三类路线。第一类是 majority vote 或 label smoothing 式训练，它们仍然默认存在一个主真值，只是在局部做平滑。SHALA 直接把目标改成 annotator distribution。第二类是 inference-time uncertainty elicitation，只在测试时让模型报概率或多答案，但训练目标没变。SHALA 把分布学习放进训练过程。第三类是一般的 distributional alignment 或 pluralistic alignment 工作，往往强调多视角输出，但未必显式利用样本级 annotator disagreement 来调节优化强度。SHALA 的“smart handling”主要体现在这个动态加权机制上。

不过也要看到方法边界。它依赖多标注者分布，适用场景天然受限；verbalized distribution 还涉及文本解析误差和概率校准问题；GRPO 相比直接监督学习训练成本更高，是否值得要看任务规模和歧义密度。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 ChaosNLI、GoEmotions 和 MSP-Podcast，分别对应歧义敏感的自然语言推断和情感识别任务。作者同时看了分布对齐指标和常规分类指标，这一点是合理的，因为只看 F1 会掩盖模型是否真的学到了不确定性结构。

结果上，ChaosNLI 提升最明显：Jensen-Shannon Distance 下降 62.1%，F1 提升 16.6%。这说明模型不仅更接近人类标注分布，而且在离散分类上也没有因为“保留歧义”而变差，反而更好。MSP-Podcast 上 JSD 下降 6.2%，F1 提升 29.2%，分类收益更大，分布收益相对温和，可能说明语音情感任务里类别边界更复杂，保留分歧有助于避免错误塌缩到单标签。摘要没有给出 GoEmotions 的具体数字，但正文表述是持续优于 majority-label supervision。

作者还做了几类分析。第一，高歧义条件下收益更强，符合方法设计预期：如果样本本来就接近单标签，SHALA 的优势不会特别大。第二，对“天然模糊”的语义类别收益更明显，说明模型确实在学习多解释空间，而不是简单做温度变软。第三，模型会表现出更符合不确定性的 reasoning 行为，也就是在输出中更愿意承认多种可能解释。这一点如果有案例分析，会比单纯指标更能说明问题。

从实验解读上，最值得留意的是：JSD 改善是否来自更好的分布建模，还是来自更保守、更平均化的输出。论文声称分类指标也同步提升，这在一定程度上排除了“只会报均匀分布”的坏解，但仍建议读者细看消融，确认动态加权项、reward 设计和 verbalized distribution 解析各自贡献了多少。另一个需要关注的是 rollout 数量、group size 和 reward 方差对训练稳定性的影响，这些通常是 GRPO 类方法的关键超参。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看问题定义和 Figure 1，确认作者到底在优化什么：不是单标签准确率，而是 annotator distribution 对齐。然后看方法部分里 empirical label distribution、verbalized distribution prediction 和基于 GRPO 的 reward 设计，尤其是“按歧义程度动态重加权”这一段，这是方法真正的新意。实验部分优先看主表里的 JSD/F1 结果，再看高歧义子集、类别级分析和案例分析，用来判断模型是否真的学会表达不确定性。若只想抓住主要思想，20 到 30 分钟足够；如果想把它迁移到 preference learning 或 reward modeling，建议再细看附录里的目标函数细节和训练超参。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training-signal problem that is usually collapsed away in LLM alignment: many human-centered tasks do not have a single correct label. In tasks such as NLI and emotion recognition, annotator disagreement is often part of the phenomenon rather than annotation noise. Standard pipelines reduce multiple annotations to a majority label, which discards uncertainty structure and trains the model to behave like an overconfident point classifier. The paper asks how to align an LLM directly to annotator disagreement during training, instead of only eliciting uncertainty at inference time or applying post-hoc calibration.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance is stronger for post-training than for pretraining, but the underlying lesson is broader: when supervision is inherently distributional rather than point-valued, the objective should reflect that. This matters not only for subjective classification tasks, but also for preference learning, reward modeling, synthetic-data filtering, and reasoning tasks with multiple acceptable solution paths. The useful idea here is to treat ambiguous examples as informative rather than dirty. SHALA-LLM gives higher training influence to samples with richer disagreement structure and explicitly optimizes toward human judgment distributions. That makes it relevant to uncertainty-aware alignment and distributional supervision more generally.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, SHALA-LLM, is an ambiguity-aware distributional alignment framework built on top of GRPO. Instead of a single gold label, each example is represented by an empirical label distribution derived from multiple annotators. The model is asked to produce a verbalized distribution, meaning a textual output that specifies probabilities over candidate classes. This choice avoids adding a separate classifier head and lets the model express uncertainty through the same generative interface used by standard LLMs.

Training is formulated as policy optimization. For each sample, the model generates multiple rollouts. Each rollout is parsed into a predicted class distribution, which is then compared against the annotator distribution to produce a reward. The distinctive part of SHALA is not only that it uses a distributional reward, but that it dynamically reweights rewards according to the degree of annotator disagreement. Highly ambiguous samples receive greater influence during optimization. Intuitively, the model is encouraged to do different things on different regions of the data: on low-ambiguity examples, it can concentrate on the dominant label; on high-ambiguity examples, it should preserve probability mass over multiple plausible interpretations rather than collapse to a single answer.

Relative to prior work, the paper differs from three common approaches. First, majority-vote or soft-label training still assumes a dominant truth and only smooths around it. SHALA makes the annotator distribution itself the target. Second, inference-time uncertainty elicitation asks the model to report probabilities or multiple answers at test time, but leaves the training objective unchanged. SHALA moves distribution learning into optimization. Third, broader pluralistic or distributional alignment work often focuses on diverse outputs without explicitly using sample-level disagreement to modulate training strength. The “smart handling” in SHALA is precisely this ambiguity-aware reweighting.

There are clear boundaries. The method requires multi-annotator distributions, so applicability depends on data collection. Verbalized distributions introduce parsing and calibration issues. And GRPO is more expensive than direct supervised learning, so the cost-benefit tradeoff depends on task scale and ambiguity density.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use ChaosNLI, GoEmotions, and MSP-Podcast, covering ambiguity-sensitive NLI and emotion recognition. The evaluation includes both distributional metrics and standard classification metrics, which is the right choice here because F1 alone would not reveal whether the model actually learned human uncertainty.

The strongest reported gain is on ChaosNLI: Jensen-Shannon Distance is reduced by 62.1%, while F1 improves by 16.6%. That is important because it suggests the model is not merely becoming softer; it is getting closer to the human label distribution while also improving discrete prediction quality. On MSP-Podcast, JSD drops by 6.2% and F1 improves by 29.2%. The classification gain is larger there, while the distributional gain is more modest, possibly reflecting a harder label geometry in speech emotion data where preserving ambiguity prevents harmful collapse to a single class. The abstract does not provide the exact GoEmotions numbers, but the paper claims consistent improvements over majority-label supervision.

The analysis appears to support the intended mechanism. Gains are larger under high-ambiguity conditions, which matches the design of the weighting scheme. Benefits are stronger for inherently ambiguous semantic categories, suggesting the model is learning multi-interpretation structure rather than simply outputting flatter distributions. The paper also reports more uncertainty-aware reasoning behavior, meaning the model is more willing to acknowledge multiple plausible interpretations in its outputs.

The main thing to check when reading the experiments is whether the JSD improvement comes from genuinely better distribution modeling or from overly conservative predictions. The concurrent F1 gains argue against the trivial “predict a bland average distribution” failure mode, but the ablations still matter. In particular, readers should inspect how much of the gain comes from the ambiguity-based weighting itself, how rewards are defined, and how robust the method is to rollout count, group size, and reward variance, which are often critical in GRPO-style training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the problem setup and Figure 1 to understand that the target is annotator-distribution alignment rather than single-label accuracy. Then read the method section carefully around three pieces: empirical label distributions, verbalized distribution prediction, and the GRPO reward design. The key novelty is the ambiguity-aware dynamic reweighting, so that part deserves the most attention. In the experiments, first inspect the main JSD and F1 tables, then move to the high-ambiguity subsets, category-level analyses, and qualitative examples to see whether the model truly learns to represent uncertainty. A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough to capture the main idea; if you want to adapt it to preference learning or reward modeling, spend more time on the appendix for objective details and training hyperparameters.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain，但会改你看待 preference signal 的方式：别再默认单标签干净，先看它如何把 ambiguity 变成训练信号；只读方法和消融即可。
recommendation.en: It won’t change pretraining directly, but it may change how you treat preference signals: stop assuming collapsed labels are clean; read the method and ablations only.

paper.title: Safety Paradox: How Enhanced Safety Awareness Leaves LLMs Vulnerable to Posterior Attack
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rigorously aligned to refuse harmful requests, a process that inherently cultivates a latent capacity to evaluate and recognize unsafe content. In this work, we reveal that this advanced safety awareness inadvertently introduces a fatal vulnerability. We introduce Posterior Attack, a single-query jailbreak that bypasses guardrails by prompting the model to generate the exact harmful response its internal classifier would normally flag as unsafe. Through extensive

summary.core_problem: 对齐良好的 LLM 具备强大的内部安全判别能力，但这种能力反而可以被利用，通过让模型生成“会被其内部判别器标记为不安全”的回复来绕过安全护栏。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 安全对齐中的一个结构性漏洞（安全悖论）：模型的安全判别能力越强，越容易受到后验攻击（Posterior Attack）。这挑战了现有的安全对齐范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Posterior Attack，一种无需搜索的单次查询越狱方法。传统攻击试图最大化生成有害回复的先验概率，而 Posterior Attack 利用模型的评估能力，通过 prompt 引导模型模拟后验概率：生成一个会被其内部安全分类器标记为有害的回复。通过贝叶斯推断形式化了“安全悖论”。
summary.experiments: 在 30 个开源 LLM 和前沿闭源模型（如 GPT-5-Chat, Claude Sonnet 4.6）上进行了评估，发现安全判别准确率与后验攻击成功率呈强正相关。通过 GRPO 强化学习实验证实：人为降低模型的安全判别能力可以免疫该攻击，而提高判别能力则会加剧漏洞。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Posterior Attack 的 prompt 设计思想（Figure 1 和 Table 7）以及 Safety Paradox 的贝叶斯推断解释。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Well-aligned LLMs possess strong internal safety judgment capabilities, but this very capability can be exploited to bypass safety guardrails by prompting the model to generate a response that its internal discriminator would flag as unsafe.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a structural vulnerability in LLM safety alignment (the Safety Paradox): the stronger a model's safety judgment capability, the more susceptible it is to Posterior Attack. This challenges current safety alignment paradigms.
