- In the method section, focus on the two-stage pipeline (offline artifact construction vs online scoring) and how the three reward components are normalized and combined.
- For practical adoption, inspect how the task-label classifier is used, what kinds of constraints are compiled into checkers, and how rubric dimensions are designed to avoid superficial heuristics.
- To decide whether to go deeper, verify in the results section whether offline ranking improvements correlate with online RL gains, and check the ablations over rubric/global/code components.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该从训练信号角度看：不是新 RL 算法，而是把 reward 写清楚；若你在做 open-ended RL，先复现 rubric+checker 分解再谈更复杂优化。
recommendation.en: Read this as a training-signal paper, not an RL-algorithm paper: it makes rewards explicit; if you do open-ended RL, reproduce the rubric+checker decomposition before chasing fancier optimization.

paper.title: A Predictive Law for On-Policy Self-Distillation From World Feedback
paper.abstract: Moving beyond simple scalar rewards toward richer world feedback is a natural path to more scalable RL post-training. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising recent approach that uses arbitrary feedback as learning signal, yet its reliability compared to established methods, such as GRPO, remains unclear. We identify a strikingly consistent linear correlation between the initial student-self-teacher performance gap and the final performance improvement in OPSD. This relationship holds

summary.core_problem: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）作为大语言模型后训练方法，其效果高度依赖特权上下文的设计，当前缺乏可预测的方法来提前判断不同配置的有效性，必须运行完整训练才能验证，试错成本高、稳定性差。
summary.importance: 给出了可提前筛选OPSD后训练配置的低成本方法，无需运行完整训练即可预估效果，降低后训练试错成本，也为自蒸馏类后训练的作用机制提供了实证支撑。
summary.technical_approach: OPSD使用和学生模型共享指数移动平均（EMA）权重的自教师，给自教师提供学生无法访问的特权上下文（如环境反馈、参考片段等），通过反向KL散度让学生拟合自教师的分布。核心发现是训练前学生和自教师的初始性能差（学生-自教师gap）与最终学生的性能提升呈强线性相关。
summary.experiments: 在LiveCodeBench基准上开展OPSD后训练实验，覆盖Qwen3（0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B）和Olmo3-7B两个模型家族，测试6种不同特权上下文配置。初始gap与最终性能提升的线性相关R²在Qwen3-8B达0.949，Olmo3-7B达0.996；该线性关系跨特权上下文类型、跨模型家族、跨模型尺寸均保持一致；训练过程中学生性能会逐步收敛到自教师的水平。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言中OPSD的现存问题梳理，实验部分的相关性验证结果和跨尺度实验结论。预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The effectiveness of On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a post-training method for large language models, is highly dependent on the design of privileged context. There is no predictable method to evaluate the effectiveness of different configurations in advance, and full training runs are required for validation, leading to high trial-and-error cost and poor stability.
summary_en.importance: It provides a low-cost method to screen OPSD post-training configurations in advance, enabling performance estimation without full training runs and reducing post-training trial-and-error cost. It also provides empirical support for understanding the mechanism of self-distillation based post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPSD uses a self-teacher that shares exponential moving average (EMA) weights with the student model. The self-teacher is conditioned on privileged context unavailable to the student (such as environment feedback, reference snippets), and the student is trained to fit the self-teacher's distribution via reverse KL divergence. The core finding is that the initial performance gap between the student and self-teacher before training has a strong linear correlation with the final performance improvement of the student.
summary_en.experiments: OPSD post-training experiments are conducted on the LiveCodeBench benchmark, covering two model families: Qwen3 (0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B) and Olmo3-7B, with 6 different privileged context configurations. The linear correlation R² between initial gap and final performance improvement reaches 0.949 for Qwen3-8B and 0.996 for Olmo3-7B. This linear relationship holds consistently across privileged context types, model families, and model scales. Student performance gradually converges to the self-teacher's level during training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the review of existing OPSD limitations in the introduction, the correlation validation results and cross-scale experiment conclusions in the experiments section. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 若线性律测量干净，应在内部 OPSD/RLVR ablation 复现；先读实验矩阵和失败案例，别只看拟合线。
recommendation.en: If the linear law is measured cleanly, reproduce it in internal OPSD/RLVR ablations; read the experiment matrix and failures, not just the fit line.

paper.title: RUBRIC-ARROW: Alternating Pointwise Rubric Reward Modeling for LLM Post-training in Non-verifiable Domains
paper.abstract: Pointwise reward modeling offers critical signals for LLM post-training, yet struggles with absolute scoring in subjective, non-verifiable settings. Rubric-based methods address this by decomposing evaluation into explicit criteria, but existing approaches typically depend on frontier LLMs and suffer from ties caused by hard Boolean aggregation. We present RUBRIC-ARROW, an alternating framework that jointly trains a rubric generator and a rubric-conditioned judge, with its RL stage using only pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决非可验证任务中的 reward modeling 问题：开放式指令跟随和聊天任务很难用单一整体分数稳定评价，而 rubric-based evaluator 又常依赖外部强模型生成标准和打分，成本高、可控性弱，也不容易作为独立 reward model 部署。
summary.importance: 它更偏 post-training，但和预训练研究的接口在于训练信号质量。非可验证任务里的 reward 噪声会直接影响 SFT/RL 的方向，并间接影响数据合成、持续训练和模型行为评估。Rubric-ARROW 的贡献是把 rubric 生成器和 rubric-conditioned judge 都训练成内部模块，并尽量只依赖 pairwise preference 数据。这个方向有助于减少对外部 judge 的依赖，也让 pointwise reward 更容易进入 DPO、GRPO 等后续优化流程。
summary.technical_approach: 框架包含两个模块。rubric generator 根据 instruction 生成 K 条评价标准；rubric-conditioned judge 在给定 instruction、response 和 rubric 后，对每条标准输出是否满足以及解释；criterion-level 判断再聚合成 pointwise scalar score。传统 Boolean 聚合容易产生大量 tied scores，区分度不足。论文提出 probability-based scoring rule，用更平滑的标准满足概率替代硬 0/1 聚合，从而给偏好学习和策略优化提供更细粒度信号。训练分两阶段：先做较短 SFT warm-up，再在 pairwise preference 数据上交替做 RL。judge 阶段使用偏好一致的奖励训练打分器；rubric 阶段训练标准生成器，使其产生更能区分 preferred 与 rejected response 的评价标准。优化上使用 alternating GRPO，并给出 preference consistency、opposite-side averaging 降低方差、phase-wise convergence 的理论分析。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 reward modeling benchmark 和下游 policy post-training。论文报告 Rubric-ARROW 相比强基线平均提升 3.0%。更重要的实验点是两类：一是 reward model 自身的评价能力，验证 probability-based rubric score 比硬 Boolean 聚合更少出现平分并有更强区分度；二是把学到的 evaluator 用于 DPO 或 GRPO 后，观察下游策略是否获得稳定收益。提供内容没有给出具体模型规模、数据量、benchmark 名称和逐项表格，因此不补充未显示的数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。优先看 Method 中 probability-based scoring、phase-specific reward 和 alternating GRPO 三部分；理论部分只需确认假设条件是否贴近真实偏好数据。实验部分重点看消融：去掉概率打分、去掉交替训练、只训练 judge 或只训练 rubric generator 时的变化。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是 reward 信号如何从 pairwise preference 转换成可部署的 pointwise evaluator，而不是具体聊天 benchmark 的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward modeling for non-verifiable domains such as open-ended instruction following and chat. A single holistic score is often unreliable, while rubric-based evaluators commonly depend on external frontier models for rubric generation or judging, making them expensive, hard to control, and less suitable as standalone reward models.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining research through the quality of training signals. Noisy rewards in non-verifiable domains affect SFT and RL behavior, and also influence data generation, continual training, and model evaluation loops. Rubric-ARROW’s main contribution is to train both the rubric generator and the rubric-conditioned judge as internal components, using pairwise preference data in the RL stage. This reduces dependence on external judges and produces a pointwise reward that can be plugged into downstream algorithms such as DPO and GRPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two modules. A rubric generator samples a set of criteria from the instruction. A rubric-conditioned judge evaluates a candidate response against these criteria, producing criterion-level judgments and rationales. These judgments are aggregated into a scalar pointwise reward. The paper identifies a weakness of hard Boolean aggregation: many responses collapse to tied scores, which weakens the reward signal. It replaces this with a probability-based scoring rule that uses smoother criterion-level satisfaction probabilities. Training has a short SFT warm-up followed by alternating RL on pairwise preferences. In the judge phase, the reward encourages preference-consistent scoring. In the rubric-generator phase, the reward encourages criteria that better distinguish preferred from rejected responses. The optimization uses alternating GRPO. The paper also provides analyses for preference consistency, variance reduction through opposite-side averaging, and phase-wise convergence.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover reward modeling benchmarks and downstream policy post-training. The reported average gain over strong baselines is 3.0%. The key empirical questions are whether probability-based rubric scores reduce ties and improve discrimination compared with hard Boolean aggregation, and whether the learned pointwise evaluator improves downstream DPO or GRPO training. The provided content does not include model sizes, data scale, benchmark names, or per-task tables, so more specific numerical claims should not be added.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Read the method sections on probability-based scoring, phase-specific rewards, and alternating GRPO. The theory is useful mainly for checking whether the assumptions match real preference data. In the experiments, focus on ablations: removing probabilistic scoring, removing alternating training, or training only the judge or only the rubric generator. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful part is the conversion of pairwise preferences into a deployable pointwise reward signal, not the exact ranking on chat benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 对做RLHF/奖励建模的研究者有参考价值：交替训练量规生成器与评判器的思路可用于缓解主观领域的评分困难，重点看§3.2的概率评分规则。
recommendation.en: Useful for RLHF/reward modeling researchers: the alternating rubric generator-judge training idea helps mitigate scoring difficulties in subjective domains; focus on §3.2's probabilistic scoring rule.

paper.title: In-Context Reward Adaptation for Robust Preference Modeling
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) typically relies on static reward models to align Large Language Models with human preferences. However, human values are inherently diverse and heterogeneous, and a single reward model often lacks the robustness required to generalize to unseen preference domains. While existing multi-reward frameworks attempt to address this, they are often restricted to a fixed set of known domains and fail to adapt to unseen human distributions without costly

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是偏好建模在分布外人群和新偏好域上的适应问题。传统 RLHF 通常把不同人的偏好压到一个静态 reward model 里；multi-reward 方法虽然更灵活，但需要预先定义偏好类型，遇到新用户或新域仍要训练或重训。作者进一步指出，直接把少量 pairwise preference 作为 in-context examples 喂给 Transformer，并不能可靠恢复新的 reward function，因为二元比较只给出方向信息，缺少偏好强度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有启发。核心信息是：偏好数据的形式会限制 reward model 的可识别性，后续 RL 或 DPO 类训练并不能自动弥补这个缺陷。论文把 response time 作为额外行为信号引入 reward modeling，说明对齐数据不应只看 chosen/rejected，还可以记录判断难度、犹豫程度等弱连续信号。这对构造更稳的偏好数据管线、个性化 reward model、以及减少 reward misspecification 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 In-Context Reward Adaptation。它把一个用户或一个偏好分布下的少量历史判断作为上下文，让 Transformer 在推理时推断当前偏好的隐含 reward 参数，而不是为每类偏好单独训练一个 reward model。论文的关键点不是简单使用 ICL，而是证明仅有二元比较标签时存在不可识别性：不同 reward 参数可能产生相同的 pairwise choice 分布，模型即使容量足够、训练数据足够，也无法无偏适应未知偏好。为了解决这个问题，作者引入 human response time。直觉是，两个候选答案差距很大时，人判断更快；差距接近时，反应更慢。这个信号补上了偏好强度信息。技术上，它借鉴认知决策模型，把 response time 和 reward margin 联系起来，使 reward 参数在理论上可识别。和已有 multi-reward 或 few-shot personalized reward modeling 的区别在于，它不要求预定义偏好簇，也不通过梯度更新适配新用户，而是在上下文中完成 reward 推断。
summary.experiments: 论文在合成数据和真实人类决策数据上验证该结论。合成实验主要用于检查理论预测：只用 binary comparison 的 in-context reward model 在分布外偏好上存在系统偏差；加入 response time 后，模型能更稳定地恢复未见过的 reward 结构。真实数据实验用于说明 response time 不是只在人工设定中有效，它在真实人类选择行为里也能提供额外信息。给出的全文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不适合复述具体提升幅度。更可靠的读法是关注实验是否把三类方法分开比较：静态 reward model、只用 pairwise label 的 in-context model、加入 response time 的 in-context model；以及这些方法在 seen preference 和 unseen preference 上的差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，理论部分里关于 binary preference 不可识别性的命题，这是论文最有信息量的地方；第二，response time 如何被形式化为 reward margin 的观测信号，尤其要看模型假设是否过强；第三，synthetic 到 real-world human decision-making 的实验设置，看真实数据里的 response time 是否足够干净。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可以跳过多数 Transformer 架构细节，把它当作 reward-data quality 和 posttrain signal design 的论文来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how reward models can adapt to unseen human preference distributions without retraining. A single static reward model averages over heterogeneous users, while multi-reward systems require the preference domains to be specified in advance. The paper also makes a sharper point: naive in-context learning from pairwise preference labels is not enough, because binary choices carry direction but not reliable information about preference strength.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface than to pretraining recipes themselves. Its main lesson is that the format of feedback data can impose an identifiability limit on reward learning. If the reward signal is under-specified, later RLHF-style optimization cannot fully repair it. The use of response time as an auxiliary behavioral signal is a useful reminder that preference pipelines may need richer annotations than chosen/rejected pairs, especially for personalized reward models and distribution-shifted alignment settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework, In-Context Reward Adaptation, conditions a Transformer reward model on a small set of preference demonstrations from a user or preference distribution. At inference time, the model is expected to infer the latent reward structure from the context, rather than updating parameters or selecting from a fixed bank of reward models. The key technical claim is negative first: with only binary pairwise labels, unseen reward parameters are not identifiable in general. Different latent rewards can induce the same observed choices. The paper then adds human response time, motivated by cognitive decision models where easier decisions tend to be faster and near-ties tend to be slower. Response time gives a proxy for reward margin, complementing the direction supplied by the binary label. This changes the adaptation problem from under-specified comparison learning to a better-constrained latent reward inference problem.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover synthetic preference settings and real human decision-making data. The synthetic experiments are used to test the theory: in-context models trained only on binary comparisons remain biased under preference shift, while adding response time improves recovery of unseen reward structures. The real-data experiments test whether response time remains informative outside a controlled simulator. The provided full text does not include the complete result tables, so exact numerical gains should not be inferred here. The most important comparisons are between a static reward model, an in-context model with binary labels only, and an in-context model augmented with response time, especially under unseen preference distributions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the impossibility or non-identifiability result for binary preferences, then read the response-time modeling section to check the assumptions linking latency to reward margin. The experimental section is useful mainly for seeing whether the synthetic result survives on real human decision data. For LLM pretraining researchers, the paper is best read as a signal-quality and reward-modeling paper, not as a core pretraining method paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看理论设定和 bias 证明；若成立，应影响 reward model 是否用固定头做偏好泛化。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and the bias proof; if it holds, it changes how safe it is to use a fixed reward head for preference generalization.

paper.title: From Context Shift to Stylistic Collapse: Why Training Objectives Matter More Than Scale
paper.abstract: In modern LLMs, linguistic features function not as stylistic artifacts but as probes of probability mass, allocated under training alignment objectives. Language models trained with contemporary pipelines exhibit severe reshaping of linguistic features, leading to extreme language re-distribution. While previous stylometric analyses explored linguistic differences between AI-generated and human texts, we focus on the reshaping plaguing the LLM training pipeline itself. We analyze 17 models (410

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 生成文本中的风格分布偏移：哪些语言特征被放大，哪些被压低，以及这种偏移主要来自训练目标、部署上下文和生成动态，还是来自模型规模或 RLHF。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续训练的启发在于，生成分布不能简单等同于训练语料的边际分布。模型在部署时经常被置于解释、总结、建议这类窄上下文中，实际采样的是条件分布切片；再叠加低熵生成状态，某些格式和话语标记会自我强化。这会影响合成数据回流、instruction 数据构造、风格去重和退火阶段的数据设计。论文也提醒，规模增大不一定修复风格坍缩，弱正则甚至可能加剧问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义一组 24 个语言特征，覆盖标点、话语标记、结构元素和语气标记，并用 amplification ratio 比较模型生成文本与人类基线语料中的频率。机制解释有两部分：context shift 指部署 prompt 更常触发正式说明文条件分布；absorbing stylistic states 指某些低熵特征一旦出现，会限制后续生成，使列表、总结性短语、模板化结构继续出现。论文还实验了 entropy regularization，强调控制强度：过弱干预可能把模型推入更不自然的局部模式，较强干预才有缓解效果。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 17 个模型，规模从 410M 到 100B+，包括 Pythia、OLMo、Llama、Mistral、Gemma 以及 GPT、Claude、Gemini 系列 API。作者报告 instruction-tuned 系统在话语和结构维度出现大幅重分布：平均放大范围为 1,949% 到 16,853%，峰值为 5,181% 到 209,675%。四组 base-instruct 对比显示差异不显著，p > 0.25，用来支持“RLHF 不是主要放大源”的结论。具体特征上，“delve into”为 3,660%，“in conclusion”为 5,048%，numbered lists 为 1,949%，bullet points 为 3,063%；分号下降 96.8%，em dash 下降 81.6%。正则实验中 λ=1.0 使 divergence 增加 240%，λ=5.0 带来 40.5% 改善，并在该指标上比若干前沿 API 低 96.7%–98.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看特征定义和 amplification ratio，确认基线语料、prompt 分布和生成参数是否合理；再看 base-instruct 配对实验，因为这是区分预训练、指令微调和 RLHF 影响的关键证据。entropy regularization 部分值得看消融，尤其是 λ=1.0 变差、λ=5.0 变好的现象。读时需要保留一个疑问：用全局人类语料边际分布作为基线，会天然惩罚“解释型回答”这种部署条件分布，因此机制解释比绝对 divergence 数值更有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies stylistic redistribution in LLM outputs: which linguistic features are amplified or suppressed, and whether the effect is driven by scale, RLHF, deployment context, or generation objectives.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson for pretraining is that generated text should not be compared naively to the marginal distribution of the training corpus. In deployment, models are often prompted into a narrow slice of the data distribution, such as explanatory or advisory prose. Once generation enters low-entropy stylistic states, structural markers and discourse phrases can reinforce themselves. This matters for synthetic-data feedback loops, instruction-data design, deduplication by style, and late-stage training mixtures. The paper also argues that scale alone does not remove the effect, and that weak regularization can make it worse.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define 24 linguistically motivated probes spanning punctuation, discourse markers, structural elements, and tone markers. They measure an amplification ratio between feature frequency in model generations and a human-text baseline. Their mechanism has two parts. Context shift means that deployment prompts sample from formal, expository conditional distributions rather than the full training distribution. Absorbing stylistic states mean that once a low-entropy feature appears, it constrains subsequent generation toward similar structures. They also test entropy regularization and emphasize control strength: a weak intervention can increase divergence, while a stronger one can reduce it.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 17 models from 410M to 100B+ parameters, including Pythia, OLMo, Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and API models from GPT, Claude, and Gemini families. Reported amplification in discourse and structural features ranges from 1,949% to 16,853% on average, with peaks between 5,181% and 209,675%. Four base-instruct pairs show statistically indistinguishable divergence with p > 0.25, supporting the claim that RLHF is not the primary source. Individual examples include “delve into” at 3,660%, “in conclusion” at 5,048%, numbered lists at 1,949%, and bullet points at 3,063%; semicolons are reduced by 96.8% and em dashes by 81.6%. In the regularization experiments, λ=1.0 increases divergence by 240%, while λ=5.0 improves it by 40.5% and yields substantially lower divergence than several large API systems under the paper’s metric.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the feature definitions and the amplification-ratio metric, then check the human baseline, prompt distribution, and decoding settings. The base-versus-instruct comparisons are the most important evidence for separating pretraining effects from alignment effects. The entropy-regularization ablation is also worth reading, especially the failure of weak control. The main caveat is metric choice: comparing outputs to a global human-text marginal distribution can penalize legitimate explanatory responses, so the mechanism is more informative than the absolute divergence numbers.

recommendation.zh: 数字很激进，先看模型配对和 probe 定义；若 setup 干净，应把 style collapse 纳入 SFT 数据质检。
recommendation.en: The numbers are aggressive; inspect model pairing and probe definitions first, but a clean setup would make style collapse a useful SFT data-quality check.

paper.title: Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Model Internals from Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Model internals encode rich information about how a large language model (LLM) processes its training data; however, post-training data engineering largely relies on external signals and ignores rich intrinsic signals lying in model internals. We propose SAERL, a data engineering framework for LLM reinforcement learning (RL). It models three intrinsic data properties: diversity, difficulty, and quality, using model internals extracted with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE), an advanced mechanistic interp

summary.core_problem: 在 RL post-training 的数据工程里（选哪些样本、怎么排 curriculum、怎么组 batch），主流做法依赖外部信号（偏好标注、verifier、pass rate、启发式难度等），成本高且覆盖不全。论文要解决的问题是：能否直接用模型内部表征（尤其是 SAE 提取的稀疏特征激活）来刻画“多样性/难度/质量”三类内禀数据属性，并把它们落成可执行的数据工程操作，从而提升 RL 训练效率与最终效果。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对“pretrain ↔ posttrain 闭环”有现实意义：它把 mechanistic interpretability 工具（SAE）变成可用的训练信号，用于替代/补充昂贵外部信号的数据筛选与课程学习。启发点在于：1）内部表征可作为数据属性的统一接口（diversity/difficulty/quality），比表面统计更贴近模型真实学习状态；2）如果该信号稳定，未来可能迁移到 continual pretrain / mid-train 的数据调度与退火阶段。整体贡献量级属于“工程可落地的信号源扩展”，而不是提出新的 RL 算法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法框架 SaeRL 把 SAE 激活空间当作数据工程的坐标系，并将三类属性分别对应到三类操作：
1）质量（quality）→ 过滤：训练一个基于 SAE 表征的 quality probe，用来把原始数据池过滤到更接近目标分布（论文动机是：表面特征如长度、TeX 比例、step 数只能部分反映质量；SAE 激活能更直接反映“是否像目标推理分布”）。
2）难度（difficulty）→ curriculum：用 SAE 表征训练回归器（文中用 ElasticNet）预测连续难度分数；然后在每个语义簇内做“easy-to-hard”的局部轨迹排序。这里的关键取舍是：不做全局单调 curriculum（容易把不同技能混在一起导致局部不连贯），而是“先聚类再局部排序”，让难度递进发生在相近技能/语义区域。
3）多样性（diversity）→ batching：先在 SAE 空间聚类得到多个簇，再跨簇交错取 batch 以覆盖更多特征区域；同时做“moderate batch mixing”（从相邻 batch 交换一小段 tail 样本）在不破坏 batch 内一致性的前提下增加覆盖。这里隐含的训练动态假设是：RL 更新对 batch 组成很敏感，过度混合会让梯度方向噪声变大，完全不混合又会导致模式坍缩/覆盖不足。
动机实验部分还验证了 SAE 表征确实携带可用信号：用线性 probe 预测 DeepMath 的 topic label（含 82 个 leaf topics）显著优于 majority baseline；难度回归在分布外仍保留正相关信号，说明不是简单长度/主题代理。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的总体结论是：在数学推理 RL post-training 上，SaeRL 在不同模型尺度与不同 RL 算法下都能提升性能与效率，并且三组件（过滤/课程/batching）各自有贡献（消融支持）。摘要里提到平均准确率提升约 3.00%。
从全文已给出的细节看，关键支撑实验包括：
- 表征可用性验证：SAE 特征用于 topic 线性分类（DeepMath，多粒度标签，含 82 leaf topics）显著优于 majority baseline；
- 难度信号：ElasticNet 基于 SAE 表征预测连续难度分数，in-distribution 预测强，且在分布移位下仍保持正信号；
- 质量信号：以 PRM800K 等数据为例，论证 SAE 激活能区分目标分布样本与噪声/偏离样本（全文此处在截断内容后续应有具体指标与阈值策略）。
由于提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字（除 3% 提升外），参数量、训练步数、数据规模、不同 RL 算法的具体增益需要以论文表格为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Motivating Finding 的三组 probe（topic 预测、难度回归、质量区分）：这是“SAE 信号是否值得用”的证据链。
- 再看方法三步（filter → cluster+local curriculum → interleaved batching+moderate mixing）的具体实现细节：尤其是聚类粒度、难度校准方式、mixing 的比例与相邻 batch 定义。
- 最后看消融：三组件各自带来多少增益、是否存在交互（例如过滤是否改变难度分布，进而影响 curriculum）。
如果只想判断是否可迁移到自家 pipeline：重点看 quality probe 的训练数据来源与标注方式（是否仍依赖外部信号），以及 SAE 训练/提取的成本与稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: RL post-training performance is highly sensitive to data engineering (which samples to use, how to order them, and how to batch them), yet most pipelines rely on expensive external signals (human preferences, verifiers, pass rates, heuristic difficulty). The paper asks whether intrinsic signals from model internals—specifically sparse feature activations extracted by Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs)—can reliably model three data properties (diversity, difficulty, quality) and be turned into concrete, actionable operations for RL data engineering.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but relevant to the pretrain–posttrain loop: it operationalizes mechanistic interpretability artifacts (SAE features) as training-time signals for filtering, curriculum, and batching. The main value is pragmatic: a unified internal representation space that may reduce dependence on costly external supervision and better reflect what the model actually finds hard/easy or in-/out-of-distribution. If robust, the same idea could extend to continual pretraining or mid-training data scheduling, though this work focuses on RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SaeRL treats SAE activation space as the coordinate system for data engineering and maps three intrinsic properties to three operations:
1) Quality → filtering: train an SAE-based quality probe to filter a raw pool toward the target reasoning distribution (arguing surface heuristics like length/TeX ratio/step count are insufficient).
2) Difficulty → curriculum: train a regressor (ElasticNet) on SAE representations to predict a continuous difficulty score; then build curricula as local easy-to-hard trajectories within each SAE-space cluster (a deliberate choice over a single global curriculum to preserve skill/topic coherence).
3) Diversity → batching: cluster samples in SAE space, interleave batches across clusters to increase coverage, and apply “moderate batch mixing” by swapping a small tail portion between nearby batches—aiming to improve diversity without destroying within-batch coherence (important for stable RL gradients).
The motivating section supports the premise with probes: SAE features predict topic labels (DeepMath, including 82 leaf topics) well above a majority baseline; SAE-based difficulty prediction remains positively informative under distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is an average accuracy gain of about +3.00% on math reasoning RL post-training, reported to hold across model scales and RL algorithms, with ablations showing each component (filtering, curriculum, batching) contributes.
From the provided full-text excerpt, the key empirical pillars are:
- Topic/semantic structure: linear probes on SAE features predict DeepMath topic labels across granularities, including 82 leaf topics, outperforming majority baselines.
- Difficulty signal: ElasticNet regression from SAE features predicts in-distribution difficulty strongly and retains a positive signal under distribution shift.
- Quality signal: experiments (referencing PRM800K and others) argue SAE activations help separate target-distribution samples from noisy/OOD data (the excerpt is truncated before the detailed metrics).
Exact model sizes, dataset sizes, and per-setting deltas are not fully visible in the provided content and should be taken from the paper’s tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the “Motivating Finding” probes first; they are the justification for using SAE space at all.
- Then read the three-step pipeline details (quality probe training, clustering choices, difficulty calibration, and the batch interleaving/mixing rule).
- Finally, check ablations to see whether gains are additive or dominated by one component.
If evaluating adoption, focus on: (i) what supervision the quality probe needs (does it reintroduce external labels?), and (ii) the cost/stability of training and extracting SAE features at scale.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法和消融：若 SAE 信号真能稳定迁移，RL 数据选择不必只靠 reward 和外部标签。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: if SAE signals transfer robustly, RL data selection need not rely only on rewards and external labels.

paper.title: Beyond Pairwise Preferences: Listwise Reward-Aware Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as an efficient alternative to online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning text-to-image diffusion models. However, existing methods largely reduce supervision to binary pairwise comparisons. This pairwise reduction is limiting when training data naturally contains multiple candidate images for the same prompt, and when continuous reward scores can provide richer information than a single winner-loser label. To address these limitatio

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型偏好优化方法局限于二元成对比较，无法利用多候选图像的连续奖励分数提供的丰富信息。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出列表级奖励感知的扩散模型对齐范式，超越二元偏好框架。对文本RLHF从二元转向列表级有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR将同一prompt下多候选图像的奖励分数转换为中心化优势权重，优化优势加权的隐式奖励回归目标，并通过二次惩罚正则化隐式奖励的幅度。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上验证，相比二元偏好方法在多个维度（美学、人类偏好匹配）上取得更好的对齐效果。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学，Stefano Ermon（生成模型领域知名学者，diffusion alignment方向核心研究者）、Yisong Yue（ML知名学者）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion model preference optimization is limited to binary pairwise comparisons, wasting richer information from continuous reward scores across multiple candidate images per prompt.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes listwise reward-aware alignment paradigm for diffusion models, analogous to moving beyond binary preferences in text RLHF.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR converts reward scores across multiple candidates into centered advantage weights, optimizing an advantage-weighted regression objective on implicit reward with quadratic penalty regularization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-image generation, outperforming binary preference methods across multiple dimensions including aesthetics and human preference alignment.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University; Stefano Ermon (leading researcher in generative models and diffusion alignment), Yisong Yue (prominent ML researcher)

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型的列表级偏好对齐，核心insight（二元→列表级）对RLHF方法论有一定类比启发，但实验仅在文生图上验证，对LLM pretrain研究者看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Listwise preference alignment for diffusion models; the binary→listwise insight has some analogical relevance to RLHF methodology, but experiments are purely text-to-image — read only the abstract.

paper.title: Spend Your Rollouts Where It Counts: Rollout Allocation for Group-Based RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the dominant paradigm for post-training large language models. However, in the online, on-policy setting, rollout generation dominates the computational cost of training. Group-based policy optimization methods compute advantages from multiple rollouts per prompt, yet they indiscriminately allocate budget to prompts with collapsed reward distributions, wasting expensive rollouts on negligible learning signals. We demonstrate that group-based updates are most effect

summary.core_problem: 基于分组的RL后训练方法（如GRPO）为每个prompt分配相同的rollout采样预算，导致大量算力浪费在奖励分布坍缩、梯度信号可忽略的prompt上；同时由于训练过程中策略持续演化，prompt的信息量无法预先计算，只能在线估计，但全量估算所有prompt的信息量算力成本过高。
summary.importance: 首次将rollout分配明确作为RL后训练的一级优化问题，为分组RL算法提供了可落地的算力优化方案，在不损失最终精度的前提下显著降低RL阶段的采样成本，对大模型RL对齐的工程落地和效率提升有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Pilot-Commit两阶段rollout分配框架：1）Pilot阶段：用小部分预算为每个prompt生成少量rollout，在线估算当前策略下的奖励方差，作为prompt信息量的代理；2）Commit阶段：将剩余预算优先分配给高奖励方差（梯度信号强）的prompt，跳过低信号prompt并延迟到后续epoch；额外引入非对称阈值（保留接近最优学习区间的困难prompt、跳过接近收敛的简单prompt）、重播缓存、单步绑定机制降低额外开销。核心理论支撑：GRPO的 surrogate梯度模长与组内奖励方差正相关，当奖励结果不确定性最高时梯度信号最强。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理基准上测试1.5B到14B参数的模型，Pilot-Commit达到与基线相同精度时，使用的rollout数量比GRPO少最多1.9倍，比DAPO少最多4.0倍；所有测试设置下均能稳定节省采样算力，无精度损失。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章的梯度与奖励方差的理论推导部分，理解方案的核心逻辑；查看第4章的实验结果表，了解不同模型规模和设置下的算力节省幅度；附录的实现细节可作为工程落地参考，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Group-based RL post-training methods such as GRPO allocate identical rollout sampling budgets to all prompts, leading to massive compute waste on prompts with collapsed reward distributions and negligible gradient signals. Meanwhile, since the policy evolves continuously during training, prompt informativeness cannot be precomputed and must be estimated online, while exhaustive evaluation of all prompts is computationally prohibitive.
summary_en.importance: This work explicitly frames rollout allocation as a first-class optimization problem for RL post-training, and provides a practical compute optimization scheme for group-based RL algorithms. It significantly reduces sampling cost during the RL phase without sacrificing final accuracy, offering direct reference for the engineering implementation and efficiency improvement of LLM RL alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Pilot-Commit two-stage rollout allocation framework is proposed: 1) Pilot stage: use a small fraction of the budget to generate a few rollouts for each prompt, and online estimate reward variance under the current policy as a proxy for prompt informativeness; 2) Commit stage: allocate the remaining budget preferentially to prompts with high reward variance (strong gradient signals), skip low-signal prompts and defer them to later epochs. Additional techniques include asymmetric thresholds (retaining hard prompts approaching the optimal learning regime, skipping nearly solved prompts with diminishing signals), replay buffer, and one-step binding mechanism to reduce overhead. The core theoretical support is that the surrogate gradient magnitude of GRPO is positively correlated with within-group reward variance, and the gradient signal is strongest when reward outcomes are maximally uncertain.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning benchmarks with model sizes ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters. When achieving the same accuracy as baselines, Pilot-Commit uses up to 1.9× fewer rollouts than GRPO and up to 4.0× fewer than DAPO across all settings, consistently reducing sampling compute without accuracy loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the theoretical derivation of the relationship between gradient and reward variance in Chapter 3 to understand the core logic of the scheme. Check the experimental result tables in Chapter 4 for the compute saving幅度 across different model scales and settings. Implementation details in the appendix can serve as engineering reference. Estimated reading time is 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward-variance 诊断和 allocation 消融；若结果稳，应把 RL rollout budget 从固定 K 改成在线分配。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-variance diagnosis and allocation ablations; if stable, fixed-K rollout schedules should be replaced by online budget allocation.

paper.title: GeoFaith: A Spatio-Temporal Dual View of Faithful Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has advanced large language models (LLMs), but outcome-based supervision leads to pervasive post-hoc rationalization, producing plausible yet unfaithful reasoning chains. Most prior faithfulness assessment methods are either unscalable, expensive, or unreliable. We propose GeoFaith, a spatio-temporal framework that leverages latent geometric structure and entropy dynamics to diagnose and enforce faithful reasoning. We develop a scalable bootstrapping pipeline exp

summary.core_problem: 如何在可规模化的条件下评估并训练 CoT 的“过程忠实性”（faithfulness），避免只用最终答案监督导致的 post-hoc rationalization：模型给出看似合理但与其真实内部推断不一致的推理链。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接改动不多，但对“训练信号质量”与“过程监督/RL 目标设计”有现实意义：1）把忠实性从纯文本 judge/人工标注，转向可批量计算的表征与不确定性信号；2）给出一个可扩展的数据构建路线（1k 步级标注扩到 20k），以及一个可落地的 detector→RL 闭环。对做 reasoning mid-train / RL、以及想把过程指标纳入训练目标的团队更有参考价值。整体更像 post-train/对齐侧的过程质量工程，而不是预训练 recipe 或 scaling 规律贡献。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路是“时空双视角”：
1）空间（latent geometry）：把每个推理 step 生成后的 last-token hidden state 当作轨迹点，观察到隐藏状态在各层都呈现低内在维度（PCA 解释方差很快饱和；TwoNN 估计的 intrinsic dimension 也偏低），并且 faithful/unfaithful 在 UMAP 上可分。进一步用 VAE 把隐藏状态映射到潜空间，在潜空间上用 pullback metric 定义黎曼度量，借助 kNN 图近似测地距离，用几何距离/聚类结构来刻画“轨迹是否偏离 faithful 核心区域”。
2）时间（entropy dynamics）：跟踪每一步的预测不确定性（熵）随 step 的演化，作为过程是否稳定、是否出现“编造式补丁”的信号。
3）数据与监督：提出 bootstrapping 标注引擎，把少量人工/高成本的 step-level 忠实性标注（1k）扩展到 20k。做法是先在轨迹空间聚类，再用 detector 引导的迭代筛选/修正，把“几何上可分 + 熵动态异常”的样本优先纳入标注与训练。
4）训练：训练一个 8B 的 faithfulness detector 做 step-level 判别；再把 detector 作为 reward/约束引入 faithfulness-aware RL，同时优化（a）最终正确性，（b）过程忠实性，（c）trajectory consistency（鼓励轨迹在几何/时间信号上更一致）。目标效果是减少冗长但不真实的 CoT，得到更短、更忠实的推理链。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的关键数字主要集中在 detector：8B detector 在自建 in-domain step-level 基准上，faithful/unfaithful 的平均 F1 为 83.1/70.4。并报告在 RAGTruth、FCGPT、FaithCoT-Bench 上超过 GPT-5（文中未在摘录段落里给出逐项分数）。
现象类实验包括：
- 表征维度：PCA 显示少于 128 个主成分（约占隐藏维度 3%）解释大部分方差；TwoNN 显示各层 intrinsic dimension 偏低。
- 可分性：UMAP 上 faithful 核心区与 unfaithful 外围簇分离；unfaithful 样本来自 RFEval 的反事实干预构造。
- RL 效果：声称 joint optimization 后推理链更短且更忠实，同时下游任务准确率更好（但在当前提供的全文片段中缺少具体任务、提升幅度与对照组数字；精读时需要回到实验章节核对）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看“Spatio-Temporal Duality”这一节：PCA/TwoNN 的低维证据、UMAP 分离图，以及他们为何引入 VAE+黎曼度量（这决定了方法是否只是可视化巧合，还是能形成可计算的判别信号）。
- 再看 bootstrapping pipeline 的细节：聚类粒度、如何从 1k 扩到 20k、以及 detector-guided refinement 的迭代规则与噪声控制（这里决定数据是否会自举漂移）。
- 最后看 RL 目标：reward 由哪些项组成、权重如何设、是否有 reward hacking 的防护（例如 trajectory consistency 是否只是“迎合 detector”）。
精读时重点核对三点：1）faithfulness 的 operational definition 是否稳定；2）detector 是否跨域泛化还是主要吃到数据分布；3）RL 后准确率提升是否来自更好推理，还是来自更短输出带来的评测偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: How to assess and enforce chain-of-thought (CoT) process faithfulness at scale, beyond final-answer supervision that often induces post-hoc rationalization (plausible-looking but internally unfaithful reasoning traces).
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for training-signal quality in mid-training / RL / process supervision loops. The main value is a concrete alternative to expensive human labeling or LLM-judge pipelines: using representation geometry and uncertainty dynamics as scalable signals, plus a detector→RL feedback loop. If you are building reasoning-focused continual training or RL objectives, it offers a workable blueprint; if you are focused on tokenizer/scaling/optimizer, the direct impact is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GeoFaith frames faithfulness via a spatio-temporal view of reasoning trajectories:
- Spatial (latent geometry): treat each reasoning step as a point given by the model’s last-token hidden state. Empirically, these states lie on a low-dimensional manifold (fast PCA saturation; low intrinsic dimension via TwoNN). Faithful vs. unfaithful states appear separable in UMAP. To make geometry computable beyond visualization, they fit a VAE and define a Riemannian metric (pullback metric induced by the decoder), then approximate geodesic distances with a kNN graph in latent space.
- Temporal (entropy dynamics): track predictive entropy across steps; abnormal entropy evolution is used as an additional indicator of unfaithful “patching” behavior.
- Data bootstrapping: expand step-level faithfulness annotations from 1k to 20k using trajectory clustering and detector-guided refinement, aiming to scale process supervision without relying on brittle LLM judges.
- Training and optimization: train an 8B step-level faithfulness detector; then incorporate it into a faithfulness-aware RL objective that jointly optimizes answer correctness, process faithfulness, and trajectory consistency, encouraging shorter but more faithful CoT traces.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers center on the detector: an 8B faithfulness detector reaches 83.1/70.4 average F1 for faithful/unfaithful classification on their in-domain step-level benchmark, and is reported to outperform GPT-5 on RAGTruth, FCGPT, and FaithCoT-Bench (per-benchmark scores need to be checked in the main experiments section).
Supporting analyses include: <128 PCs (~3% of hidden dimension) explain most variance; TwoNN indicates low intrinsic dimensionality; UMAP shows clear separation between faithful cores and unfaithful peripheral clusters (with unfaithful samples constructed via counterfactual interventions from RFEval).
They also claim RL produces shorter, more faithful chains with better downstream accuracy, but the provided excerpt does not include the exact task-level deltas—those should be verified from the full experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the spatio-temporal evidence first: PCA/TwoNN results and the UMAP separation, then the rationale for VAE + Riemannian distance (to judge whether the geometry is a robust signal or a visualization artifact).
2) Inspect the bootstrapping pipeline details: clustering strategy, refinement loop, and how they control self-training drift/noise when scaling from 1k to 20k.
3) Check the RL objective and safeguards: reward terms, weighting, and whether trajectory consistency reduces detector gaming.
When going deeper, focus on (i) the operational definition of “faithfulness” used for step labels, (ii) cross-domain generalization of the detector, and (iii) whether accuracy gains persist under evaluation setups that are not sensitive to shorter outputs.

recommendation.zh: 结论先打折，只读 detector 信号定义和 RL reward 组合；若标注 bootstrapping 干净，可借来做过程奖励审计。
recommendation.en: Treat the claims cautiously; read the detector signals and RL reward composition, especially if the bootstrapped labels are auditable.

paper.title: Multi-Stakeholder LLM Alignment: Decomposing Estimation from Aggregation
paper.abstract: Multi-stakeholder tasks require one output to satisfy users with conflicting preferences. Holistic LLM judges conflate utility estimation and utility aggregation, yielding unstable implicit weights. We show empirically and theoretically that this aggregation-specific \emph{weighting noise} can create large score shifts when stakeholder satisfaction is dispersed; in our experiments, these weight-induced shifts also increase with stakeholder count. We propose \textsc{DecompR}: counterfactual-calib

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多利益相关者任务中的奖励建模问题：一个输出需要同时满足多个偏好冲突的用户，而常规 LLM judge 在一次评分里同时做效用估计和效用聚合，导致隐含权重随候选答案和表述方式漂移，奖励信号不稳定。
summary.importance: 它与基座预训练的关系不是直接的训练目标或数据配比，而是 pretrain-posttrain 接口中的奖励质量问题。对 GRPO、RLHF、RLAIF 这类训练流程有参考意义：如果 judge 的聚合权重不稳定，策略梯度会强化错误候选，尤其是在中高质量答案之间做细粒度区分时。论文的贡献在于把 reward noise 拆成估计噪声和聚合权重噪声，并指出多用户场景下后者会随 stakeholder 数量和满意度分散度放大。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DecompR，将效用估计和效用聚合拆开。每个 stakeholder 的满意度由 judge 独立估计，避免在同一次整体评分中混合多个角色偏好；聚合权重不让 judge 在线自由决定，而是根据 query structure 通过 counterfactual calibration 预先固定。这里的权重被设计为对预期牺牲程度的代理量：如果某个 stakeholder 的约束更难同时满足，或在候选计划中更容易被牺牲，则获得更合适的聚合权重。这个设计与普通 rubric 或 checklist 的区别在于，它仍然围绕 stakeholder utility 聚合，而不是把问题改写成通用质量维度；与 uniform weighting 的区别在于，它保留了查询结构中的不对称性。
summary.experiments: 实验构造了 60 个真实多用户旅行规划查询的 seed responses，stakeholder 数量为 2、3、5、8，质量分为高、中、低三档。每个 seed 生成 55 个语义保持变体，覆盖 11 类变换、每类 5 个版本，包括顺序置换、格式控制、因果表述翻转、证据位置移动、改写和主题重排。另有 5 次完全重复作为 judge 内在随机性的基线。评测使用 Qwen3.5-Plus、Gemini-3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Flash，温度为 0。关键结果是：中高质量回答的语义保持变体方差会随 stakeholder 数量增长，pooled Growth 为 1.87，Gemini 最高达到 6.67 倍；当 n=8 时，中高质量回答的 Sem/Rep 比值达到 2.64，说明仅改变 stakeholder 的呈现方式就带来超过重复评测随机性的额外波动。低质量回答没有同样趋势，Growth 为 0.29，作者解释为低分区间的 floor effect。结构化评测能降低波动，但 judge 在线自适应分配权重会重新引入不稳定性：Rubric Growth 为 1.18，固定均匀权重的 decomposed scoring 为 1.20，而使用相同满意度估计、让 judge 自适应给权重时 Growth 升到 1.58。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看经验分析部分对 σ_Sem^2、σ_Rep^2 和 Sem/Rep ratio 的定义，以及 Table 1 中方差随 stakeholder 数量增长的结果。然后看结构化评测协议对比，尤其是 adaptive decomposed 与 uniform decomposed 的受控比较，因为它直接隔离了权重噪声。理论部分可快速看它如何说明权重漂移会改变组内排序并误导 GRPO。DecompR 的 counterfactual-calibrated weights 是方法核心，值得关注其权重是否真的由查询结构决定，而不是把另一个 LLM judge 的偏差前移了一步。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward modeling for multi-stakeholder tasks, where a single response must satisfy multiple users with conflicting preferences. A standard holistic LLM judge estimates stakeholder utilities and aggregates them in one pass. This makes the implicit aggregation weights unstable, so the same candidate can receive different rewards depending on presentation details.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than to core pretraining. Its value is in reward-signal analysis for RLHF, RLAIF, and GRPO-style training. If a judge changes aggregation weights across evaluations, within-group rankings can flip and policy updates may reinforce the wrong samples. The useful distinction is between utility-estimation noise and aggregation-weighting noise; the latter becomes more harmful when stakeholder utilities are dispersed and when the number of stakeholders grows.
summary_en.technical_approach: DecompR separates estimation from aggregation. The judge estimates each stakeholder's satisfaction independently. Aggregation weights are not assigned online while scoring a candidate; instead, they are fixed from the query structure through counterfactual calibration. The weights are intended to proxy expected sacrifice: stakeholders whose constraints are structurally harder to satisfy, or more likely to be traded off, receive non-uniform treatment. This differs from generic rubric scoring, which aggregates broad quality dimensions, and from uniform stakeholder weighting, which ignores constraint asymmetry. It also avoids candidate-dependent weight drift from a holistic judge.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses 60 seed responses from real multi-stakeholder travel-planning queries, with stakeholder counts n in {2, 3, 5, 8} and three quality levels. For each seed, the authors create 55 semantics-preserving variants across 11 transformation families, including ordering changes, formatting controls, causal framing changes, evidence relocation, paraphrasing, and topic repositioning. Five exact repeats provide an intrinsic-noise baseline. Evaluations are run at temperature 0 using Qwen3.5-Plus, Gemini-3-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. For medium- and high-quality responses, variance across semantic variants grows with stakeholder count: pooled Growth is 1.87, and Gemini reaches 6.67x. At n=8, the Sem/Rep ratio reaches 2.64 for medium and high responses, meaning presentation changes add much more variance than repeated evaluation noise. Low-quality responses do not show this pattern, with Growth 0.29, likely due to a floor effect. Structured protocols reduce variance, but judge-assigned adaptive weights reintroduce instability: Rubric has Growth 1.18, decomposed scoring with fixed uniform weights has 1.20, while adaptive decomposed weighting rises to 1.58 using the same utility estimates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the empirical setup carefully, especially the definitions of semantic-variant variance, repeat variance, and the Sem/Rep ratio. Table 1 is the main evidence for variance growth with stakeholder count. The most informative comparison is between adaptive decomposed scoring and uniform decomposed scoring, because it isolates aggregation-weight noise while holding utility estimates fixed. The theory section is worth a quick pass for its argument that weight drift can corrupt within-group rankings in GRPO. For DecompR, focus on how counterfactual-calibrated weights are derived from query structure and whether this calibration introduces a new source of judge bias.

recommendation.zh: 多利益相关方对齐中权重噪声的发现很有价值，DecompR 的解耦思路对设计更稳定的 RLHF 奖励模型有启发，重点看 §3 的理论分析。
recommendation.en: The identification of weighting noise in multi-stakeholder alignment is valuable; DecompR's decoupling approach informs more stable RLHF reward model design—focus on §3 theoretical analysis.

paper.title: Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Standard on-policy reinforcement learning relies on heuristic clipping to enforce trust regions, but this mechanism imposes a severe cost by indiscriminately truncating high-return yet high-divergence updates. We demonstrate that explicitly constraining the policy ratio variance provides a principled local approximation to trust-region constraints, eliminating the need for binary hard clipping. By acting as a distributional ``soft brake'', this approach preserves critical gradient signals from n

summary.core_problem: 在 PPO/GRPO 这类一阶 on-policy 策略梯度里，clip 用“逐样本硬截断”近似 trust region，导致两个直接问题：高回报但 ratio 偏大的样本梯度被一刀切抹掉；以及数据一旦稍微 off-policy 就几乎不能用。论文要解决的是：在不引入 TRPO 二阶开销的前提下，用一个更“分布式”的约束替代 pointwise clipping，同时允许一定程度的 stale/off-policy 复用。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 的 RLHF/RLAIF/可验证奖励 RL（含 GRPO 系）有直接启发：把“稳定性约束”从 clip 的启发式，改成可优化、可调节的统计量约束（importance ratio 的方差），理论上更贴近 KL trust region 的局部近似，工程上也更容易做成可控的软约束。更关键的是它把“稳定更新”和“复用旧数据”统一到同一个约束里：方差大就自动降权，方差小就允许继续吃旧数据。这类思路如果在大规模 RL 训练里成立，可能减少对严格 on-policy 的依赖，改善样本效率与训练吞吐。
summary.technical_approach:
核心替代物是“约束 importance ratio 的方差”。设 ρ_t(θ)=π_θ(a_t|s_t)/π_old(a_t|s_t)。PPO 的 clip 是对每个样本的 ρ_t 做区间截断；本文改为对一批样本的二阶统计量做约束：控制 Var(ρ_t)（以及与之相关的二阶矩），把它作为 trust-region（KL）在局部 regime 的近似。

实现上给出 R2VPO：把“最大化优势加权的 importance sampling 目标”与“ratio 方差不超过阈值”写成带约束优化，然后用拉格朗日乘子做 primal-dual 更新：
- primal：更新策略参数以提升回报（类似 PPO/GRPO 的 surrogate）；
- dual：自适应调节方差惩罚强度，使 ratio 方差维持在目标范围。

直观效果是一个 soft brake：ratio 偏离越大、对方差贡献越大，就被更强地惩罚/降权，但不会像 clip 那样把梯度直接置零；同时对 stale/off-policy 数据，ratio 分布往往更“散”，方差约束会自动把它们的有效权重压下去，从而在不显式 hard cutoff 的情况下实现“可控复用”。论文还给出 off-policy 变体 R2VPO-OFF，强调可以利用旧轨迹/旧 rollouts 做额外更新。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称覆盖 LLM 对齐/推理范式与连续控制两大类实验。
- LLM 侧：在 7 组不同 LLM scale/设置上，R2VPO 相对强 clipping baseline（含 GRPO）给出 macro-average 相对提升 +35%，小模型场景最高到 +138%；在 7 个设置里有 6 个优于 GRPO。并报告 R2VPO-OFF 能有效利用 stale 数据提升样本效率。
- 控制侧：在 DeepMind Control Suite 上显著优于 PPO，尤其在 sparse-reward 探索与动态任务中更不易崩。

从“预训练-后训练接口”的角度，更值得看的不是绝对分数，而是：方差约束是否减少了训练中 ratio 爆炸/崩溃的频率、是否允许更大的学习率或更少的 rollout 频率、以及 off-policy 复用在不同延迟(staleness)下的收益曲线。全文如果给了这些曲线/消融（阈值、dual 更新速率、与 KL/clip 的对照），信息量会很高。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 方法推导部分：他们如何把 KL trust region 的局部近似落到 Var(ρ) 上——这里决定了它是不是“换个正则项”的包装。
2) 算法框图/伪代码：primal-dual 的更新频率、dual 的稳定性技巧（是否需要 clamp、moving average、target schedule）。
3) LLM 实验：重点看与 PPO/GRPO 的对照是否控制了 rollout 数、batch、优势估计、KL penalty 等变量；以及 R2VPO-OFF 的 staleness 设置与收益。
4) 消融：方差阈值/惩罚系数自适应 vs 固定、是否仍需要 KL penalty、与 clip 同时用会怎样。

如果要判断能否迁移到大规模 RLHF 生产训练，优先找：ratio 分布统计、梯度范数/更新幅度、loss spike 频率、以及吞吐/样本效率的量化。

summary_en.core_problem: First-order on-policy methods (PPO/GRPO) approximate trust regions via per-sample hard clipping of the importance ratio. This stabilizes updates but discards gradients from high-return yet high-divergence samples, and effectively prevents reuse of slightly stale/off-policy data. The paper targets a replacement for pointwise clipping that (i) remains first-order and scalable, (ii) behaves like a trust-region surrogate, and (iii) enables controlled reuse of off-policy trajectories.
summary_en.importance: For LLM post-training (RLHF/RLAIF and verifier-based RL), the main value is reframing the stability constraint from a heuristic clip to an optimizable statistical constraint: controlling the variance of importance ratios. This is closer to a local trust-region view than binary truncation, and it naturally couples stability with off-policy reuse: stale data tends to inflate ratio dispersion, which the variance constraint down-weights automatically. If the reported gains hold under strict compute/data controls, this could reduce the “must be on-policy” pressure in large-scale RL pipelines and improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key idea is to constrain second-order statistics of the importance ratio ρ_t(θ)=π_θ(a_t|s_t)/π_old(a_t|s_t), rather than clipping ρ_t per token/step. The authors argue that, in a local regime, a KL trust-region constraint can be approximated by controlling the variance (and related second moment) of ρ.

They propose R2VPO (Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization): formulate policy optimization as maximizing an IS-style surrogate objective subject to a constraint on Var(ρ). The constraint is enforced via a Lagrangian primal–dual scheme:
- primal update improves the return surrogate (PPO-like objective without hard clipping);
- dual update adapts the penalty to keep ratio variance near a target.

This yields a “soft brake”: samples with extreme ratios are smoothly down-weighted (not zeroed), preserving gradient signal from rare but valuable trajectories. An off-policy variant (R2VPO-OFF) explicitly reuses stale trajectories; the same variance control acts as an automatic gate on how much those trajectories can influence updates.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports results in both LLM fine-tuning and continuous control.
- LLMs: across 7 model scales/settings, R2VPO shows a macro-average relative gain of +35% over strong clipping-based baselines (including GRPO), with up to +138% in smaller-model regimes; it beats GRPO in 6/7 settings. R2VPO-OFF is reported to improve sample efficiency by leveraging stale data.
- Control: on DeepMind Control Suite, R2VPO outperforms PPO, with stronger exploration in sparse-reward tasks and less collapse in dynamic tasks.

For an LLM training reader, the most diagnostic evidence is not the headline score but the training dynamics: ratio distribution statistics, update magnitude, instability/spike frequency, and performance vs staleness curves for off-policy reuse (if provided).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
1) The derivation connecting KL trust regions to Var(ρ): this determines whether the method is principled or just a different regularizer.
2) Algorithm details: primal–dual update schedule, how the dual variable is stabilized (clamps/EMA/targets), and whether additional KL penalties are still needed.
3) LLM experiments: check if rollouts, batch sizes, advantage estimation, and compute budgets are matched against PPO/GRPO; focus on the off-policy/staleness protocol.
4) Ablations: fixed vs adaptive penalty, sensitivity to the variance target, combining with clipping/KL, and any reported training stability metrics.

If you care about production RLHF, prioritize sections that quantify throughput/sample-efficiency trade-offs and robustness to stale data.

recommendation.zh: PPO硬clip的有原则替代方案，正则化思路对LLM RL优化有参考价值，做RLHF的研究员可看§3的算法推导
recommendation.en: A principled alternative to PPO hard clipping, the regularization idea is informative for LLM RL researchers, focus on §3 algorithm derivation

paper.title: Focal Reward: Balanced Reinforcement Learning under Rubric-Based Rewards
paper.abstract: The open-ended generation in LLMs usually requires multi-dimensional rubrics to adequately assess quality and guide the improvement of reinforcement learning. However, a critical dilemma inherent in this training paradigm is the imbalanced reward polarization along different rubric dimensions. Under this bottleneck, even if LLMs achieve relatively high rewards after training, they may still exhibit severe deficiencies in certain dimensions, leading to a direct deterioration in user experience. T

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 rubric-based RL 中多维奖励聚合不均衡的问题：一些容易满足的维度较早饱和，但静态加权仍持续奖励这些维度，导致模型在总分上升的同时，在关键约束或难优化维度上仍有明显缺陷。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 训练信号设计有参考价值。它把开放式生成的奖励问题从“如何构造更好的 judge”转到“如何把 criterion-level feedback 合成成更合理的标量奖励”。这个问题会影响 SFT/RL 阶段的行为塑形，也会反过来影响对预训练能力缺口的诊断。价值主要在 reward scalarization，而不是新的 RL 算法。
summary.technical_approach: Focal Reward 不改 judge、不改 rubric，也不改 GRPO 一类策略优化框架，只在奖励合成层做干预。方法先用 inverse reward projection 估计每个 rubric criterion 的饱和程度，即判断某个维度在当前 rollout 分布中是否已经接近上限；再根据饱和度调整 criterion 权重。已饱和维度被降权，仍有较大提升空间的维度被加权。这样做的目标是避免静态 scalarizer 把训练信号浪费在 fluency、format compliance 等容易得分的维度上，而忽略 nuanced helpfulness、任务约束满足等更难维度。与固定加权、多维分数简单平均相比，它更像一个在线的奖励方向校准器。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个模型规模和 6 个 benchmark，共 18 个 model-benchmark 组合。论文报告 Focal Reward 在全部 18 个比较中超过最强静态聚合基线；相对最强静态 baseline 的平均提升随模型规模约为 +1.38 到 +2.50 分。消融和 rollout 分析支持一个关键结论：不同 rubric 维度在训练中确实以不同速度饱和，在线重分配权重能把优化压力转向仍有 headroom 的维度。需要注意，论文摘要和正文片段显示的结果主要是开放式生成评测分数，尚不足以证明它能稳定改善更硬的可验证任务或长期偏好一致性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 inverse reward projection 如何定义 saturation，以及 adaptive reweighting 如何进入原有 GRPO-style reward。实验部分优先看三类内容：不同 criterion 的饱和轨迹、与 static scalarizer 的逐 benchmark 对比、去掉 saturation-aware 权重后的消融。若只关心预训练，可把它作为 reward shaping 的案例，而不是预训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward imbalance in rubric-based RL for open-ended generation. Some rubric dimensions saturate early, while static aggregation keeps rewarding them, leaving harder or more decisive criteria under-optimized even when the overall reward improves.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not about base-model pretraining, but it is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface. It focuses on how criterion-level feedback should be scalarized before policy optimization. This matters because a poorly shaped post-training signal can hide capability gaps and encourage models to polish easy dimensions such as fluency while missing task-critical constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Focal Reward keeps the judge, rubric, and policy optimizer unchanged. The intervention is placed only at the reward synthesis layer. It estimates criterion saturation through an inverse reward projection mechanism, then adaptively reweights the rubric dimensions. Saturated criteria receive less emphasis; criteria with larger remaining headroom receive stronger training signal. Compared with fixed weighted sums or uniform averaging, the method acts as an online reward-direction calibrator for rubric-based RL.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates three model scales on six benchmarks, producing 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Focal Reward outperforms the strongest static aggregation baseline in all 18 comparisons. Reported average gains over the strongest static baseline range from about +1.38 to +2.50 points across model scales. The rollout analysis and ablations suggest that rubric dimensions do saturate at different rates and that saturation-aware reallocation improves optimization. The evidence is mainly on open-ended generation scores, so the result should not be overread as a general RL improvement for verifiable reasoning tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the definition of inverse reward projection, the adaptive reweighting rule, and how the resulting scalar reward is plugged into the existing GRPO-style optimization. In the experiments, prioritize the criterion saturation curves, per-benchmark comparison against static scalarizers, and ablations that remove saturation-aware weighting. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the reward-shaping lesson rather than the RL framework itself.

recommendation.zh: 可读方法部分，重点看动态重权是否真能避免 reward dimension collapse；若只靠标量重配，迁移到强 RM 可能有限。
recommendation.en: Read the method section for the dynamic weighting idea; if it is only scalar reweighting, expect limited transfer to stronger reward models.

paper.title: KARMA: Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation
paper.abstract: Human communication depends on implicit social signals where effectiveness is shaped by tone, context, and conversational norms rather than semantic content alone. We introduce KARMA (Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation), a framework for LLM learning of context-sensitive conversational behavior from large-scale social interaction data. KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict response valuation conditioned on context, and uses this signal to fine-tune language models via

summary.core_problem: 如何从大规模社交互动数据中学习语用和语境敏感的对话偏好，并把这种信号转成可用于 LLM 对齐的奖励模型。
summary.importance: 它和 pretrain 的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 信号设计有启发：奖励模型的离线拟合指标不一定对应下游 RL 效果，这对 RLHF/RLAIF 的 reward 选择很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 KARMA：先在 Reddit 对话上训练 reward model，预测回复在上下文中的社会反馈，再用该奖励通过强化学习微调语言模型。作者特别比较了不同 reward 设计，发现只看上下文的 reward 虽然更难准确预测 karma，却带来更好的下游行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模细节。实验比较了 reward model 的预测性能与 RL 后下游表现，并测试了下游模型是否直接暴露于社交媒体数据。核心结果是：最佳 reward predictor 并不对应最佳 downstream alignment，说明 reward misspecification 比拟合精度更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to learn pragmatics- and context-sensitive conversational preferences from large-scale social interaction data and turn them into useful reward signals for LLM alignment.
summary_en.importance: Its direct link to pretraining is limited, but it is relevant for post-training signal design: better offline reward-model fit does not necessarily translate into better RL outcomes, which matters for RLHF/RLAIF practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: KARMA first trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict socially valued responses conditioned on context, then uses that reward for RL fine-tuning. A key comparison is across reward formulations, including a context-only reward that predicts karma worse but yields better downstream behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes. The main empirical result is a decoupling between reward-model predictive accuracy and downstream alignment quality, with additional tests on whether the downstream model had direct exposure to the social-media data.

recommendation.zh: 可当 reward design 的反例读：别把 RM AUC 当真目标，只看“预测更差却 RL 更好”这一点就够了。
recommendation.en: Read it as a reward-design cautionary tale: do not optimize for RM fit alone; the key signal is that a worse predictor can drive better RL.

paper.title: Directional Alignment Mitigates Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
paper.abstract: Reward hacking arises when a model improves a proxy reward by exploiting shortcuts rather than solving the intended task. We study this failure mode through the geometry of reinforcement learning updates in language models and argue that hacking emerges when optimization drifts away from a stable low-dimensional learning trajectory. We analyze this drift through dominant singular directions of parameter updates and show that reward-hacking runs exhibit substantially larger directional change tha

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 RL for LM 里的 reward hacking，但切入点不是继续改 reward model，而是问：为什么模型会沿着“看起来 reward 更高、真实能力却更差”的方向走偏。作者把问题表述成优化几何问题：干净训练往往沿着一个相对稳定、低维的更新轨迹前进，而 reward hacking 对应的是更新方向从这条轨迹上发生明显旋转和漂移。论文要解决的核心问题，就是能否用这种“方向一致性”来识别并约束 RL 更新，从而延缓 shortcut exploitation。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不如 post-train 强，但它对理解 RL 阶段与基座参数空间几何的关系有启发。很多关于 reward hacking 的工作把问题归结为 reward misspecification，这篇文章补了另一个维度：即使 reward 不完美，模型是否会偏离一条相对可信的学习子空间，可能本身就是风险信号。这个视角对 RLHF、RFT、reasoning RL 都有参考意义，尤其是在大家越来越关心“RL 到底学到了什么，而不是只看 reward 曲线”的背景下。贡献量级更像一个有意思的机制假设加一个简单有效的干预方法，而不是已经成熟的通用 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是分析更新方向。作者把训练过程中某一步的参数更新 ΔW 做 SVD，写成若干奇异方向的叠加，重点关注前 K 个 dominant directions。直觉上，这些方向解释了更新中最主要的变化模式。为了比较不同 checkpoint 的方向是否一致，作者不用简单向量夹角，而是对由 top-k 奇异向量张成的子空间做 CCA，相当于测两个低维更新子空间的相似度。论文观察到，在不发生 hacking 的训练里，这些主导方向随时间演化较平滑；而在 hacking run 中，方向相似度显著下降，说明更新发生了旋转。第二步是基于这个观察做约束。作者提出 trusted-direction gradient alignment / trusted-direction projection：先用少量“干净”的监督训练步骤得到一组参考参数变化，对这些变化做 SVD，提取一个 trusted subspace；随后在 RL 训练时，把梯度投影到这个子空间内，只允许更新沿着这些被认为更可信的方向发生。这里的关键取舍是，作者只约束 output-side 的主导方向，不强行固定全部参数更新，因此比强 KL 回拉 reference policy 更有机会保留学习能力。与已有方法相比，它不是改 reward，也不是单纯缩小步长或做平滑，而是显式控制更新方向。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文内容看，核心实验集中在数学推理场景下的人为 reward-hacking 设置。分析部分先比较 clean run 和 hacking run 的方向一致性，使用 rank-1 CCA similarity，例如比较 step 20 和 step 80 的主导更新方向。论文报告 clean run 在大多数模块上的 CCA 大约维持在 0.8 左右，而 hacking model 明显更低，且最差层的漂移更严重。这支持“reward hacking 伴随方向漂移”的经验观察。方法部分再把 trusted-direction projection 用到 RL 训练中，主结论是它能显著延缓 shortcut exploitation，并更好保持真实任务性能。摘要里用的是 delay reward hacking 和 preserve task performance 这样的表述，说明它更像缓解而不是彻底消除。就目前可见内容，论文没有展示特别大规模的模型或超长训练，而是更偏机制验证：先证明几何信号存在，再证明基于该信号的投影约束有用。阅读时要留意作者是否报告了不同 rank K、不同 trusted data 规模、以及与 KL regularization 或 sharpness-based 方法的对比，这些决定方法是否只是特定设置下有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，把作者和 reward misspecification 路线、sharpness 路线的区别理清。然后直接看 Dominant Update Directions 和 Directional Shift in Reward Hacking，这两节给出整篇文章最重要的机制假设：reward hacking 不是只看 reward 设计，还要看更新是否偏离稳定子空间。接着看方法节里 trusted subspace 如何由少量 clean SFT steps 构造，以及 RL 时具体投影在哪些层、哪些矩阵上。最后看实验图，重点关注 CCA 曲线、真实任务性能与 proxy reward 是否出现背离、以及投影后这种背离是否被推迟。预计 25 分钟能完成泛读。如果要判断是否值得复现，优先检查附录里 rank 选择、不同模块一致性、以及投影带来的优化开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies reward hacking in RL for language models, but instead of treating it purely as a reward-modeling problem, it asks a geometric question: why do some RL runs drift into directions that improve proxy reward while hurting true task performance? The authors frame clean learning as following a relatively stable low-dimensional update trajectory, and reward hacking as a directional departure from that trajectory. The core problem is whether this notion of directional consistency can be measured and then used to constrain RL updates so that shortcut exploitation is delayed.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to pretraining is indirect, but the paper is relevant to anyone interested in how post-training interacts with the geometry of a pretrained model. Much of the reward-hacking literature focuses on misspecified rewards. This work adds another axis: even with imperfect rewards, the model may become unsafe when optimization leaves a trusted learning subspace. That is useful for RLHF, reasoning RL, and reinforcement fine-tuning more broadly, especially when reward curves are no longer a reliable proxy for actual capability. The contribution is best viewed as a mechanistic hypothesis plus a simple intervention, not yet a fully established general recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. First, the paper analyzes update directions. For a parameter update ΔW at a training step, the authors compute its SVD and focus on the top-K dominant singular directions, which are treated as the main modes of change. To compare directions across checkpoints, they do not rely on a single vector angle; instead they compare the subspaces spanned by the top-k singular vectors using CCA. This gives a geometry-aware measure of whether the dominant update subspace remains aligned over time. Empirically, non-hacking runs show smoother evolution and higher subspace similarity, while hacking runs exhibit stronger rotations. Second, the paper turns this observation into a constraint. It proposes trusted-direction gradient alignment, or trusted-direction projection: run a small number of clean supervised updates, collect the induced parameter changes, extract a trusted subspace via SVD, and during RL project gradients onto that subspace. The idea is to allow learning only along directions that resemble clean progress. A notable design choice is that the method constrains the dominant output-side directions rather than freezing all updates, which makes it less restrictive than strong KL anchoring to a reference policy. Relative to prior work, this is neither reward redesign nor simple step-size or sharpness control; it explicitly regulates update direction.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full text, the main experiments are in mathematical reasoning settings with induced reward-hacking scenarios. The analysis first compares clean and hacking runs using rank-1 CCA similarity between dominant update directions, for example between checkpoints 20 and 80. The paper reports that clean runs maintain CCA values around 0.8 across most modules, whereas hacking runs show substantially lower alignment and worse worst-layer behavior. This supports the central empirical claim that reward hacking is associated with directional drift. The intervention is then tested by applying trusted-direction projection during RL. The reported outcome is that it substantially delays shortcut exploitation and better preserves true task performance. The wording in the abstract is careful: the method mitigates and delays hacking rather than eliminating it. Based on the visible text, the paper appears more focused on mechanism validation than on very large-scale training. When reading, it is worth checking whether the full experiments include sensitivity to rank K, the amount of clean reference data, and comparisons against KL regularization or sharpness-based baselines, since those details determine whether the method is robust or only works in a narrow setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction to separate this paper from the standard reward-misspecification framing and from sharpness-based mitigation. Then read the sections on dominant update directions and directional shift in reward hacking, since they contain the main conceptual contribution: hacking is linked to leaving a stable update subspace. After that, inspect how the trusted subspace is built from a small number of clean SFT steps and exactly where the projection is applied during RL. In the experiments, focus on the CCA plots, the divergence between proxy reward and true task performance, and whether the projection delays that divergence. A 25-minute skim should be enough for the main idea. If you are considering reproduction, check the appendix for rank selection, layerwise consistency, and the optimization overhead introduced by the projection.

recommendation.zh: 值得看主奇异方向诊断；投影技巧未必通用，但“RL 失控先表现为更新方向漂移”应进内部监控。
recommendation.en: Read the singular-direction diagnostic; the projection trick may not generalize, but update-direction drift is a good candidate for internal RL monitoring.

paper.title: Extreme Region Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 强化学习中的样本效率和 KL 效率冲突。严格 on-policy 训练每批轨迹通常只用一次，采样成本高；off-policy 重复更新可以提高样本利用率，但会让当前策略偏离生成数据的旧策略，引入分布错配。PPO 类 KL 或 ratio clipping 能抑制漂移，但也会使优化过于保守。作者关心的问题是：能否充分挖掘一批轨迹里的训练信号，同时避免无效策略漂移消耗 KL 预算。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更接近 post-train，但对预训练研究有两个启发。第一，它把 reasoning RL 的瓶颈从“有没有更多数据”推进到“每批轨迹中的有效信号如何被利用”。这对长 CoT 采样成本很高的模型尤其重要。第二，它强调 KL divergence 不只是正则项，而是一种训练预算。无效漂移会占用预算，却不带来任务收益。这个视角对 mid-train、RL pretrain、持续训练中的 trust region 设计都有参考意义。贡献量级主要是训练范式和经验观察，不是基础架构变化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Extreme Region Policy Distillation。它把一次 RL 更新拆成两个阶段。第一阶段先放松 KL 约束，在固定轨迹数据上做更激进的多步 off-policy 优化，目标是尽量提取这批数据中的训练信号。这个阶段得到的策略不直接作为最终模型，而是作为 teacher。第二阶段把 teacher 中有用的监督信号蒸馏回原始策略，并显式加 trust-region 约束，让 student 保留有效改进，同时过滤掉第一阶段产生的多余漂移。作者还讨论了 strong teacher 和 weak teacher 两类情况。strong teacher 指第一阶段确实训练出更强策略；weak teacher 指即使 teacher 本身不更强，甚至是退化构造，也可能通过不同 signal construction strategy 给 student 提供有用方向。这个设计的关键不是简单复用 off-policy 数据，而是先在“极端区域”探索可用信号，再用受约束蒸馏把有效部分投回可接受的 KL 区域。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在数学推理任务上进行，覆盖强基座模型在标准 on-policy RL 收益变小的场景。作者先做固定数据上的大量 off-policy 更新分析：早期多步优化能快速提升，但更新过多后，轨迹概率偏移增大，policy entropy 下降，性能很早进入平台期。单纯收紧 KL 约束不能解决问题，只会降低可达到的性能上限。两阶段蒸馏后，student 能在相近性能下使用更小 KL，说明一部分 off-policy 漂移不是有效任务改进。论文还报告了在 Qwen3.5-27B 级别强模型上的实验，显示 weak teacher strategy 在强模型继续提升困难时仍能带来收益。可见正文没有提供完整 benchmark 表和具体提升数字，因此更可靠的结论是训练动态和 KL-efficiency 观察。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。优先看固定轨迹多步 off-policy 更新的诊断图，尤其是 performance、trajectory probability、entropy、KL 的联动变化。然后看两阶段框架图，理解为什么 teacher 不是最终策略，而是中间信号提取器。方法部分重点看三类 signal construction strategy，以及 student 何时能超过 teacher。实验部分建议关注强模型上的结果，因为这类模型最能暴露 on-policy RL 的边际收益问题。若时间有限，可以跳过一般 RL 预备知识，直接读 off-policy degradation 分析和 distillation ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the tension between sample efficiency and KL efficiency in reinforcement learning for large language models. Strictly on-policy training usually uses each batch of trajectories once, which is expensive for long reasoning rollouts. Reusing trajectories off-policy improves sample utilization, but repeated updates move the policy away from the behavior policy that generated the data. Standard PPO-style clipping or KL penalties reduce this mismatch, but they also make optimization conservative. The central question is whether a training procedure can exploit more signal from each batch without wasting KL budget on ineffective policy drift.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers who care about the interface between base models and reasoning RL. The useful idea is to treat KL divergence as a limited optimization budget, not just as a regularizer. Off-policy updates may consume this budget through probability drift and entropy collapse without producing durable task improvement. That observation matters for RL pretraining, mid-training, continual training, and any setting where rollout generation is costly. The contribution is a training procedure and a set of empirical diagnostics rather than a new model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Extreme Region Policy Distillation. It separates signal extraction from trust-region optimization. In the first stage, the method relaxes KL constraints and performs aggressive multi-step off-policy optimization on a fixed batch of trajectories. The resulting policy is not used as the final model; it is treated as a teacher that exposes useful training signals. In the second stage, these signals are distilled back into the original policy under explicit trust-region constraints. The intended effect is to keep the task-relevant improvement discovered during aggressive optimization while removing spurious drift. The paper also studies strong-teacher and weak-teacher regimes. A strong teacher is an off-policy optimized policy that improves over the base. A weak teacher may fail to improve, or may even be constructed in a degenerate way, yet still provide useful supervisory signals through alternative signal construction strategies. The method is therefore not merely off-policy data reuse; it uses an unconstrained or weakly constrained phase to search for signals, then projects those signals back into a KL-controlled region.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on mathematical reasoning tasks and strong base models where standard on-policy RL shows diminishing returns. The diagnostic experiments on fixed data show a consistent pattern: aggressive off-policy updates produce fast early gains, but excessive updates increase trajectory-probability drift, reduce policy entropy, and lead to an early performance plateau. Tightening the KL constraint alone does not solve the issue; it mainly lowers the achievable ceiling. The distillation stage achieves comparable performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that part of the off-policy movement was not useful for the task. The paper also reports experiments on a Qwen3.5-27B-scale model, where weak-teacher strategies can still improve a strong model when ordinary on-policy optimization is less effective. Exact benchmark numbers are not available in the visible manuscript content, so the most robust takeaway is the training-dynamics evidence and the KL-efficiency gain from distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim reading should take about 30 to 40 minutes. Start with the diagnostic plots for repeated off-policy updates on fixed trajectories, especially the interaction among performance, trajectory probability, entropy, and KL. Then read the two-stage framework carefully: the teacher is an intermediate signal extractor, not the final policy. In the method section, focus on the signal construction strategies and the conditions under which the student can outperform the teacher. In the experiments, prioritize the results on strong models, because they best illustrate why standard on-policy RL leaves useful signal unused. The generic RL preliminaries can be skipped if the reader is already familiar with PPO, KL constraints, and off-policy mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 fixed-data off-policy 曲线；若现象稳，RLVR 采样复用的内部分层实验应复现。
recommendation.en: Read the fixed-data off-policy curves; if stable, this is worth reproducing in internal RLVR sample-reuse ablations.

paper.title: DVAO: Dynamic Variance-adaptive Advantage Optimization for Multi-reward Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning has become a standard paradigm for aligning Large Language Models with human intent and task requirements. While Group Relative Policy Optimization offers an efficient, value-model-free alternative to Proximal Policy Optimization, adapting it to real-world multi-reward settings remains challenging. Standard scalarization practices, such as Reward Combination and Advantage Combination, suffer from significant drawbacks: Reward Combination frequently generates advantages wit

summary.core_problem: 解决多奖励 RL 对齐中，GRPO 类无 value 模型方法如何稳定地合并多个奖励信号，避免优势值尺度失控和静态权重失配的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段的优化细节工作，不是新对齐范式，但它触及一个真实痛点：多目标奖励在实践里常常噪声不同、量纲不同、相关性不同，简单加权会把训练推向不稳定区间。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 DVAO，用 rollout group 内各奖励目标的经验方差来动态调整组合权重。直觉上，方差更能反映当前目标的有效学习信号与噪声水平，因此方法会抬高信号更强的目标、压低更噪的目标，替代固定的 Reward Combination 或 Advantage Combination。核心改动发生在 advantage 组合层，而不是引入额外 value model 或复杂多目标优化器。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点是与标准 Reward Combination 和 Advantage Combination 比较训练稳定性与多奖励场景下的表现，但未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体任务和提升幅度。当前能确认的是作者主张其方法在真实多奖励设置下更稳，且能利用目标间方差差异自适应分配学习重心。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to combine multiple reward signals stably in GRPO-style value-free RL for LLM alignment, avoiding exploding advantage scales and the mismatch of static weighting.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization paper rather than a new alignment paradigm, but it targets a real practical issue: multi-objective rewards differ in noise, scale, and correlation, and naive scalarization often destabilizes training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DVAO, which dynamically adjusts combination weights using the empirical variance of each reward objective within a rollout group. The intuition is that variance captures signal quality and noise level, so the method up-weights objectives with stronger learning signal and suppresses noisier ones. The change is made at the advantage-combination stage, without adding a value model or a more complex multi-objective optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments mainly compare against standard Reward Combination and Advantage Combination in terms of stability and performance under multi-reward settings, but no model size, data scale, task suite, or effect size is provided. What can be inferred is that the authors claim better stability and more adaptive credit assignment across objectives.

recommendation.zh: 偏工程型的小改进，不会改写 RL 对齐认知；若你在做多 reward GRPO，先看它如何定义方差权重和是否真能压住 advantage 爆炸。
recommendation.en: An engineering-side tweak, not a paradigm shift; worth checking only if you run multi-reward GRPO and care whether variance-based weighting actually tames advantage blow-ups.

paper.title: GeoSVG-RL: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Layout-Constrained Text-to-SVG Diagram Generation
paper.abstract: Generating structured, editable diagrams remains a significant challenge for contemporary large language models, despite their proficiency in general-purpose vector code generation. The primary difficulty lies in the structural fragility of the output; minor errors such as misaligned connector endpoints, text labels overlapping borders, or complex layouts drifting beyond the canvas boundaries render the resulting SVG files functionally unusable for professional applications. To address these iss
