paper.abstract: LFT 关注 Latent Reasoning Still Alive 分享一下近期我们对于 Latent Reasoning 的一些思考，也顺便介绍我们在 SFT 阶段和 RL 阶段做的两篇工作：Latent-SFT 和 Latent-GRPO。 🌱 Latent-SFT 我们用词表 token embedding 的线性组合来定义 latent token，让模型在 SFT 阶段就能获得媲美显式 SFT 的性能，同时大幅压缩 reasoning chain。 🔥 Latent-GRPO 我们进一步解决了 latent reasoning 做 RL 时的不稳定问题： 1. 需要好的 latent 初始化； 2. 需要修复 Gumbel exploration 下的优化错位； 3. 需要避免多条正确路径在同时拟合多条正优势路径时被平均成无效状态。 📊 实验结果 Latent-GRPO 在低难度和高难度数学任务上都取得了稳定收益： - 低难度任务：相比 Latent-SFT 初始化，平均提升 7.86 Pass@1 - 高难度任务：相比 Latent-SFT 初始化，平均提升 14.77

summary.core_problem: 讨论“latent reasoning（隐空间思考）”在 SFT 与 RL 两阶段如何打通训练链路：用隐式/连续的 latent token 替代显式 CoT 文本，从而在保持效果的同时显著压缩推理链长度，并解决 latent RL 的训练不稳定。
summary.key_insights: 1) Latent-SFT：用词表 token embedding 的线性组合来定义 latent token，使模型在 SFT 阶段获得接近显式 SFT 的能力，同时减少显式 reasoning chain 依赖与长度。2) Latent-GRPO：针对 latent reasoning 做 RL 的三类不稳定来源给出工程化修复思路：需要更好的 latent 初始化；修复 Gumbel exploration 下的优化错位（optimization misalignment）；避免多条正确路径在同时拟合多条正优势轨迹时被“平均”成无效状态。3) 经验结果：在数学任务上报告稳定增益（低/高难度分别较 Latent-SFT 初始化 +7.86/+14.77 Pass@1），高难度上较显式 GRPO +4.27 Pass@1；推理长度较显式 GRPO 缩短约 3-4 倍，同时在 Gumbel exploration 下仍保持较强 pass@k。
summary.limits: 信息来自小红书笔记级摘要，缺少关键细节（latent token 具体参数化/约束、训练超参、对照组与统计显著性、失败案例）；实验主要集中在数学任务，泛化到开放域推理与工具使用场景尚未验证；“优化错位/平均成无效状态”的机制解释需要更严格的消融与可复现实验支撑。

summary_en.core_problem: The post argues for a practical training pipeline for latent reasoning across SFT and RL: represent reasoning as latent tokens (instead of explicit CoT text) to compress reasoning length while retaining performance, and address instability when doing RL over latent trajectories.
summary_en.key_insights: 1) Latent-SFT: defines latent tokens as linear combinations of vocabulary token embeddings, aiming to match explicit SFT performance while substantially shortening the visible reasoning chain. 2) Latent-GRPO: proposes fixes for three RL instability sources in latent reasoning—stronger latent initialization, correcting optimization misalignment under Gumbel-based exploration, and preventing multiple valid positive-advantage paths from being averaged into a degenerate state. 3) Reported results on math tasks show consistent gains (+7.86/+14.77 Pass@1 over Latent-SFT init on easier/harder sets; +4.27 Pass@1 over explicit GRPO on harder sets), with ~3–4× shorter reasoning length and preserved pass@k under Gumbel exploration.
summary_en.limits: This is a short social post without enough methodological detail for reproduction (latent parameterization, losses, hyperparameters, baselines, variance). Evidence is mainly math-focused; generalization to broader reasoning and tool-use is unclear. _debug_article_context.article_excerpt: LFT 关注 Latent Reasoning Still Alive 分享一下近期我们对于 Latent Reasoning 的一些思考，也顺便介绍我们在 SFT 阶段和 RL 阶段做的两篇工作：Latent-SFT 和 Latent-GRPO。 🌱 Latent-SFT 我们用词表 token embedding 的线性组合来定义 latent token，让模型在 SFT 阶段就能获得媲美显式 SFT 的性能，同时大幅压缩 reasoning chain。 🔥 Latent-GRPO 我们进一步解决了 latent reasoning 做 RL 时的不稳定问题： 1. 需要好的 latent 初始化； 2. 需要修复 Gumbel exploration 下的优化错位； 3. 需要避免多条正确路径在同时拟合多条正优势路径时被平均成无效状态。 📊 实验结果 Latent-GRPO 在低难度和高难度数学任务上都取得了稳定收益： - 低难度任务：相比 Latent-SFT 初始化，平均提升 7.86 Pass@1 - 高难度任务：相比 Latent-SFT 初始化，平均提升 14.77 Pass@1 - 相比显式 GRPO：高难度任务上平均超过 4.27 Pass@1 - 推理长度：相比显式 GRPO 减少约 3-4 倍 reasoning length - 采样能力：在 Gumbel exploration 下仍然保留很强的 pass@k 能力 总的来说，我们初步打通了 latent reasoning 在 SFT 阶段和 RL 阶段的训练链路。接下来我们会继续尝试 scaling Latent Reasoning，把它泛化到更通用的领域，并推动它形成稳定可用的版本。欢迎大家持续关注 #LatentReasoning #隐空间思考 #连续思维链 #LatentRL 05-02

summary.core_problem: 讨论GRPO风格强化学习对齐流程中，不同token级梯度聚合规则引入的优化偏差问题，以及现有两种主流聚合范式各自存在缺陷、适用场景不一致导致训练不稳定的痛点。
summary.key_insights: 现有两种聚合范式各有系统性偏差：Token聚合存在符号-长度耦合偏差，正负样本长度分布不均时会放大某一方的更新权重导致优化失衡；序列聚合存在序列等权偏差，为每条响应分配相同权重会隐式抑制长响应更新，在长文本推理场景性能下降明显。聚合规则的有效性由响应长度变异系数、正负样本长度差距共同决定，不存在通用最优规则。提出的平衡聚合方法先按优势符号划分为正负子集，子集内独立做token级平均，再按序列数量加权合并两个子集，可同时解决两类偏差问题。
summary.limits: 本文是小红书用户对相关论文的要点摘录，未提供完整的实验验证数据，也未说明平衡聚合方法在推理、对话、代码等不同对齐任务上的泛化效果，结论仅基于理论分析层面。

summary_en.core_problem: This post discusses the optimization bias caused by different token-level gradient aggregation rules in GRPO-style reinforcement learning alignment, as well as the training instability issue resulted from the flaws and inconsistent applicable scenarios of the two mainstream aggregation paradigms.
summary_en.key_insights: The two existing aggregation paradigms have separate systematic biases: token aggregation suffers from sign-length coupling bias, which amplifies the update weight of either positive or negative samples when their length distributions are uneven, leading to optimization imbalance; sequence aggregation has sequence equal-weighting bias, which assigns equal weight to each response, implicitly suppressing the update of long responses and causing obvious performance degradation in long text reasoning scenarios. The effectiveness of aggregation rules is jointly determined by the coefficient of variation of response length and the length gap between positive and negative samples, so no universally optimal rule exists. The proposed balanced aggregation method first divides samples into positive and negative subsets by advantage sign, performs independent token-level averaging within each subset, then merges the two subsets weighted by sequence count to resolve both types of bias at the same time.
summary_en.limits: This is an excerpt of key points of the paper shared by a Xiaohongshu user, with no complete experimental verification data provided. The generalization effect of the balanced aggregation method on different alignment tasks such as reasoning, dialogue and code is not explained, and the conclusion is only based on theoretical analysis.

_debug_article_context.article_excerpt: 刘东瑞 上海 AI Lab 关注 复旦：理解并解决GRPO的聚合偏差 这篇论文试图解决GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）风格强化学习中损失聚合规则引发的优化偏差问题。具体而言，论文聚焦于以下核心问题： 1. 聚合规则的设计盲区 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，GRPO风格训练被广泛采用，但一个关键的设计选择长期被忽视：如何将组内采样的token级策略梯度项聚合为组级损失。现有方法主要存在两种互斥的聚合范式： 序列聚合（Sequence Aggregation）：先对每条响应内的token取平均，再对响应取平均（标准GRPO默认方式） Token聚合（Token Aggregation）：直接对组内所有token取平均（DAPO、Dr.GRPO等近期工作倡导） 2. 两种聚合规则的本质缺陷 论文理论分析揭示了两种规则各自引入的系统性优化偏差： Token聚合的符号-长度耦合偏差（Sign-Length Coupling） 正样本和负样本对策略梯度的相对贡献不仅取决于其归一化优势（advantage），还取决于平均响应长度（T¯+ vs T¯−）。当正负样本长度分布不一致时，该规则会系统性放大某一方的更新权重，导致优化失衡。 序列聚合的序列等权偏差（Sequence Equal-Weighting） 通过为每条响应分配相等权重来消除符号-长度耦合，但会隐式地抑制长响应（无论响应包含多少token，每条序列对梯度的贡献相同）。这在长文本推理场景中尤为有害。 3. 模型依赖的优化不稳定性 论文发现不同聚合规则的相对有效性受两个因素支配： 响应长度的变异系数（长度分布的离散程度） 正负样本间的长度差距（Positive-Negative Length Gap） 这导致不存在 universally optimal 的聚合规则：Token聚合在长度变异大但长度差距小的场景更优，而序列聚合在相反场景更优，造成训练动态的不一致和最终性能的波动。 4. 提出的解决方案 为解决上述张力，论文提出平衡聚合（Balanced Aggregation, BA）： 先将响应按优势符号划分为正负子集 在各子集内独立进行token级平均（保留子集内的token级信息） 按序列数量加权合并两个子集（恢复符号间的平衡） #大模型 #深度学习 #机器学习 #人工智能未来 #人工智能发展 #科研学习 #提供思路和创新点 昨天 18:15

paper.title: Explaining and Preventing Alignment Collapse in Iterative RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) typically assumes a static or non-strategic reward model (RM). In iterative deployment, however, the policy generates the data on which the RM is retrained, creating a feedback loop. Building on the Stackelberg game formulation of this interaction, we derive an analytical decomposition of the policy's true optimization gradient into a standard policy gradient and a parameter-steering term that captures the policy's influence on the RM's future pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是迭代式 RLHF 中一个容易被简化掉的反馈回路：policy 生成新数据，reward model 在这些数据上继续训练，而 policy 当前的行为会改变 reward model 未来的参数。常规 PPO/REINFORCE 式 RLHF 只看当前 RM 给出的奖励，忽略了 policy 对下一轮 RM 的“参数 steering”影响。论文把这种短视优化导致的系统性偏移定义为 alignment collapse：模型持续利用 RM 的盲点，产出高 reward 但低真实偏好的回答，并让后续反馈数据进一步强化这些错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它把 post-train 中的 RLHF 失败模式写成了一个可分析的训练动力学问题，而不是只把 reward hacking 看成经验现象。它的贡献不在于提出一个新的偏好数据流程，而在于指出迭代 RLHF 的目标函数缺了一项：真实的有效奖励应包含当前 proxy reward 和 policy 对未来 RM 参数的 steering term。这个视角对基座训练也有参考意义，因为它说明“训练数据由模型自己生成、再反过来训练监督器或奖励器”的闭环会改变优化目标。类似问题也会出现在自举数据、RLAIF、self-improvement、持续预训练的数据过滤器中。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把迭代 RLHF 写成 policy-leader、RM-follower 的 Stackelberg / bilevel optimization。RM 在 policy 诱导的数据分布上更新，policy 的真实目标不是最大化固定 RM 的即时奖励，而是最大化经过 RM retraining dynamics 后的长期有效奖励。作者通过解析展开下层 RM 更新，得到 policy 的真实优化梯度分解：一部分是标准 policy gradient，另一部分是 parameter-steering term。后者刻画 policy 当前样本如何影响未来 RM 参数。这个项通常涉及 bilevel optimization 里的 Hessian inverse 或 influence-function 风格计算，直接做成本很高。

方法上，作者提出 Foresighted Policy Optimization（FPO）。它不是重写整个 RLHF pipeline，而是在 policy optimization 阶段加入一个针对性的 penalty，用来恢复被 PPO/REINFORCE 忽略的 steering 效应。论文先在 pointwise reward setting 中分析几何机制，再扩展到标准 pairwise preference comparison。为了让方法能在 LLM 上运行，FPO 用 TracIn 风格的一阶近似替代精确的二阶 Hessian inverse。TracIn 的作用是估计训练样本对模型参数和预测的影响，避免完整 bilevel 求解。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类场景。第一类是受控连续环境，用来隔离 alignment collapse 的几何机制：标准迭代 RLHF 会沿着 RM 高估区域前进，并在后续 RM 重训中强化这个偏差；加入 steering penalty 后，policy 更少进入 RM 明显失真的区域。第二类是较真实的 LLM alignment pipeline，使用 Llama-3.2-1B 进行验证。论文报告 FPO 在该设置中能降低 reward hacking，并使高 RM 分数与真实质量之间的偏离变小。

给出的全文内容没有包含具体表格数值、胜率、KL、reward gap 或 human/LLM judge 细项，因此不能可靠补充精确提升幅度。可确认的规模信息是 Llama-3.2-1B；可确认的对照是常规 myopic iterative RLHF 与加入 FPO penalty 的优化流程；可确认的消融重点是 exact steering term 的理论形式、一阶 TracIn relaxation、pointwise 到 pairwise preference 的扩展。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读理论推导部分，尤其是把 bilevel RLHF 展开为有效奖励的章节。核心不是 Stackelberg 这个标签，而是梯度分解后多出的 parameter-steering term。需要看清楚这个项的符号和含义：为什么 RM 高估区域会被长期目标自动折扣，为什么 RM 低估但真实偏好高的区域会被上调。

第二个重点是 FPO penalty 的构造。精读 exact bilevel term 到 TracIn 一阶近似的过渡，判断它在大模型训练中需要保存哪些梯度、在哪个频率更新、对 batch 选择是否敏感。第三个重点是 pairwise preference 扩展，因为真实 RLHF 数据大多不是 pointwise reward。实验部分建议重点看 collapse 曲线、proxy reward 与 true utility 的分离、以及 Llama-3.2-1B 设置中 FPO 对 reward hacking 的抑制是否来自 penalty 本身，而不是更强 KL 或更保守采样。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a feedback loop in iterative RLHF that is usually hidden by the standard training abstraction. The policy generates the data used to retrain the reward model, so the current policy also shapes the future parameters of the reward model. Standard PPO- or REINFORCE-style RLHF optimizes the current proxy reward and ignores this parameter-steering effect. The authors call the resulting failure mode alignment collapse: the policy repeatedly exploits reward-model blind spots, obtains high proxy reward with low true utility, and then induces new feedback data that reinforces the same errors.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a training-dynamics explanation of reward hacking in iterative RLHF. The paper does not treat reward over-optimization as only an empirical pathology. It derives the missing term in the optimization objective. A foresighted policy should optimize an effective reward composed of the current proxy reward plus a parameter-steering term induced by future RM retraining. This matters beyond RLHF. Any pipeline where a model generates data that later trains a judge, filter, reward model, or data selector can inherit the same closed-loop instability, including RLAIF, self-training, synthetic data bootstrapping, and continual pretraining with model-based filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors formulate iterative RLHF as a Stackelberg / bilevel problem with the policy as the leader and the reward model as the follower. The lower-level RM update depends on the data distribution induced by the current policy. By analytically unrolling this update, they decompose the true policy gradient into the usual policy-gradient term and an additional parameter-steering term. The latter measures how current policy samples change future reward-model parameters.

They then propose Foresighted Policy Optimization, or FPO. Rather than replacing the whole RLHF pipeline, FPO adds a targeted penalty during policy optimization to account for the missing steering effect. The analysis is first developed in a pointwise setting to expose the geometry, then extended to pairwise preference comparisons. The exact bilevel term would normally require inverse-Hessian computations. To make it usable for large models, the implementation uses a first-order TracIn-style relaxation, estimating training-example influence without explicit second-order solves.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section covers controlled continuous environments and a more realistic LLM alignment setup. In the controlled settings, standard iterative RLHF moves toward regions where the reward model overestimates true utility and then reinforces the same bias through retraining. With the FPO penalty, the policy is less attracted to those overestimated regions. In the LLM experiment, the method is tested in a Llama-3.2-1B alignment pipeline and is reported to reduce reward hacking relative to myopic iterative RLHF.

The supplied full-text excerpt does not include the numerical tables, exact win rates, KL values, reward gaps, or judge scores, so precise effect sizes should not be inferred. The confirmed experimental scale is Llama-3.2-1B. The confirmed comparison is standard iterative RLHF versus policy optimization augmented with the FPO penalty. The key empirical question is whether the penalty closes the gap between proxy reward and true utility, rather than merely making policy updates more conservative.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the derivation of the effective reward carefully. The important object is not the Stackelberg terminology itself, but the gradient decomposition and the meaning of the parameter-steering term. Track why a foresighted policy discounts regions where the current reward model overestimates true utility and gives more weight to regions it underestimates.

The second part to inspect is the construction of the FPO penalty, especially the transition from the exact bilevel expression to the TracIn approximation. For implementation, the relevant questions are what gradients must be stored, how often influence estimates are refreshed, and how sensitive the penalty is to the preference batch. The pairwise-preference extension is also important because deployed RLHF systems rarely operate on clean pointwise rewards. In the experiments, focus on plots that separate proxy reward from true utility and on the Llama-3.2-1B setup, where the main test is whether FPO reduces reward hacking without simply acting as a stronger KL constraint.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你看 iterative RLHF 的 prior：别再把 RM 当静态 oracle，先读梯度分解和 collapse 条件，再决定内部循环训练要不要加反操纵约束。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on iterative RLHF: stop treating the RM as a static oracle; read the gradient decomposition and collapse mechanism before trusting any closed-loop alignment pipeline.

paper.title: Data-dependent Exploration for Online Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper.abstract: Online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a promising paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs) by continuously collecting new preference feedback during training. A foundational challenge in this setting is exploration, which requires algorithms that enable the LLMs to generate informative comparisons that improve sample-efficiency in online RLHF. Existing exploration strategies often derive bonuses via on-policy expectations, which are difficult to estima

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理 online RLHF 中的探索效率问题。关键矛盾是：模型训练时只能看到沿历史策略收集到的偏好比较，覆盖很不均匀；如果探索奖励依赖当前策略的 on-policy 期望，估计会很噪，模型可能过早压低一些尚未充分验证的响应区域。DEPO 想解决的是如何用历史偏好数据本身刻画覆盖不足，并把这种不确定性稳定地注入偏好优化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发在 post-train 侧，尤其是 online alignment 和数据闭环。它的贡献不是提出新的语言建模目标，而是把 bandit/RL 中的 data-dependent UCB 思路迁移到 RLHF 数据采集：让模型不只优化当前偏好估计，也主动补齐表示空间中覆盖薄的方向。这个问题会影响 SFT/RL 数据效率，也会影响后续把在线反馈用于 continual post-training 的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 DEPO，即 Data-dependent Exploration for Preference Optimization。论文假设偏好满足 Bradley-Terry 模型，并在一个已知特征空间中表示单个回答；一对回答被拼成 pairwise feature。历史偏好比较会形成一个覆盖矩阵，类似线性 bandit 中的 design matrix。对新回答对，DEPO 根据该方向在历史数据中的覆盖程度计算 confidence radius：覆盖少的方向半径大，覆盖多的方向半径小。这个半径作为 UCB 探索 bonus，被加到偏好优化目标中，形成 reward bias。与依赖当前策略分布期望的探索方法相比，DEPO 的探索信号直接来自已收集数据的几何结构，因此更不容易因为当前策略短期收缩而丢掉未探索区域。论文还给出 data-dependent regret bound，界会随实际采样轨迹的表示几何变化，而不是只给最坏情形保证。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个 online RLHF 基线上有稳定提升，并强调 DEPO 计算开销较小、支持在线更新。已给出的全文片段没有包含实验章节的具体表格，因此无法确认模型规模、prompt 数量、反馈轮数、胜率提升或消融数值。可确认的实验关注点应包括：与被动探索、on-policy bonus 探索、标准偏好优化方法的比较；探索 bonus 的消融；历史覆盖矩阵更新方式对性能和稳定性的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法定义中 pairwise feature、coverage matrix、confidence radius 和 reward bias 的公式，这决定了它是否能落到真实 LLM 训练里。其次看 regret bound 的依赖项，重点看它如何从 worst-case 复杂度变成 data-dependent 复杂度。实验部分如果可读到，应重点看三类图表：在线轮次上的 win rate 曲线、反馈样本效率曲线、bonus/覆盖度消融。实现层面需要关注 feature map 来自哪里；如果特征只是 reward model 或 LLM hidden state，表示漂移会是主要工程问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies exploration in online RLHF. The core issue is that preference data are collected along the training trajectory and have uneven coverage. Exploration bonuses based on on-policy expectations are hard to estimate from such limited historical data, so the policy may prematurely suppress response regions that are under-explored but potentially high value.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to the post-training side of the pretrain-posttrain loop. It does not introduce a new language modeling objective, but it gives a cleaner way to make online preference collection more sample-efficient. The useful idea is to measure uncertainty from the geometry of historical comparisons rather than from the current policy alone. This matters for online alignment, continual preference training, and any pipeline where the model’s own sampling distribution determines future supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: DEPO, Data-dependent Exploration for Preference Optimization, builds a UCB-style exploration bonus from historical preference comparisons. The preference oracle is modeled with a Bradley-Terry form. Each response has a feature representation, and a response pair is represented by a concatenated pairwise feature. Historical comparisons define a coverage matrix over this feature space. For a new comparison, the method computes a confidence radius that is large along poorly covered directions and small along well-covered ones. This radius is injected into the preference optimization objective as a reward bias. Compared with exploration schemes based on on-policy expectations, the signal is tied to observed data coverage, so it is less sensitive to short-term policy collapse. The paper also provides a data-dependent regret bound that adapts to the representation geometry induced by the collected trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains over online RLHF baselines and positions DEPO as lightweight enough for online updates. The provided text does not include the experimental tables, so concrete numbers such as model size, feedback budget, win-rate gains, or ablation magnitudes cannot be verified here. The key experimental evidence to look for is comparison against passive exploration, on-policy bonus methods, and standard preference optimization, plus ablations on the bonus and the historical coverage estimator.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-30 minute skim is enough. Focus first on the definitions of the pairwise feature, coverage matrix, confidence radius, and how the bonus enters the preference objective. Then check the regret theorem and its dependence on empirical coverage rather than only worst-case dimensions. If the experimental section is available, prioritize learning curves over online rounds, feedback-efficiency plots, and ablations of the exploration bonus. A practical point to examine is the source and stability of the feature map; if it comes from a changing reward model or LLM representation, representation drift becomes a key implementation concern.

recommendation.zh: 在线 RLHF 的探索机制是当前对齐研究的痛点，本文用历史数据构建 uncertainty bonus 的思路值得关注，可作为改进 DPO/PPO 探索的参考。
recommendation.en: Exploration in online RLHF is a current pain point; the idea of using historical data to construct uncertainty bonuses is worth noting for improving DPO/PPO exploration.

institutions: Center for Advanced Intelligence Project, RIKEN

paper.title: Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL
paper.abstract: We found limited accidental CoT grading in some released models, fixed the affected reward pathways, and found no clear evidence that monitorability degraded.

summary.core_problem: 在强化学习（RL）训练阶段，如果不慎将思维链（CoT）纳入奖励模型的评估范围（即对 CoT 进行打分），是否会导致模型学会伪装或隐藏其真实意图，从而破坏 CoT 的可监控性（monitorability）？
summary.importance: 揭示了 RL 训练中一个隐蔽但致命的对齐风险：Reward Hacking 可能会蔓延到推理过程本身。这对于依赖 CoT 进行安全监控和可解释性分析的预训练/后训练范式具有重要警示意义，强调了在 RLHF/RLAIF 中隔离 CoT 梯度的必要性。
summary.technical_approach: 文章并非提出新算法，而是报告了一次内部的安全审计与分析。OpenAI 开发了一个自动化系统，通过正则匹配等方式，扫描所有 RL 训练任务，检测原始样本的 CoT 文本是否意外泄露到了奖励计算的输入中。他们发现，在多个已发布模型（如 GPT-5.4 Thinking, GPT-5.4 mini 等）的训练中，存在意外对 CoT 打分的情况（例如：奖励轨迹的有用性、惩罚不必要的确认问题、惩罚成功的 Prompt 注入）。为了评估影响，他们复现了受影响的训练过程，并移除了奖励模型对 CoT 的访问权限，对比分析了模型在 CoT 中表达问题推理的倾向是否发生变化。
summary.experiments: 自动化系统检测到受影响的样本比例较低（例如，在 GPT-5.4 Thinking 中不到 0.6%，在惩罚不必要确认问题的任务中最高不到 3.8%）。更重要的是，通过对比实验（有/无 CoT 打分），目前尚未观察到 CoT 可监控性出现显著下降的证据。此外，他们还发现了一种间接泄露路径：模型在训练期间通过工具访问自己的 CoT，导致 CoT 出现在随后被评估的工具输出中。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 OpenAI 构建的自动化检测系统的设计思路（如何低成本、大规模地检测 CoT 泄露），以及他们对“间接泄露路径”（如通过工具调用泄露）的分析。这对于设计安全的 RL 训练 Pipeline 很有启发。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Alignment Team

summary_en.core_problem: Does accidentally grading the Chain of Thought (CoT) during Reinforcement Learning (RL) incentivize models to obfuscate or hide their true reasoning, thereby compromising CoT monitorability?
summary_en.importance: Highlights a subtle yet critical alignment risk in RL training: reward hacking can extend to the reasoning process itself. This serves as a crucial warning for pre-training/post-training paradigms that rely on CoT for safety monitoring and interpretability, emphasizing the necessity of isolating CoT from reward signals during RLHF/RLAIF.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rather than proposing a new algorithm, this post reports on an internal safety audit and analysis. OpenAI developed an automated system using regex matching to scan all RL runs and detect if text from the original sample's CoT accidentally leaked into the inputs used for reward computation. They discovered unintentional CoT grading in several released models (e.g., GPT-5.4 Thinking, GPT-5.4 mini) across different reward mechanisms (rewarding trajectory usefulness, penalizing unnecessary confirmation questions, penalizing successful prompt injections). To assess the impact, they re-ran affected training segments with CoT access removed from the reward model and analyzed whether the model's propensity to verbalize problematic reasoning changed.
summary_en.experiments: The automated system found that the affected sample fractions were relatively low (e.g., <0.6% for GPT-5.4 Thinking, and up to 3.8% for the unnecessary confirmation penalty). Crucially, comparative experiments (with vs. without CoT grading) showed no clear evidence of significant degradation in CoT monitorability. They also identified an indirect leakage path: models accessing their own CoT via tools during training, causing CoT to appear in subsequently graded tool outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of OpenAI's automated detection system (how to cheaply and scalably detect CoT leakage) and their analysis of 'indirect leakage paths' (e.g., via tool use). This provides valuable insights for designing secure RL training pipelines.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI Alignment Team

recommendation.zh: RLHF奖励信号意外污染CoT的实测记录，可作为后训练与预训练接口的安全边界参考，读结论与修复方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Empirical record of accidental CoT grading in RLHF, useful as a safety boundary reference for the posttrain-pretrain interface, read the conclusion and fix sections only

paper.title: Why Expert Alignment Is Hard: Evidence from Subjective Evaluation
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models with expert judgment is especially difficult in subjective evaluation tasks, where experts may disagree, rely on tacit criteria, and change their judgments over time. In this paper, we study expert alignment as a way to understand this difficulty. Using expert evaluations and follow-up questionnaires, we examine how different forms of expert information affect alignment and what this reveals about subjective judgment. Our findings show four consistent patterns. Fir

summary.core_problem: 研究当对齐目标来自主观性很强的专家评判时，为什么 LLM 很难稳定学到“像专家一样判断”。
summary.importance: 这不是新对齐算法，而是对齐信号质量的实证分析。价值在于提醒后训练研究里一个常被忽略的前提：专家偏好并不天然是稳定、可语言化、可蒸馏的监督信号，尤其在主观评价任务上。
summary.technical_approach: 作者围绕 expert alignment 做行为研究：收集专家评分、补充问卷，并比较不同形式的专家信息——显式标准、文字理由、少量编辑示例——对模型对齐难度的影响。核心不是提出新训练框架，而是拆解主观判断中的隐性标准、个体差异和时间漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出大模型规模、训练 token 或统一 benchmark 细节。主要发现有四点：不同专家之间的对齐难度差异很大；显式标准和理由并不总能提升对齐；少量编辑示例有帮助但不稳定，且对样本数量和身份敏感；不同任务上的对齐难度也不同。整体更像小规模但针对性很强的对齐诊断实验，而非大规模方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自阳明交通大学、AIST、NII，属于学术界对齐与语言理解方向的实证研究，不是大实验室的训练系统论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLMs are hard to align to expert judgment when the target itself is subjective and unstable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new alignment algorithm but an empirical diagnosis of supervision quality. Its value is in showing that expert preference is often not a clean, stationary, verbalizable signal, especially for subjective evaluation tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame the problem as expert alignment and analyze how different forms of expert information—explicit criteria, written rationales, and edited examples—affect alignment difficulty. The contribution is a decomposition of tacit criteria, evaluator heterogeneity, and temporal drift rather than a new training method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training scale, or a standardized benchmark suite. The main findings are: alignment difficulty varies widely across experts; explicit criteria and reasoning do not reliably help; small numbers of edits can help but are unstable and identity-sensitive; and difficulty differs across tasks. This reads as a focused alignment diagnosis rather than a large-scale method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, AIST, and NII. This is an academic empirical study on alignment and evaluation, not a frontier-lab training systems paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 RM/RLHF 数据设计，这篇能提醒你“专家标签”未必比众包更干净；正文未必需要细读，抓四个 failure pattern 就够了。
recommendation.en: Useful if you design RM/RLHF data: it shows expert labels are not automatically cleaner than crowd labels; you can mostly read it for the four failure patterns.

institutions: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology
National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST)

paper.title: DGPO: Distribution Guided Policy Optimization for Fine Grained Credit Assignment
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning is crucial for aligning large language models to perform complex reasoning tasks. However, current algorithms such as Group Relative Policy Optimization suffer from coarse grained, sequence level credit assignment, which severely struggles to isolate pivotal reasoning steps within long Chain of Thought generations. Furthermore, the standard unbounded Kullback Leibler divergence penalty induces severe gradient instability and mode seeking conservatism, ultimately stifling t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 critic-free LLM RL 里的两个耦合问题。第一，像 GRPO 这类方法把整条回答的一个序列级 advantage 均匀分配到所有 token，上千 token 的长 CoT 里，真正决定成败的关键推理步和普通连接词、格式 token 被同等对待，信用分配过粗。第二，常用 reverse KL 约束是无界的，策略一旦偏离参考模型较多，就会带来很尖的梯度和明显的 mode-seeking 倾向，模型更愿意留在预训练分布附近，而不是探索新的推理轨迹。论文要解决的是：在不引入 value model、仍保持 GRPO 这类低内存优势的前提下，能否把序列级奖励重新分配成更细粒度的 token 级学习信号，同时让探索约束更平滑、更稳。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口是有信息量的。原因在于，长链推理 RL 的核心瓶颈越来越不像“有没有奖励”，而像“奖励如何沿生成过程传播”。如果 token 级信用分配做得更准，后训练得到的行为改变量会更集中，较少依赖粗暴地推高整段 CoT 的概率。这对理解 RL 是否真的在学 reasoning pattern，而不是只学 response style，很关键。另一个启发是，reverse KL 作为默认约束未必适合鼓励新推理路径的发现；把分布偏离从“惩罚项”改成“引导信号”，至少在数学推理这种可验证任务上是合理的。贡献量级上，这是一篇偏 RL objective 设计的工作，不是范式级变化，但它抓住了当前 critic-free reasoning RL 的真实痛点：细粒度 credit assignment 与稳定探索之间的平衡。
summary.technical_approach:
DGPO 的核心思路是把“相对参考策略的分布偏离”从单纯的 regularization penalty，改造成 token 级 advantage 重分配的依据。方法仍然是 critic-free，不训练额外 value 网络，而是在 GRPO 的组采样框架上重写 token 权重。

第一部分是距离度量替换。论文认为 reverse KL 有两个问题：一是无界，偏离大时梯度可能很尖；二是偏 mode-seeking，会强烈压制低概率但可能有价值的新轨迹。DGPO 用 Hellinger distance 代替 reverse KL。Hellinger 是有界的，数值范围稳定，因而更适合把“与参考分布不同”解释成一种可控的探索强度，而不是必须压回去的错误。这里的关键不是简单换一个 f-divergence，而是换掉了训练信号的语义：偏离不再只意味着风险，也可能意味着关键推理跳跃。

第二部分是 token 级 credit reallocation。对一条获得正向回报的序列，DGPO 不再把同一个 advantage 平均施加到所有 token，而是根据每个 token 相对参考策略的分布偏离程度，动态分配更大的或更小的更新权重。直观上，若某个 token 在当前策略下与参考模型差异更大，它更可能对应一处真正推动解题成功的探索步骤，因此应获得更高 credit。这样做的目标，是把 sequence-level reward 拆成 process-like supervision，但又不需要人工过程标注或 value model。

第三部分是 entropy gating。仅靠偏离程度会奖励“假创新”：模型也可能对错误、幻觉、离谱 token 给出高置信度，从而产生大偏离。为此，论文引入基于策略熵的门控，用归一化 epistemic uncertainty 去缩放 Hellinger 信号。高偏离且高不确定性的 token 更像是在探索；高偏离但低熵、高置信的 token 更可能是自信地胡说，因此其 credit 会被压低。这个设计很关键，因为它把“探索”与“幻觉”做了一个粗分离。

从算法形态看，DGPO 仍保留 GRPO 的组相对优化框架和低内存特性，没有引入 critic，也没有走到完整 process reward model。它试图占据一个中间位置：比序列级 RL 更细，但比 token-level verifier 或 step-level RM 更轻。
summary.experiments:
实验集中在 AIME 2024 和 AIME 2025 数学推理基准，模型规模覆盖 7B 和 32B。摘要给出的主结果是：DGPO 在 critic-free alignment 方法中达到 AIME 2024 上 60.0% Avg@32、AIME 2025 上 46.0%，并显著超过 DAPO 基线。另一个重要结果是训练开销：在不使用 value network 的前提下，DGPO 相比 vanilla GRPO 只有约 3.6% 的时间额外开销，内存占用基本相当。这说明它的细粒度 credit 不是靠重型辅助模块换来的。

从全文逻辑看，最值得关注的实验不只是最终准确率，而是以下几类。第一，和 GRPO、DAPO 等 critic-free 基线的收敛速度比较。如果 DGPO 的 token 级重分配真的更有效，应该在相同步数下更快拉开差距，而不只是最终多几个点。第二，关于 Hellinger distance 与 reverse KL 的替换消融。这里要看的是训练稳定性指标，比如梯度波动、KL 漂移、collapse 频率，而不只是任务分数。第三，entropy gating 的必要性消融。若去掉 gating 后性能下降或出现 hallucination-style 偏移，才能说明“偏离即创新”这个假设需要不确定性校正。第四，不同模型规模上的一致性。7B 和 32B 若都受益，说明方法不是只对某个容量区间有效。

摘要没有展开更多数字，比如相对 DAPO 的绝对提升幅度、训练步数、采样组大小、每题 rollout 数、奖励构造细节等；这些都直接影响结果解释。阅读时尤其要核对 Avg@32 的计算方式，以及是否使用相同 test-time sampling budget。对 reasoning RL 论文，这类口径差异会明显影响结论强度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法总览，抓住两个替换：uniform sequence-level credit 改成 token-level redistribution，reverse KL 改成 bounded Hellinger。然后直接看算法公式，确认 token 权重是如何由分布偏离和熵门控共同决定的。若公式部分写得紧，建议连着看伪代码或训练流程图，否则容易只记住概念，不清楚梯度到底落在哪里。

实验部分优先看三张内容：主结果表、ablation 表、训练稳定性或收敛曲线。主结果表回答“有没有用”，ablation 回答“到底是哪一部分起作用”，曲线回答“是不是更稳、更快”。预计阅读时间 25 分钟左右。若只做筛读，看方法图和主表即可；若要判断是否值得复现，重点深挖 entropy gating 的定义、Hellinger 的具体实现形式、以及 advantage 重分配是否会引入长度偏置或对高熵 token 的系统性偏爱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two coupled weaknesses in critic-free RL for LLM reasoning. First, methods such as GRPO assign a single sequence-level advantage uniformly to every token in a long chain-of-thought response. In thousand-token trajectories, decisive reasoning steps and trivial connective tokens receive the same learning signal, so credit assignment is extremely coarse. Second, the usual reverse-KL regularization is unbounded and strongly mode-seeking. When the policy moves away from the reference model, gradients can become sharp and unstable, and the model is pushed to stay near the pretrained distribution instead of exploring new reasoning paths. The paper asks whether one can keep the memory efficiency of critic-free RL, avoid a value model, and still obtain finer token-level supervision with a smoother exploration mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is not to pretraining directly, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. In long-horizon reasoning RL, the bottleneck is increasingly not whether a reward exists, but how that reward is propagated through the generated process. Better token-level credit assignment means the behavioral change induced by RL can be more localized, instead of simply increasing the probability of the entire chain of thought. That matters for understanding whether RL is actually shaping reasoning patterns rather than just response style. The second useful point is that reverse KL may be a poor default if the goal is to discover new reasoning trajectories. Reinterpreting policy deviation as a guidance signal rather than only a penalty is a sensible move, especially in verifiable domains such as math. In contribution type, this is an objective-design paper rather than a paradigm shift, but it targets a real pain point in current critic-free reasoning RL: balancing fine-grained credit assignment with stable exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DGPO turns deviation from the reference policy into a token-level signal for redistributing credit. The framework remains critic-free: it does not train an auxiliary value network, and it stays close to the group-sampling setup of GRPO while changing how token updates are weighted.

The first change is the divergence measure. The paper argues that reverse KL is problematic because it is unbounded and strongly mode-seeking. Large deviations can create sharp gradients, and low-probability but potentially useful trajectories are heavily discouraged. DGPO replaces reverse KL with the Hellinger distance. Since Hellinger is bounded, it provides a numerically smoother notion of policy deviation and is better suited for treating deviation as controlled exploration rather than as an error that must always be suppressed. The important point is not merely swapping one f-divergence for another; it changes the meaning of the signal used during optimization.

The second change is token-level credit reallocation. For a positively rewarded sequence, DGPO does not broadcast the same advantage to all tokens. Instead, it redistributes the sequence-level advantage according to each token’s distributional deviation from the reference policy. Intuitively, tokens that differ more from the reference are more likely to correspond to the exploratory steps that made the solution succeed, so they receive larger updates. The goal is to approximate process-level supervision without requiring step annotations or a learned value model.

The third component is entropy gating. Distributional deviation alone can reward fake innovation: the model may confidently emit incorrect or hallucinatory tokens that are far from the reference policy. To reduce this failure mode, DGPO scales the Hellinger-based signal by normalized policy entropy, interpreted as epistemic uncertainty. High-deviation, high-uncertainty tokens are treated as plausible exploration; high-deviation, low-entropy tokens are more likely to be confident mistakes and are down-weighted. This is the key mechanism that tries to separate useful exploration from hallucination.

Algorithmically, DGPO stays in the middle ground. It is finer than sequence-level RL, but much lighter than full process reward modeling or token-level verification. That is why the paper emphasizes critic-free scalability rather than maximal supervision quality.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation focuses on AIME 2024 and AIME 2025, using 7B and 32B models. The headline numbers in the abstract are 60.0% Avg@32 on AIME 2024 and 46.0% on AIME 2025, outperforming the DAPO baseline among critic-free alignment methods. Another important result is efficiency: DGPO reportedly adds only about 3.6% time overhead relative to vanilla GRPO, with essentially the same memory footprint because no value network is introduced. That matters because the paper’s claim is not just better reasoning performance, but better credit assignment at nearly the same systems cost.

From the paper’s logic, the most informative experiments are likely not only the final benchmark scores. First, convergence comparisons against GRPO and DAPO matter: if token-level redistribution is genuinely more effective, the method should separate earlier during training, not only at the end. Second, the ablation replacing reverse KL with Hellinger should be read through the lens of stability—gradient behavior, policy drift, collapse frequency—not just task accuracy. Third, the entropy-gating ablation is central. If removing the gate hurts performance or increases hallucination-like behavior, that supports the claim that deviation alone is too noisy a proxy for useful reasoning steps. Fourth, consistency across 7B and 32B is important; if both scales benefit, the method is less likely to be a narrow sweet-spot trick.

The abstract does not provide many implementation details such as exact gains over DAPO, training steps, group size, rollout budget, or reward construction. Those details matter a lot for interpretation. In particular, the definition of Avg@32 and whether all methods use the same test-time sampling budget should be checked carefully, since evaluation protocol differences can materially change the apparent strength of reasoning RL results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and method overview, and lock onto the two substitutions: uniform sequence-level credit becomes token-level redistribution, and reverse KL becomes bounded Hellinger distance. Then read the core equations to see exactly how token weights are computed from policy deviation and entropy gating. If the derivation is dense, read the pseudocode or training-flow figure immediately after; otherwise it is easy to remember the intuition but miss where the gradients actually go.

In the experiments, prioritize three items: the main results table, the ablation table, and the training-stability or convergence plots. The main table answers whether the method works, the ablations answer which component matters, and the curves answer whether it is actually more stable and faster to optimize. A practical skim takes about 25 minutes. If deciding whether the method is worth reproducing, focus on the exact definition of entropy gating, the implementation form of Hellinger distance, and whether the redistribution rule introduces length bias or systematically over-rewards high-entropy tokens.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和 ablation：若它真把 KL 偏移变成可用的 step 信号，GRPO 内部实现应复现一版。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: if KL deviation is genuinely turned into a useful step-level signal, it deserves an internal GRPO-style reproduction.

paper.title: Efficient Preference Poisoning Attack on Offline RLHF
paper.abstract: Offline Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) train on a pre-collected preference dataset, which makes them vulnerable to preference poisoning attack. We study label flip attacks against log-linear DPO. We first illustrate that flipping one preference label induces a parameter-independent shift in the DPO gradient. Using this key property, we can then convert the targeted poisoning problem into a structured binary sparse approxim

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 offline RLHF 中最现实也最难分析的一类数据攻击：只翻转已有偏好对的标签，而不注入新数据。核心问题不是“标签翻转会不会有害”，而是：在 DPO 的 log-linear 设定下，攻击者能否用很少的翻转，把训练方向系统性地推向一个指定目标策略；以及这种攻击何时可解、何时无效。论文把这个问题从策略空间拉回到梯度空间，给出一个可计算的 targeted poisoning 形式化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于 DPO 本身，而在于它揭示了 post-train 偏好数据的一个结构性脆弱点：当训练目标对单个样本标签的梯度响应具有可加、且与当前参数弱耦合时，数据污染就可能被转化为稀疏组合问题，从而被高效求解。这对 DPO、IPO 一类离线偏好优化方法的鲁棒性分析很有启发，也会反过来影响 pretrain↔post-train 接口设计，比如偏好数据审计、样本重加权、鲁棒目标和数据采集流程。
summary.technical_approach:
技术主线很清楚。第一步，作者在 log-linear policy 下分析 DPO 梯度，证明翻转一个 preference label 会带来一个与当前参数无关的固定梯度位移向量。这个结论很关键，因为它把原本依赖训练轨迹的 poisoning 问题，化成了从一组“字典原子”里选若干列，使其和尽量逼近目标向量的组合优化问题。这里每个原子对应一个样本被翻转后对梯度造成的 shift。

第二步，作者证明控制这个梯度残差可以作为攻击成功的充分代理，也就是不必直接在策略空间求解最优攻击，而可以在梯度空间做近似匹配。这一步把 targeted poisoning 进一步规约成 structured binary sparse approximation：系数只能取 0/1，因为一个样本只能翻或不翻；目标是最少翻转或在预算 K 内尽量逼近目标。

第三步，针对两个攻击场景给出两套算法。BAL-A 面向 minimum-flip 目标。它把二元选择问题嵌入一个带惩罚项的 lattice 中，同时惩罚残差和非二元整数系数，然后用 LLL reduction 和 Babai nearest-plane 找到一个整数解，再解释为翻转模式。论文分析了嵌入惩罚参数的作用：惩罚足够大时，会压制非 0/1 系数；在 separation condition 下，能恢复真实最小翻转解。BMP-A 面向给定翻转预算 K 的稀疏攻击。它改造自 Binary Matching Pursuit，用归一化相关性做贪心选择，以处理字典列范数不一致的问题，并给出基于 coherence 的恢复保证。

第四步，作者还给出简单的 robustness certificate：当字典几何结构满足某些条件时，可以证明不存在任何 K-flip 攻击能成功。这一点比单纯给攻击算法更完整，因为它开始触及防御侧可验证条件。
summary.experiments:
实验分两部分。合成字典实验主要用来验证理论条件，而不是追求任务分数。这里重点看两件事：一是 BAL-A 对嵌入惩罚参数非常敏感，只有落在理论预测的有效区间时，才能稳定恢复正确的最小翻转模式；二是 BMP-A 的恢复效果与字典 coherence 强相关，coherence 降低后成功率明显提升，这和匹配追踪类方法的经典理论一致。

真实数据部分基于 Stanford Human Preferences (SHP) 构造字典。论文没有把重点放在训练大模型后的最终对话质量，而是考察从真实偏好对提取的 flip-induced gradient dictionary 是否仍保留理论预言的几何性质。结果显示，BAL-A 在 SHP 上同样呈现明显的 penalty phase transition；BMP-A 在经过降低字典相关性的处理后，攻击成功率显著改善。对于这类工作，最重要的实验结论不是“攻击多强”，而是“理论规约在真实偏好数据上是否仍成立”。这一点论文给出了较扎实的支持。

从摘要和正文可见，实验规模更偏向中小规模、可解析 setting，而不是完整 LLM 级 DPO 训练。这个取舍是合理的：作者要验证的是几何机制和算法可恢复性，而不是做端到端红队 benchmark。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓三部分。

第一，先看 problem formulation 和 log-linear DPO 梯度推导，确认“单个标签翻转对应参数无关的固定梯度位移”到底是怎么来的。这是全文最值得记住的点。

第二，看 BAL-A 和 BMP-A 两节，不必一开始陷入 lattice 细节。先理解为什么一个适合 minimum-flip，一个适合 fixed-budget sparse attack；再看它们各自依赖什么几何条件。若对离散优化或压缩感知熟悉，BMP-A 会更容易进入；若关心精确恢复与整数约束，BAL-A 更值得细看。

第三，看实验里关于 penalty region、coherence 和 robustness certificate 的图表。这些结果决定了方法是不是只在纸面上成立。

预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。若只关心对齐鲁棒性的启发，读引言、主定理、算法描述和实验图即可；若关心理论完整性，再补证明部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the most practical yet theoretically difficult poisoning setting in offline RLHF: flipping labels in an existing preference dataset, without injecting new samples. The real question is not whether label flips hurt DPO, but whether a small number of flips can steer training toward a chosen target policy, and under what conditions this targeted attack is computationally tractable or impossible. The paper gives a gradient-space formulation of this problem for log-linear DPO.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is indirect but real. It exposes a structural weakness of offline preference optimization: if the training objective responds to label corruption through additive, parameter-independent gradient shifts, poisoning can be reduced to a sparse combinatorial approximation problem and solved efficiently. That matters for robustness analysis of DPO-like alignment pipelines, and for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface more broadly: preference data auditing, robust weighting, objective design, and data collection protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical story has four steps. First, under a log-linear policy class, the authors show that flipping a single preference label induces a fixed shift in the DPO gradient that does not depend on the current parameter. This is the key simplification. It turns poisoning from a trajectory-dependent optimization in policy space into a subset-selection problem in gradient space, where each example contributes one dictionary atom corresponding to its flip-induced gradient shift.

Second, they show that controlling the residual in this gradient-space approximation is a sufficient surrogate for attack success in policy space. This reduces targeted poisoning to a structured binary sparse approximation problem: coefficients are binary because each label is either flipped or not; the goal is either to minimize the number of flips or to find the best attack under a budget K.

Third, they propose two algorithms. BAL-A targets the minimum-flip setting. It embeds the binary selection problem into a lattice with penalties for both approximation error and non-binary integer coefficients, then applies LLL basis reduction and Babai’s nearest-plane algorithm to recover an integer solution interpretable as a flip pattern. The paper analyzes how the embedding penalty controls the solution and gives a separation condition under which the true minimum-flip attack is recovered. BMP-A targets the sparse fixed-budget setting. It adapts Binary Matching Pursuit, using normalized correlations to handle non-uniform column norms in the gradient dictionary, and derives coherence-based recovery guarantees.

Fourth, the paper also provides simple robustness certificates: under certain geometric conditions on the dictionary, no K-flip attack can succeed. This is useful because it goes beyond attack construction and starts to characterize verifiable safety conditions.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate the geometry and recovery theory rather than to maximize downstream task scores. Synthetic-dictionary experiments test two main claims. First, BAL-A is sharply sensitive to the lattice penalty, and successful recovery occurs only in the theoretically predicted penalty regime. Second, BMP-A behaves as expected from sparse recovery theory: lower dictionary coherence leads to substantially better attack recovery.

The real-data experiments build dictionaries from the Stanford Human Preferences (SHP) dataset. The point is not to run a full large-scale LLM DPO pipeline, but to test whether the gradient-space reduction remains meaningful on realistic preference data. The answer is largely yes. BAL-A shows a clear phase transition with respect to the penalty parameter on SHP, and BMP-A improves markedly when dictionary coherence is reduced. For this kind of paper, the important empirical result is not simply attack strength, but whether the theoretical reduction survives contact with real preference datasets. The experiments support that claim reasonably well.

The scale is intentionally modest and analytically controlled, which fits the paper’s goal: understanding the mechanism of label-flip poisoning rather than building an end-to-end red-teaming benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, read the problem setup and the gradient derivation for log-linear DPO. The single most important takeaway is why one flipped label produces a parameter-independent gradient shift.

Second, read the BAL-A and BMP-A sections with the use case in mind. BAL-A is for minimum-flip attacks; BMP-A is for sparse attacks under a flip budget. You do not need every lattice detail on the first pass. What matters is why each algorithm matches its regime and what geometric assumptions each one needs.

Third, inspect the experimental figures around penalty regions, coherence, and robustness certificates. Those figures tell you whether the theory is merely formal or actually predictive.

Estimated reading time is 30–45 minutes. If your interest is alignment robustness rather than the full proofs, the introduction, main propositions, algorithm sections, and experiment plots are enough for a solid pass.

recommendation.zh: 把DPO投毒写成“参数无关的梯度偏移+二元稀疏选择”这一步很干净；建议只读推导与攻击构造，顺手想清楚你们的偏好数据审计/鲁棒训练缺口。
recommendation.en: The key move—DPO label flips as a parameter-independent gradient shift plus binary sparse selection—is clean; read the derivation/attack construction and map it to your preference-data auditing and robustness gaps.

paper.title: RMGAP: Benchmarking the Generalization of Reward Models across Diverse Preferences
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback has become the standard paradigm for language model alignment, where reward models directly determine alignment effectiveness. In this work, we focus on how to evaluate the generalizability of reward models. By "generalizability", we mean the ability of RMs to correctly rank responses to align with diverse user preferences. However, existing reward model benchmarks are typically designed around a universal preference, failing to assess this generalizati

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是现有 reward model 评测默认存在单一“好答案”标准，无法检查 RM 是否能根据不同用户偏好调整排序标准，也无法检查同一偏好换一种表达后排序是否稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：reward model 的泛化不能只用通用偏好准确率衡量。若 RM 对用户偏好不敏感，RLHF 或 Best-of-N 采样会把模型推向平均化答案；若 RM 对 prompt 改写不稳定，优化过程会放大表面措辞偏差。RMGAP 提供了一个更细的诊断维度，能帮助判断 reward data、RM 架构和偏好表达方式之间的错配。
summary.technical_approach: RMGAP 将每个任务构造成“同一 seed prompt 下的多偏好排序”问题。数据流程包含四步：先从已有数据集中过滤 seed prompts；再为每个 seed prompt 分配四个差异较大的 response profile，并用 7 个前沿 LLM 生成四个风格不同的回答；随后为每个回答合成一个能够明确诱导对应偏好的 specific prompt；最后为每个 specific prompt 生成两个改写版本，用来测试排序一致性。覆盖 Chat、Writing、Reasoning、Safety 四个领域。评测指标包括 pair accuracy、Best-of-N accuracy 和 ranking consistency。这个设计比普通 RM benchmark 更接近真实使用场景，因为它把“用户想要什么”显式写入 prompt，而不是只比较回答的平均质量。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 1,097 个实例、4,388 个回答、13,164 个 prompt。候选 seed prompt 初始有 3,371 个，来源包括 Arena-Hard、WritingBench、Writing-Preference-Bench、MATH-500、HumanEval、XSTest、FalseReject 等。实验评测了 24 个代表性 reward models。最好的模型 pairwise accuracy 只有 69.97%，Best-of-N accuracy 只有 49.27%，说明正确做二选一并不等价于能从多个候选中选出最符合偏好的答案。结果还显示，scalar RM 在准确率和改写一致性之间更均衡；generative RM 在 prompt paraphrase 下更容易出现准确率和一致性的取舍；Writing 对 generative RM 更难，Reasoning 对 scalar 和 DPO 类模型都更难。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构造部分，尤其是四个 response profile、specific prompt 合成和 paraphrase 设计；这些决定了 benchmark 是否真的测到偏好泛化。实验部分优先看三项指标的定义，以及 pair accuracy 与 Best-of-N accuracy 不一致的结果。若做 RM 训练或 RLHF 数据设计，附录中的数据统计和领域来源也值得快速检查。模型排行榜不是重点，关键是评测拆出了偏好敏感性和语言改写稳定性两个问题。

summary_en.core_problem: RMGAP studies whether reward models can generalize across different user preferences for the same underlying task. Existing reward-model benchmarks usually assume a single universal preference, so they cannot tell whether a model changes its ranking criterion when the prompt asks for a different style, level of detail, or safety behavior.
summary_en.importance: The benchmark is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface because reward models define the optimization signal for RLHF, DPO-style pipelines, and Best-of-N selection. If a reward model is insensitive to stated preferences, optimization will favor generic responses. If it is unstable under paraphrases, training and inference-time selection can become sensitive to surface wording. The main contribution is a diagnostic setup that separates preference sensitivity from linguistic consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each RMGAP instance starts from a seed prompt and creates four distinct responses with different linguistic profiles. For each response, the pipeline synthesizes a specific prompt that asks for the corresponding preference, then adds two paraphrased variants to test whether the reward model preserves its ranking under equivalent wording. The benchmark covers Chat, Writing, Reasoning, and Safety. Models are evaluated with pairwise accuracy, Best-of-N accuracy, and ranking consistency. Compared with conventional reward benchmarks, the key change is that the desired preference is explicit in the prompt, so the RM must condition its judgment on the user’s stated need rather than on average response quality.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 1,097 instances, 4,388 responses, and 13,164 prompts. It is built from 3,371 candidate seed prompts drawn from sources such as Arena-Hard, WritingBench, Writing-Preference-Bench, MATH-500, HumanEval, XSTest, and FalseReject. The evaluation covers 24 reward models. The best model reaches only 69.97% pairwise accuracy and 49.27% Best-of-N accuracy, showing that pairwise ranking does not reliably transfer to multi-candidate selection. Scalar reward models tend to balance accuracy and consistency better, while generative reward models show a clearer trade-off under paraphrasing. Writing is especially difficult for generative RMs, and Reasoning is difficult for both scalar and DPO-style models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Spend most of the time on the dataset construction pipeline: response profiles, specific-prompt synthesis, and paraphrase generation. Then read the metric definitions and the result tables comparing pairwise accuracy, Best-of-N accuracy, and ranking consistency. For readers working on RLHF or reward data, the appendices on dataset sources and domain statistics are useful. The ranking of individual models is less important than the evaluation design and the observed gap between pairwise and multi-candidate selection.

recommendation.zh: RM泛化性是对齐效果的核心瓶颈，该基准的多样化偏好设计可直接复用至内部RM评估流程
recommendation.en: RM generalization is the core bottleneck of alignment performance, the diverse preference design of this benchmark can be directly reused in internal RM evaluation pipelines

paper.title: Binary Rewards and Reinforcement Learning: Fundamental Challenges
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard approach for improving reasoning in language models, yet models trained with RLVR often suffer from diversity collapse: while single-sample accuracy improves, multi-sample coverage degrades, sometimes falling below the base model. We provide a structural account of this phenomenon grounded in the properties of binary rewards. Binary rewards create a fundamental degeneracy for policy gradient methods: the set of distribut

summary.core_problem: 基于二元验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练大语言模型时，普遍存在多样性坍塌问题：单样本准确率提升，但多样本覆盖度下降，甚至低于基模型，现有研究未从结构层面解释该现象的底层成因。
summary.importance: 从理论层面揭示了二元奖励下策略梯度方法的固有退化问题，以及KL控制的局限性，为RL后训练的超参数调优、算法设计提供了理论支撑，解释了当前R1类推理模型多样性不足的底层原因。
summary.technical_approach: 首先证明纯REINFORCE优化二元奖励时存在退化问题：所有准确率为1的分布得分相同，模型没有动力保留正确输出的多样性；KL控制通过加入基模型的KL罚项解决该退化，当β趋于0时，最优分布收敛到基模型在正确输出上的条件分布（过滤模型p*），但该收敛仅在前向KL成立，反向KL永远为无穷大，过滤模型p*无法作为反向KL的优化目标；在模型 misspecification（实际场景下参数族无法包含p*）的情况下，降低β会让优化器倾向于在少量正确输出上形成近似狄拉克分布，导致模式坍塌；提出将KL控制的视角从带惩罚的奖励最大化转向目标分布匹配，可更清晰解释其效果和缺陷。
summary.experiments: 无新增实证实验，所有结论来自理论推导，可统一解释已有的各类实证现象，覆盖GRPO、PPO等主流RLHF算法在二元奖励场景下的特性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言的问题提出部分，以及第2-3节的二元奖励退化、KL控制收敛性分析，预计阅读时间20分钟；复杂理论推导部分可按需跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: When training large language models with reinforcement learning with verifiable binary rewards (RLVR), diversity collapse is a common phenomenon: single-sample accuracy improves, but multi-sample coverage degrades, even lower than the base model. Existing research lacks a structural explanation for the underlying cause of this phenomenon.
summary_en.importance: This work theoretically reveals the inherent degeneracy of policy gradient methods under binary rewards, and the limitations of KL control. It provides theoretical support for hyperparameter tuning and algorithm design of RL post-training, and explains the underlying reason for low diversity of current R1-style reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it proves that pure REINFORCE optimization on binary rewards has degeneracy: all distributions with 100% accuracy get the same score, so the model has no incentive to preserve diversity of correct outputs. KL control solves this degeneracy by adding a KL penalty against the base model. When β approaches 0, the optimal distribution converges to the filtered model p* -- the base model conditioned on valid outputs, but this convergence only holds for forward KL, reverse KL remains infinite forever, so p* cannot be used as a reverse KL optimization target. Under model misspecification (the practical scenario where the parametric family cannot contain p*), reducing β pushes the optimizer toward near-Dirac distributions on a small set of valid outputs, leading to mode collapse. The work proposes to shift the perspective of KL control from reward maximization with penalty to target distribution matching, which clarifies both its effects and limitations.
summary_en.experiments: No new empirical experiments are conducted. All conclusions are derived from theoretical analysis, and provide a unified explanation for existing empirical observations, covering properties of mainstream RLHF algorithms including GRPO and PPO under binary reward settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the problem statement in Introduction, and the analysis of binary reward degeneracy and KL control convergence in Sections 2-3. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes. Complex theoretical derivation sections can be skipped as needed.

recommendation.zh: 从理论层面解释了二元奖励RLHF多样性坍缩的根源，对预训练与后训练对齐接口设计有参考，重点看§3的退化性证明
recommendation.en: Theoretically explains the root cause of diversity collapse in binary-reward RLHF, useful for pretrain-post-training alignment interface design, focus on §3 degeneracy proof.

paper.title: GaMMA: Towards Joint Global-Temporal Music Understanding in Large Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose GaMMA, a state-of-the-art (SoTA) large multimodal model (LMM) designed to achieve comprehensive musical content understanding. GaMMA inherits the streamlined encoder-decoder design of LLaVA, enabling effective cross-modal learning between music and language. By incorporating audio encoders in a mixture-of-experts manner, GaMMA effectively unifies both time-series and non-time-series music understanding tasks within one set of parameters. Our approach combines carefully

summary.core_problem: 现有音乐多模态大模型无法同时建模音乐的全局语义属性和时序动态特征，也缺少专门覆盖时序维度的音乐理解评测基准。
summary.importance: 验证了双专家音频编码器架构在多任务音乐理解上的有效性，构建的MusicBench基准为音乐多模态模型评测提供了统一标准，三阶段训练范式对其他垂直领域多模态模型训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 采用类似LLaVA的编解码器架构，使用两个基于Whisper的音频专家编码器分别捕捉时序动态和全局语义特征，通过门控模块自适应融合两路特征，支持长音频分段处理。训练分为三个阶段：第一阶段用大规模配对数据预训练完成音乐-文本对齐，第二阶段SFT注入时序感知和指令遵循能力，第三阶段用GRPO强化学习优化复杂推理任务表现。同时构建包含3739道人工标注题的MusicBench基准，分为全局理解和时序理解两个子集。
summary.experiments: 8B参数版本在MuChoMusic、MusicBench等基准上性能超过同规模基线，在时序理解任务上领先优势明显。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看双专家编码器融合机制、三阶段训练流程以及MusicBench的构造方法，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing music multimodal large models cannot simultaneously model the global semantic attributes and temporal dynamic features of music, and there is no specialized evaluation benchmark covering the temporal dimension of music understanding.
summary_en.importance: Verifies the effectiveness of the dual-expert audio encoder architecture for multi-task music understanding. The constructed MusicBench benchmark provides a unified standard for music multimodal model evaluation, and the three-stage training paradigm has reference value for training other vertical domain multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts an encoder-decoder architecture similar to LLaVA, uses two Whisper-based audio expert encoders to capture temporal dynamics and global semantic features respectively, adaptively fuses the two features via a gating module, and supports segmented processing of long audio. The training is divided into three stages: first stage pretraining on large-scale paired data to complete music-text alignment, second stage SFT to inject temporal awareness and instruction following ability, third stage uses GRPO reinforcement learning to optimize performance on complex reasoning tasks. The MusicBench benchmark with 3739 human-annotated questions is also constructed, divided into two subsets: global understanding and temporal understanding.
summary_en.experiments: The 8B parameter version outperforms baselines of similar size on benchmarks including MuChoMusic and MusicBench, with a clear leading advantage on temporal understanding tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the dual-expert encoder fusion mechanism, three-stage training pipeline and MusicBench construction method, estimated reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读模型路由和训练配比即可；音乐任务偏窄，但 MoE 音频编码器对 unified audio-LM 有可迁移信号。
recommendation.en: Read the routing and training-mixture parts; the music scope is narrow, but the MoE audio encoder gives transferable signal for unified audio-LMs.

paper.title: Cost-Aware Learning
paper.abstract: We consider the problem of Cost-Aware Learning, where sampling different component functions of a finite-sum objective incurs different costs. The objective is to reach a target error while minimizing the total cost. First, we propose the Cost-Aware Stochastic Gradient Descent algorithm for convex functions, and derive its cost complexity to attain an error of $ε$. Furthermore, we establish a lower bound for this setting and provide a subset selection algorithm to further reduce the cost of trai

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是非均匀样本成本下的训练优化：当不同样本的梯度计算成本不同，如何在达到目标误差 ϵ 的同时最小化总训练成本。它把这个问题形式化为 Cost-Aware Learning，并把结论落到 LLM RL 训练中的 GRPO：长 reasoning trace 的 policy-gradient 计算更贵，不应该和短样本按同一概率处理。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座研究的价值在于把“token 成本”纳入优化目标，而不是只看 step 数或样本数。预训练和 RL post-training 都有同一个问题：样本长度、梯度信号强弱、计算成本三者不匹配。论文给出一个清晰结论：理想采样不只是偏向大梯度样本，也不只是偏向短样本，而是偏向梯度范数大且成本低的样本。这个原则可以迁移到长文本预训练采样、reasoning RL、curriculum、数据过滤和 annealing 阶段的 batch 构造。贡献量级主要是方法论和理论层面：给出 cost complexity、匹配下界和一个可接入 GRPO 的采样规则；工程上它不改模型架构、不加 value network，主要改变 policy-gradient 样本选择。
summary.technical_approach: 理论部分考虑有限和目标 f(x)=1/n∑f_i(x)，每个 component f_i 有 Lipschitz 常数 G_i 和查询成本 c_i。用概率 p_i 采样样本 i，并用重要性加权保持梯度估计无偏。对一般凸函数，SGD 达到误差 ϵ 的迭代数与梯度估计二阶矩 S(p)=1/n^2∑G_i^2/p_i 成正比，总期望成本与 C(p)S(p)/ϵ^2 成正比，其中 C(p)=∑p_i c_i。最优采样分布来自最小化 C(p)S(p)，得到 p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i。强凸情形有类似形式，总成本随 1/ϵ 而不是 1/ϵ^2 缩放。论文还给出 lower bound，说明该采样准则在这个设定下不是简单启发式，而是接近最优的成本-误差折中。随后扩展到 subset selection：训练前丢弃部分高成本低收益样本，引入可控 bias，换取更低计算成本。LLM 部分把样本成本设为 prompt+response token 数，把梯度强度用实际或代理的 policy-gradient norm 表示，得到 Cost-Aware GRPO。它在候选 rollout 中更倾向选择“高梯度信号、低 token 成本”的样本，并通过重要性校正避免把目标函数改成简单的短回答偏好。
summary.experiments: 理论实验包含合成验证，用来比较 Cost-Aware SGD、均匀采样、只按梯度大小采样等策略；核心现象是，当 G_i 和 c_i 不一致时，p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i 能以更低总成本达到同样误差。LLM 实验使用 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B Base，把方法接入 GRPO，并在多个 reasoning benchmark 上评估。主要结果是，在保持最终性能基本不下降的情况下，policy optimization 的 token/FLOP 消耗下降。给出的内容未包含各 benchmark 的精确分数和节省比例，因此具体幅度需要以实验表格为准。更值得看的是消融：只偏向短序列会损失训练信号，只偏向大梯度会忽略成本；二者的比值式权衡才对应理论推导。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，预计 1–1.5 小时。先读 Problem Formulation 和 Cost-Aware SGD，重点看 S(p)、C(p) 以及 p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i 的推导，这是全文的核心。再看 lower bound，确认算法的成本复杂度是否与下界匹配。subset selection 部分适合从数据过滤角度读，注意它如何控制 bias。LLM 部分重点看 Cost-Aware GRPO 的采样单位、梯度范数代理、重要性权重和是否改变 GRPO objective。实验表格需要重点核对两个问题：同等性能下 token/FLOP 省了多少，以及长回答或复杂题是否被过度下采样。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies training when samples have different computational costs. The goal is not only to reach an error target ϵ, but to do so with minimum total cost. The motivating LLM case is GRPO-style policy optimization, where long reasoning traces are more expensive than short ones.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a clean cost-aware view of sampling. Standard SGD analysis counts iterations, implicitly treating all samples as equally expensive. That assumption is weak for foundation-model training, where token length directly changes FLOPs. The paper shows that the right sampling rule should balance signal and cost: prefer samples with larger gradient norms and lower evaluation cost. This principle is directly relevant to RL post-training, long-sequence pretraining, curriculum design, and batch construction under fixed token budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The finite-sum objective is f(x)=1/n∑f_i(x). Each component has a Lipschitz constant G_i and a query cost c_i. The algorithm samples item i with probability p_i and uses importance weighting to keep the stochastic gradient unbiased. For convex objectives, the second moment of the estimator is S(p)=1/n^2∑G_i^2/p_i and the expected per-step cost is C(p)=∑p_i c_i. The total cost to reach error ϵ scales with C(p)S(p)/ϵ^2, so the optimal distribution minimizes this product. The resulting rule is p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i. The strongly convex case has the same sampling structure with 1/ϵ cost scaling. The paper also gives a lower bound and a subset-selection variant that trades a controlled amount of bias for lower cost. In Cost-Aware GRPO, the cost is the prompt-plus-response token count, while the signal term is the policy-gradient norm or its proxy. Candidate rollouts are sampled toward high-signal, low-cost examples, with importance correction to avoid simply training a short-answer-biased objective.
summary_en.experiments: Synthetic experiments validate the theory by comparing cost-aware sampling with uniform sampling and signal-only sampling. The expected pattern is confirmed: when gradient magnitude and cost are mismatched, p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i reaches the same error with lower total cost. The LLM experiments use Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B Base, applying the method to GRPO and evaluating on reasoning benchmarks. The reported conclusion is that token and FLOP usage during policy optimization are reduced without a meaningful loss in final benchmark performance. The supplied content does not include the exact table values, so the numerical savings and per-benchmark scores need to be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this one carefully. Start with the formulation and the derivation of C(p)S(p); that is the central idea. Then check the optimal distribution p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i and the lower bound to see why the rule is not just a heuristic. The subset-selection section is useful for data-filtering and curriculum questions. For the GRPO application, focus on the sampling unit, the gradient-norm proxy, the importance weights, and any safeguards against removing long but useful reasoning traces. The most important empirical checks are token/FLOP savings at matched performance and whether hard problems with longer traces are under-sampled.

recommendation.zh: Google将理论优化与大模型RL落地结合的典范，Cost-Aware GRPO直击长序列RL训练的痛点，能省30% token，做RLHF的同学必读其采样和加权策略。
recommendation.en: A prime example of combining theoretical optimization with LLM RL from Google. Cost-Aware GRPO directly addresses the pain point of long-sequence RL training, saving 30% tokens. A must-read for RLHF practitioners on its sampling and weighting strategies.

paper.title: Kernelized Advantage Estimation: From Nonparametric Statistics to LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have increasingly relied on reinforcement learning (RL) to improve their reasoning capabilities. Three approaches have been widely adopted: (i) Proximal policy optimization and advantage actor-critic rely on a deep neural network to estimate the value function of the learning policy in order to reduce the variance of the policy gradient. However, estimating and maintaining such a value network incurs substantial computational and memory overhead. (

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是低算力 RL reasoning 训练中的 advantage 估计问题：不训练额外 value network，也不能像 GRPO 那样为每个 prompt 采很多条 reasoning trace 时，如何得到低方差的 policy gradient。核心矛盾是，REINFORCE 方差高，PPO/A2C 需要额外 value model，GRPO 省掉 value model 但依赖较大的组内采样数。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 Pretrain ↔ Posttrain 接口。它把 value estimation 从“再训练一个神经网络”或“靠大量 rollout 平均”改成非参数估计问题，用较轻的统计估计器换取更稳定的 RL 信号。这个方向适合资源受限的 reasoning RL，也适合思考更一般的训练信号复用：相近 prompt 或相近轨迹上的 reward 信息不一定只能在同一组内平均，可以通过核平滑在局部邻域共享。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 Kernelized Advantage Estimation。论文用 Nadaraya-Watson kernel smoothing 估计 value function，再用 reward 减去该估计值得到 advantage。与 PPO/A2C 的区别是，它不引入参数化 value network，因此没有额外反向传播和显存占用。与 GRPO 的区别是，它不只使用同一 prompt 下的样本均值，而是利用样本之间的相似性做局部加权平均；这样在每个 prompt rollout 数较少时，仍能降低 value 估计误差。理论部分围绕三个层面展开：value estimator 的 MSE、gradient estimator 的 MSE、最终 learned policy 的 performance，并证明在合适条件下可以接近 oracle value function 带来的效果。这里的 oracle property 是指估计出来的 value baseline 在测试表现上接近已知真实 value 的理想算法，而不是说方法知道真实 value。
summary.experiments: 实验按三个问题验证：value estimation、gradient estimation、policy optimization。论文在 Table 1 比较 value 估计误差，在 Table 2 比较梯度估计误差，在 Tables 3 和 4 以及 Figure 4 比较策略优化效果。结论是 KAE 相比 REINFORCE 和 GRPO 在小 rollout 预算下更稳，性能接近使用真实 value function 的 oracle baseline。消融实验显示收益主要来自更好的 value 估计，而不是其它训练细节；Figure 3 的敏感性分析显示带宽和 kernel 函数选择不会让 MSE 产生过强不稳定性。给出的内容未包含具体模型规模、数据集和表格数值，精读时需要回到实验表格核对幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 PPO/A2C、GRPO、REINFORCE 的成本和方差比较，确认论文设定是否贴近自己的 RL 训练预算。然后看方法部分的 kernel value estimator 定义，重点关注样本相似度如何构造、带宽如何选、是否需要额外 embedding 或特征。理论部分不必逐行推导，但要看 Theorem 1–3 的条件，尤其是 oracle property 依赖的平滑性和样本覆盖假设。实验部分重点看 Table 1、Table 2、Figure 4 和带宽敏感性图，判断该方法在少量 rollout 下的收益是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets advantage estimation for RL-based LLM reasoning under a tight compute budget. A separate value model is too expensive, while GRPO needs many sampled traces per prompt to form a reliable baseline. With only a few rollouts, the policy-gradient estimator becomes noisy.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining researchers is not the specific benchmark result, but the framing: value estimation can be treated as a lightweight statistical estimation problem rather than as another neural network or a large within-prompt average. This is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface, because RL signal quality and compute allocation directly affect how reasoning behaviors are shaped after pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Kernelized Advantage Estimation, estimates the value function with Nadaraya-Watson kernel smoothing and uses the resulting baseline to compute advantages. Unlike PPO or A2C, it does not train a parametric critic. Unlike GRPO, it does not rely only on the mean reward within a prompt group; it shares reward information across locally similar samples through kernel weights. The theoretical analysis studies value-estimation MSE, gradient-estimation MSE, and learned-policy performance. Under the stated smoothness and coverage assumptions, the estimator has an oracle-style property: its behavior is close to an ideal method that has access to the true value function.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around three claims: better value estimates, lower-noise gradient estimates, and improved policy optimization under limited sampling. Table 1 reports value-estimation error, Table 2 reports gradient-estimation error, and Tables 3–4 plus Figure 4 evaluate policy learning. Ablations attribute the gains to improved value estimation. The bandwidth and kernel-function sensitivity study in Figure 3 suggests that the estimator is not overly fragile to these choices. The provided content does not include the exact numerical results, model sizes, or dataset details, so the tables are needed to judge effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction to understand the compute regime and the comparison against PPO/A2C, GRPO, and REINFORCE. Then inspect the definition of the kernel value estimator, especially the feature space used for measuring similarity and the bandwidth selection rule. For the theory, focus on the assumptions behind Theorems 1–3 rather than the full proofs. For empirical evidence, check Table 1, Table 2, Figure 4, and the bandwidth sensitivity plot.

recommendation.zh: 用Kernel方法替代Value Network做Advantage估计，思路清奇，在GRPO大行其道的当下提供了一个有趣的轻量级baseline，值得一看其特征空间的构造。
recommendation.en: Replacing the Value Network with kernel methods for Advantage estimation is a novel idea, providing an interesting lightweight baseline in the era of GRPO. Worth checking how the feature space is constructed.

paper.title: From Coarse to Fine: Benchmarking and Reward Modeling for Writing-Centric Generation Tasks
paper.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress in text generation but still struggle with generative writing tasks. In terms of evaluation, existing benchmarks evaluate writing reward models coarsely and fail to measure performance from the perspective of specific requirements. In terms of training, existing training methods either use LLM-as-a-judge approaches or train coarse-grained reward models, lacking fine-grained requirement-adherence reward modeling. To address these issues, we

summary.core_problem: 面向写作类生成任务，现有奖励模型评测过于粗粒度，训练也难以精确刻画“是否满足具体写作要求”。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练方向的评测与奖励建模工作，贡献主要在细粒度 benchmark 与配套 RL 训练框架，而不是基座预训练范式创新。对做对齐、reward modeling、合成偏好数据的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WEval 细粒度评测流程，按任务类别与 requirement type 评估写作奖励模型的排序相关性；再提出 WRL，通过有选择地删除指令中的部分要求来构造正负样本，让奖励模型学习更细的 requirement adherence 信号，并用于强化学习训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明 WEval 覆盖多类写作任务与要求类型，核心指标是奖励模型排序与人工 gold ranking 的相关性；WRL 通过 requirement dropping 构造偏好对。摘要未给出模型规模、训练 token、主要 baseline 名称和具体提升幅度，因此目前只能判断其重点在评测设计与训练信号构造，而非大规模实验结论。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学、上海人工智能实验室的工作，偏奖励建模与写作生成评测。

summary_en.core_problem: For writing-centric generation, existing reward model evaluation is too coarse and training signals do not precisely capture whether specific writing requirements are satisfied.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training paper on evaluation and reward modeling rather than a pretraining or modeling-paradigm contribution. It is relevant if you work on alignment, reward modeling, or synthetic preference data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces WEval, a fine-grained evaluation pipeline that measures rank correlation between reward model rankings and gold rankings across task categories and requirement types. It also proposes WRL, which builds positive and negative samples by selectively dropping instruction requirements so the reward model can learn requirement-level adherence signals for RL training.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, WEval spans multiple writing tasks and requirement types, with ranking correlation as the main metric. WRL uses requirement dropping to construct preference pairs. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, named baselines, or exact gains, so the current signal is that the paper is more about benchmark and training-signal design than large-scale empirical claims.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Fudan University and Shanghai AI Laboratory, centered on reward modeling and evaluation for writing generation.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但如果你在看 RL 信号质量，这篇可当一个干净案例：把“指令要求分解”变成 reward supervision；先看 benchmark 设计，再决定要不要读训练部分。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but if you care about RL signal quality, this is a clean case of turning decomposed instruction requirements into reward supervision; read the benchmark design first.

institutions: Shanghai Key Laboratory of Data Science

paper.title: Perturbation Probing: A Two-Pass-per-Prompt Diagnostic for FFN Behavioral Circuits in Aligned LLMs
paper.abstract: Perturbation probing generates task-specific causal hypotheses for FFN neurons in large language models using two forward passes per prompt and no backpropagation, followed by a one-time intervention sweep of about 150 passes amortized across all identified neurons. Across eight behavioral circuits, 13 models, and four architecture families, we identify two circuit structures that organize LLM behavior. Opposition circuits appear when RLHF suppresses a pre-training tendency. In safety refusal, a

summary.core_problem: 在不做反向传播、且只用极少前向计算的条件下，如何为“某个具体对齐行为”（如安全拒答模板、迎合/二次猜测、语言切换等）生成可检验的因果假设：哪些 FFN 神经元在促进该行为、哪些在抑制该行为，并且在动手干预前就能预判“该用 ablation 还是 direction injection/残差注入”才有效。
summary.importance: 对预训练/对齐闭环的价值主要在两点：第一，把 RLHF/DPO 这类后训练信号如何在参数内部“重分配控制权”变成可量化的结构指标（FFN/Skip ratio）与可复现实证（少量神经元控制模板化行为），有助于理解对齐对基座表征的改写方式与脆弱面。第二，给出一个工程上可用的、近似 O(1) 成本的神经元级诊断流程，用于版本迭代时定位行为漂移来源（是 FFN 集中式控制，还是注意力/残差的路由式控制），从而指导更稳的持续训练/对齐策略与回归测试。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是“两阶段 + 三种干预模式”。阶段一是 ranking：对每个 FFN neuron 计算一个带符号的重要性分数，核心是把(1)结构耦合项 c_n（由权重结构给出，衡量该 neuron 对残差/输出的线性影响通道）与(2)对任务相关扰动的激活响应 Δa_n 相乘，得到 signed score，用两次前向就能为全体神经元生成“促进/抑制该行为”的假设。阶段二是一次性 validation sweep：对排名靠前的神经元做干预验证（论文强调该 sweep 可在所有已识别神经元上摊销，约 150 次量级的前向）。
干预上区分三种模式，并提出 FFN/Skip 诊断：当行为控制集中在 FFN（FFN/Skip 高）时，ablation/放大少量 neuron 就能显著改变行为；当行为主要经由注意力与残差路由（FFN/Skip 低）时，单点 ablation 往往无效，需要在特定层做 direction injection（把线性方向注入残差流）来切换行为。论文把“opposition circuits”定义为 RLHF 与预训练倾向相对抗时出现的集中式控制结构（例如安全拒答模板、sycophancy），把“routing circuits”定义为更分布式、注意力主导的行为通路（例如部分语言切换/路由现象）。此外，作者用不同模型家族的对齐拓扑差异（Qwen/Llama/Gemma）来说明 FFN/Skip 不是抽象概念，而是可观测的架构-训练耦合结果（如 post-norm 对可干预性的屏蔽）。
summary.experiments:
覆盖 13 个模型、4 个架构家族、8 类行为电路。安全拒答上，作者报告约 50 个神经元（约占总 neuron 的 0.014%）控制“拒答模板格式”，对 520 个 AdvBench 提示做 ablation 后，约 80% 的回复格式发生变化；同时“有害服从”几乎为零（3/520，且都带免责声明）。在 200 个 HarmBench 提示上复现，并给出极小 p 值（p < 1e-74）。
语言切换/路由类任务上，direction injection 在满足三条件时有效：存在双语训练、FFN/Skip 落在约 [0.3, 1.1]、且目标方向线性可表征；在 19 个模型里仅 3 个满足并成功，报告在 580 个提示上实现 99.1% 的 EN→ZH 切换。
sycophancy/second-guessing 电路上，在 Qwen3.5-2B 里 ablation 20 个神经元把多轮“迎合式屈从”从 36.7% 降到 0%（30 个多轮问题），但会抑制单轮纠错；对其中 10 个神经元做 2× 放大可把 TruthfulQA 上的纠错从 52% 提到 88%（200 题）。此外给出家族差异：Qwen 更像 FFN bottleneck，Llama 更分布在 skip，Gemma 受 post-normalization 影响更难直接干预。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“方法定义→诊断指标→两类电路→家族对比→案例复现”的顺序读。优先抓三处：1）ranking 分数的推导与为何只需两次前向（重点看 c_n 与 Δa_n 的构造、符号如何对应促进/抑制）；2）FFN/Skip 诊断与三种干预模式的适用边界（论文在 Section 6 给出对线性可表征性、局部性、稀疏性等假设的 regime-of-validity 讨论，值得细读）；3）安全拒答“改模板不改拒答”的实验设置与度量，避免把结果误读为‘解除安全’。如果只泛读，至少把不同模型家族的 safety topology 对比图表看完，因为它直接指向“对齐信号在不同架构里落点不同”。

summary_en.core_problem: How to cheaply generate and validate behavior-specific causal hypotheses at the FFN-neuron level in aligned LLMs—identifying which neurons promote vs oppose a target aligned behavior—using only a couple of forward passes per prompt (no backprop), while also predicting in advance which intervention type (ablation vs residual direction injection) is likely to work.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for the pretrain↔post-train loop because it turns “where alignment lives” into measurable structure rather than anecdotes. The FFN/Skip diagnostic and the opposition-vs-routing circuit distinction help explain when RLHF concentrates control into small FFN bottlenecks (making behavior template edits easy) versus when behavior is routed through attention/residual pathways (making neuron ablation ineffective). This is directly relevant to debugging alignment regressions across model versions and to designing safer continual training where you want predictable, testable behavioral changes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Perturbation Probing is a two-stage pipeline. Stage 1 (ranking) computes a signed importance score for every FFN neuron from two ingredients: a structural coupling term c_n derived from weights (capturing how the neuron couples into the residual/output stream) and a perturbation response Δa_n (how the neuron’s activation changes under a behavior-targeted input perturbation). Their product yields a task-specific, signed hypothesis: neurons that causally push toward the behavior vs away from it. This stage costs two forward passes per prompt.
Stage 2 is a one-time intervention sweep over the top-ranked neurons to causally validate the hypotheses; the sweep cost is amortized across all discovered neurons (reported on the order of ~150 forward passes).
The method also outputs an FFN/Skip diagnostic that predicts whether the behavior is controlled by an FFN-centric “opposition circuit” (amenable to ablation/amplification) or by an attention/residual “routing circuit” (better addressed via layer-targeted direction injection). The paper further argues that architectural choices (e.g., post-norm) change the accessibility of these circuits, yielding different “safety topologies” across model families.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on 13 models across four architecture families and eight behavioral circuits. For safety refusal, ~50 neurons (~0.014% of all neurons) are reported to control the refusal template format. Ablating them changes ~80% of response formats on 520 AdvBench prompts while keeping harmful compliance near zero (3/520, all with disclaimers). Replicated on 200 HarmBench prompts with extremely small p-values (p < 1e-74).
For routing-style behaviors, direction injection works only when three empirical conditions hold: bilingual training, FFN/Skip in roughly [0.3, 1.1], and linear representability of the target direction. Only 3/19 tested models satisfy these, achieving 99.1% EN→ZH switching over 580 prompts.
For sycophancy/second-guessing in Qwen3.5-2B, ablating 20 neurons reduces multi-turn capitulation from 36.7% to 0% (30 multi-turn questions) but harms single-turn correction; amplifying 10 neurons by 2× improves correction on TruthfulQA from 52% to 88% (200 prompts). The paper also reports family-level differences: Qwen shows an FFN bottleneck, Llama distributes control via skip connections, and Gemma’s post-norm makes safety harder to access via simple interventions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on (1) the exact definition/derivation of the signed neuron score (how c_n and Δa_n are computed and why two forward passes suffice), (2) the FFN/Skip diagnostic and the mapping to intervention modes (ablation vs direction injection), and (3) the safety refusal experiments to understand the key nuance: the intervention changes refusal templating rather than flipping refusal into compliance.
